barbarian>monk.text: I've crushed boulders bigger than you.
Boulders do not move. I do.

monk>barbarian.text: Breathe. Your anger arrives three steps before you do.
Good. Then it hits you first.

barbarian>moon-elf.text: The moon does not stand still for wolves. Why for you?

moon-elf>barbarian.text: You will never see my arrow coming.

barbarian>ninja.text: Where'd you go? Come out and fight!

ninja>barbarian.text: The poison is already inside you.

barbarian>paladin.text: Nice shiny armor. I'll give it back dented.
It has been dented before. My faith has not.

paladin>barbarian.text: Lay down your axe, and I will pray for you.
Pray for yourself. You're the one standing near me.

barbarian>pyromancer.text: Fire is hot. I don't like hot.
Oh, don't worry! You won't feel it for long!

pyromancer>barbarian.text: You're so big! You'll burn for ages!

barbarian>shadow-thief.text: Was your bag. Try to keep up.

shadow-thief>barbarian.text: Big muscles, empty head. Easiest job I'll ever have.

barbarian>treant.text: You're the biggest thing I've punched this week!
Youth often mistakes size for significance, child.

treant>barbarian.text: I was old... before your people learned fire, child.
Old means slow. Slow means I win.

barbarian>artificer.text: Nice toys. Can I break them?
Request denied. Proceed anyway, I require the impact data.

artificer>barbarian.text: Your cranial architecture suggests a fascinating absence of higher cognitive function.

barbarian>cursed-pirate.text: Take it, mate! Cursed gold's done me no favors.

cursed-pirate>barbarian.text: Ye look strong enough to carry me gold—
Ghost lady! Can I punch ghosts?

barbarian>gunslinger.text: Tiny metal pebbles? That's your weapon?
Pebbles move faster than you, big man.

gunslinger>barbarian.text: There's a bounty on your head, big fella.
Only one? I must be slipping.

barbarian>huntress.text: Nyra thinks you look nice too. Mostly the legs.

huntress>barbarian.text: Nyra hasn't eaten in two days.

barbarian>samurai.text: A blade needs no weight. Only purpose. You have neither.

samurai>barbarian.text: You fight without discipline. There is no honor in that.

seraph>barbarian.text: Avert your eyes, mortal, lest my light blind you.

barbarian>tactician.text: Get down from that hill and fight!
Surrender the high ground to a battering ram? No.

tactician>barbarian.text: I have predicted every move you will make.

vampire-lord>barbarian.text: So much blood in one body. How generous.

barbarian>black-panther.text: You're a king? Kings don't fight.
In Wakanda, the king fights first.

black-panther>barbarian.text: Strike me as hard as you like. I absorb every blow.

barbarian>black-widow.text: Everyone says that. Right before the bomb goes off.

black-widow>barbarian.text: I've read your file. It's one page.

barbarian>captain-marvel.text: You glow. Why do you glow?
Because I'm about to hit you from orbit.

captain-marvel>barbarian.text: Try to keep up, big guy.

barbarian>doctor-strange.text: Sorcerer Supreme. And the feeling is entirely mutual.

doctor-strange>barbarian.text: I've foreseen fourteen million futures. You lose in all of them.
Even the one where I punch you?

barbarian>loki.text: These are a crown, you absolute ox.

loki>barbarian.text: Bow, and I may keep you as a pet.

barbarian>spider-man.text: Right here! Wait—no! Not here! Totally invisible!

spider-man>barbarian.text: Okay, big guy, let's just talk about this.

barbarian>scarlet-witch.text: Your red magic doesn't scare me.
Then you haven't seen what it did to the last one.

barbarian>thor.text: HA! Finally, a worthy brawler! Have at thee!

thor>barbarian.text: After this, we drink together, friend!

barbarian>cyclops.text: I don't need them for you.

cyclops>barbarian.text: I've analyzed your weaknesses. There are several.

barbarian>gambit.text: Card games are for sitting down.
Gambit's cards don't sit still, mon ami. Dey explode.

gambit>barbarian.text: Care to make a wager, big man?

iceman>barbarian.text: Chill out, big guy. You're overheating.

barbarian>jean-grey.text: —I AM THE FLAME THAT BURNED THE STARS.

jean-grey>barbarian.text: I'm so sorry for what happens next—

barbarian>psylocke.text: Fair is a word for people who lose.

psylocke>barbarian.text: I've been inside your mind. It echoes.

barbarian>rogue.text: You fly? Come fight on the ground!
Oh, I'll come down, sugar. You won't like the landin'.

rogue>barbarian.text: One touch, sugar, and your strength is mine.

barbarian>storm.text: I will make it thunder. Upon you.

storm>barbarian.text: The storm does not ask permission.

barbarian>wolverine.text: Small man. Big claws. I like you.
Don't. Everybody I like ends up hurt, bub.

wolverine>barbarian.text: You smell like a tavern floor, bub.

headless-horseman>barbarian.text: Heh heh heh... are you afraid, big man?

barbarian>necromancer.text: They are my ARMY! ...You there! Stand up straight!

necromancer>barbarian.text: Kneel before the Lord of the Dead, you overgrown oaf!

barbarian>pale-lady.text: How charming. The dress will survive. You shall not.

pale-lady>barbarian.text: Do mind your manners, you enormous—

barbarian>raveness.text: Your bird keeps looking at me.
He is choosing where to begin.

raveness>barbarian.text: Nevermore shall you stand, brute. Quoth the raven.

barbarian>druid.text: You turn into a bear? Cool!
Keep that enthusiasm. The bear appreciates it.

druid>barbarian.text: The wild answers when I call—
Ha! I wrestle bears for fun!

barbarian>duelist.text: Dancing is fighting, you dull, dim destroyer.

duelist>barbarian.text: Step forward, stumble, strike... then swiftly surrender.

forgemaster>barbarian.text: That beard... not bad. For a tall one.

barbarian>sun-elf.text: Then you are not worthy of her light.

sun-elf>barbarian.text: Kneel beneath the sun, and be warmed.
Already warm. Too warm. Let's fight.

barbarian>santa.text: Santa! You never bring me presents!
Ho ho ho! You're on the naughty list, son.

santa>barbarian.text: Ho ho ho! Let's see who's been naughty!

barbarian>krampus.text: Charming. Into the sack you go.

krampus>barbarian.text: I remember everything you did last year.

barbarian>alchemist.text: Oh, much better! Drink it and we'll find out!

alchemist>barbarian.text: Hold still, big subject. For science.

barbarian>mystic-brawler.text: Big muscles! Almost as big as mine.
Almost? Friend, the ocean itself envies these.

mystic-brawler>barbarian.text: No hard feelings when I win, brother!

barbarian>deadpool.text: Complexity ONE, folks! The only one! They made him for the tutorial.

deadpool>barbarian.text: Congrats, big guy! Only complexity-one hero in the whole game!

monk>moon-elf.text: The moon only shines with borrowed light.
And yet you still cannot look away.

moon-elf>monk.text: Chase me through the shadows, little monk.
I do not chase. The river waits for the leaf.

monk>ninja.text: Stillness is your weapon. It is also mine.

ninja>monk.text: Then it has met its teacher.

monk>paladin.text: Your armor is loud. I heard you coming for miles.
Good. The righteous need not sneak.

paladin>monk.text: With every breath. I simply ask for nothing.

monk>pyromancer.text: Fire consumes everything, and is left with nothing.
Ooh, deep! Can I burn your little robe now?

pyromancer>monk.text: You're so calm! I wonder how you scream!
Many have wondered. None have found out.

monk>shadow-thief.text: Greed is a pocket with no bottom.
Perfect. Then I'll never run out of room.

shadow-thief>monk.text: The longer this takes, the deadlier I get.
Then we are both in no hurry.

monk>treant.text: I once meditated beneath a tree like you.
Beneath my brother... child. He remembers... your weight.

treant>monk.text: You are... almost patient, child. Almost.
Coming from you, that is a great compliment.

monk>artificer.text: Correct. Which is why they do not hesitate.

artificer>monk.text: Human body, zero upgrades. Remarkably inefficient.
It took a lot of time to forge. Yours took a weekend.

monk>cursed-pirate.text: You laugh at death. Does death laugh back?
Aye, every night. We're old drinkin' mates.

monk>gunslinger.text: Revenge is a debt that grows as you pay it.

gunslinger>monk.text: You're fast, monk. Not faster than lead.
I need not outrun it. Only step aside.

monk>huntress.text: You and your tiger breathe as one. Impressive.
Nyra says you smell like incense. She hates incense.

huntress>monk.text: Nyra wants to play with you.
I have seen how cats play.

monk>samurai.text: You carry your honor like a heavy stone.
And you carry nothing. That is no virtue.

samurai>monk.text: A warrior without a blade. I will not dishonor you.

monk>seraph.text: Your light is bright. My eyes are already closed.
Clever. Blindness will not save you.

seraph>monk.text: I kneel every morning. Not to you.

monk>tactician.text: You plan every step. I simply take them.
Precisely. And I've already planned where yours end.

tactician>monk.text: From up here, you look like a pawn.
From down here, you look lonely.

monk>vampire-lord.text: Centuries of life, and still a slave to hunger.
Slave? Darling, hunger is my favorite servant.

vampire-lord>monk.text: Such calm blood. It must taste like tea.
Bitter tea. You won't enjoy it.

monk>black-panther.text: A king who fights. Who rules while you are here?
Wakanda rules itself. I only serve it.

black-panther>monk.text: A king must be calm before he strikes.
A monk must be calm after, as well.

monk>black-widow.text: You have carried many names. Which one is true?
Depends who's asking. And what they paid.

black-widow>monk.text: Calm, disciplined, no attachments. You'd have made a good spy.
I left the world. You were taken from it.

monk>captain-marvel.text: You move so fast. Where are you going?
Wherever you are. Just a second before you.

captain-marvel>monk.text: Cute breathing exercises. I punch planets.

monk>doctor-strange.text: You mastered the mystic arts. Did you study humility?

doctor-strange>monk.text: Your chi is quaint. I bend dimensions.
And yet your hands still tremble.

monk>loki.text: Does it matter? You'll lose to all of us.

loki>monk.text: Peaceful, humble, self-denying. How dreadfully boring.
Boredom is a mind that cannot sit still.

monk>spider-man.text: I can hear your heart, young one.
Cool, cool. Can you ask it to calm down?

spider-man>monk.text: Where'd I go? Invisible! Totally gone!
Your footsteps did not get the message.

monk>scarlet-witch.text: Your power is great. Your grief is greater.
Don't. You don't know what I lost.

scarlet-witch>monk.text: Change the world all you like. I remain.

monk>thor.text: Why would I not? It is glorious!

thor>monk.text: Little monk! Where is thy weapon?

cursed-pirate>monk.text: Ye look peaceful, mate. Death's peaceful too—

monk>cyclops.text: You lead many. Who leads you?
Professor Charles Xavier. I think you two would get along just fine.

cyclops>monk.text: I've already planned your defeat. Three phases.
Three? I will need only one.

monk>gambit.text: You gamble with everything. Even yourself.
Dat's de only bet worth makin', mon ami.

gambit>monk.text: Pick a card, monk. Any card.
I do not trust chance. I trust training.

monk>iceman.text: Especially in battle. Keeps things from getting... frosty.

iceman>monk.text: Ice to meet you! Get it? ...Tough crowd.
I got it. I chose silence.

monk>jean-grey.text: Balance, child. Even fire must rest.
—DOES NOT REST UNTIL ALL BURNS TO ASH.

jean-grey>monk.text: Please keep your mind calm. She's drawn to chaos.
Then she will find nothing here.

monk>psylocke.text: Your blade is made of thought. Mine, of flesh.

psylocke>monk.text: I could paralyze you before you blink.

monk>rogue.text: You avoid touch. So do I, in my way.
Difference is, sugar, you got to choose.

rogue>monk.text: Careful, sugar. Whatever I take, I keep a little of.
Then take my patience. You need it.

monk>storm.text: Your storm rages. Where is its center?

storm>monk.text: Your stillness will not survive my winds.
The grass bends. The oak breaks.

monk>wolverine.text: Your body heals quickly. But not everything, I think.

wolverine>monk.text: Don't gimme the inner peace speech, bub.
I would not waste it on you.

monk>headless-horseman.text: You have no head. How do you think?
Heh heh! I'M the head, fool! He just rides!

headless-horseman>monk.text: Heh heh heh... I'll haunt your dreams, monk!
You will find them very boring.

monk>necromancer.text: Rest? They've never worked harder! ...You! Stop napping!

necromancer>monk.text: Everyone laughed at me! Who's laughing now, monk?

monk>pale-lady.text: You keep the wolf on a leash.
A leash? Darling, I simply hold the door.

monk>raveness.text: You are sad, even when you win.
Especially then. Victory is so brief.

raveness>monk.text: Nevermore shall you know peace, monk.
Peace is never lost. Only forgotten.

druid>monk.text: You and I both follow nature.
You follow it. I sit and let it pass.

monk>duelist.text: You dance well. But I do not dance.
Then stand still, you stiff, stubborn statue.

duelist>monk.text: Perfect posture, patient poise... pity about the pajamas.
They are robes. And they are very comfortable.

monk>forgemaster.text: So much armor. What are you afraid of?
Rust. And fools who fight in bathrobes.

forgemaster>monk.text: No steel, no blade, no shield. Madness.

monk>sun-elf.text: You worship the sun. I only sit in it.
Then you have been praying without knowing it.

sun-elf>monk.text: Your robe is the color of dawn. She approves.
It was the only one left.

monk>santa.text: You give without expecting return. I admire that.
Ho ho ho! Oh, I expect a return, son. Right hook.

santa>monk.text: Ho ho ho! What does a monk want for Christmas?
Nothing. Please do not bring it.

monk>krampus.text: You remember every sin. That must be heavy.
Heavy? It's what keeps me warm.

krampus>monk.text: I know what you did last year.

monk>alchemist.text: Or the fumes! Honestly, could be the fumes!

alchemist>monk.text: This one melts steel! Let's see what it does to inner peace!

monk>mystic-brawler.text: Your ancestors walk beside you. Mine prefer to sit.
Then mine will carry them! We're generous like that!

mystic-brawler>monk.text: Hit me as hard as you can, little brother!
I know what you are. I will not.

monk>deadpool.text: Sit. Breathe. Be still for one moment.
Still? Pal, my contract says I talk until the dice drop.

deadpool>monk.text: Chi, huh? I've got chimichangas. Close enough.

pale-lady>monk.text: Serenity is so fragile, sir. Allow me to demonstrate—

monk>druid.text: You change shape so easily. Who are you, truly?

deadpool>moon-elf.text: Moon elf, huh? I'm more of a taco-night guy.
Then you will enjoy the dark. It is coming for you.

moon-elf>deadpool.text: Strike at me, clumsy thing. I am never where you aim.
Great. So this intro's the only time I land anything.

deadpool>ninja.text: Ninja versus Deadpool! Wait, which one of us is the ninja?

ninja>deadpool.text: Did she just shush me? In MY intro?

deadpool>paladin.text: Can you pray I roll an Ultimate?
I will pray for your soul. It needs it more.

paladin>deadpool.text: Which sins? I've got a whole spin-off's worth.

deadpool>pyromancer.text: Burn me all you want. I heal. It's a whole thing.
Oh, wonderful! So I get to do it again and again!

pyromancer>deadpool.text: Your skin looks like it's already been on fire!

deadpool>shadow-thief.text: Poison guy! Fun fact: I heal faster than you stab.
Fun fact: I already took your wallet.

shadow-thief>deadpool.text: A mercenary, eh? What's your rate?
Two tacos and a speaking role. Tacos are negotiable.

deadpool>treant.text: Big tree! Say 'I am Groot'! ...Wrong franchise? Same company!
A tree... who speaks? Bring him to me... child.

treant>deadpool.text: You are loud, child... like a sapling in a storm.
Says the guy with forty tokens on his board.

deadpool>artificer.text: Robot dad! Can your bots do the robot? Do it!
They are not toys. They are statistically superior to you.

artificer>deadpool.text: Your body is a failed prototype that refuses to be discarded.
Ouch. Too bad Mutant Healing's printed right on my board.

deadpool>cursed-pirate.text: Pirate lady! Talk like a pirate! ...Oh. You just do that.
Aye, and ye talk like a bilge rat with a head wound.

deadpool>gunslinger.text: Twin pistols? Cute. Half my dice are finger guns.

gunslinger>deadpool.text: Oh dice gods, grant me an Ultimate. Without using cards. Amen.

deadpool>huntress.text: Who's a good kitty? Is it you? It's you!
She's not a kitty. She's deciding which arm first.

huntress>deadpool.text: Nyra won't eat you. You smell wrong.
Harsh, but fair. I'm mostly scar tissue and tacos.

deadpool>samurai.text: Two swords! Same! Katana buddies! High five!
Your blades have no honor. Neither do you.

samurai>deadpool.text: Honor's extra. I only paid for the base game.

deadpool>seraph.text: Holy blades, blinding light, crystal wings... who balanced you?

seraph>deadpool.text: Your soul is stained beyond cleansing.
Stained? Lady, I wear red. It hides everything.

deadpool>tactician.text: You stand on a hill and point. That's a job?
It is the job. Yours is to be pointed at.

tactician>deadpool.text: You are a pawn, mercenary. A loud one.
Wrong game, chief. This is Dice Throne, not chess.

deadpool>vampire-lord.text: Blood Power tokens? That's just a fancy word for snacks.
And you, darling, are the snack.

vampire-lord>deadpool.text: Centuries of hunting, and never prey so... chatty.
You should hear me after a bad roll.

deadpool>black-panther.text: Your Majesty! Any vibranium upgrades? Asking for my face.
Wakanda does not share its secrets. Especially with you.

black-panther>deadpool.text: I have heard much about you, Wade Wilson.
All lies. Unless it's flattering. Then all true.

deadpool>black-widow.text: Natasha! Remember me? That one mission?
I remember. That's why I brought two bombs.

black-widow>deadpool.text: Neither of those is how I work.

deadpool>captain-marvel.text: Photon blasts, flying, super strength... you're basically a cheat code.
And you're the glitch I'm about to fix.

captain-marvel>deadpool.text: Last chance to walk away, Wilson.
Walk away? I've got three CP and a dream.

deadpool>doctor-strange.text: Nine spells in a book? I've got nine jokes. Same thing.
My spells, at least, occasionally work.

doctor-strange>deadpool.text: I've sealed away demons more polite than you.
Sure, but did they get their own deluxe box?

deadpool>loki.text: Three illusion cards and a bag of tricks? I brought a taco truck.
How fitting. A god of mischief, and a clown with lunch.

loki>deadpool.text: Which of us is the real trickster, mercenary?
You. I just lie to the audience. Different skill set.

deadpool>spider-man.text: Miles! I'm your favorite, right? Say I'm your favorite.
Uh... Peter said not to talk to you.

spider-man>deadpool.text: You're not gonna, like, stab me, right?
Only if I roll a four. Kidding! ...Unless.

deadpool>scarlet-witch.text: Wanda! Can you reality-warp me some better dice?
Careful what you ask of me.

scarlet-witch>deadpool.text: I know what it is to break reality.
Pfft. I break it every other sentence.

deadpool>thor.text: Settle something: can I lift the hammer if I roll five hammers?
HA! Many have tried, little red one! All have failed!

thor>deadpool.text: I have heard songs of thy deeds, Deadpool!
Wrote 'em myself. Every verse is about me.

deadpool>cyclops.text: Visor boy! Do you blink, or does it just go pew?
Take one more step and find out.

cyclops>deadpool.text: Wilson, you're not an X-Man. Stay out of this.
Tell that to the box. It says 'X-Men' right on it.

deadpool>gambit.text: Four aces charging up? Cute. I only need three fingers.
Gambit's cards go boom, mon ami. Yours go 'pew.'

gambit>deadpool.text: Play a hand wit' me, Wilson? Winner takes all.
Only if we roll for it. House rules, Remy.

deadpool>iceman.text: Finally, someone as funny as me! ...No wait, less.
Hey, that's cold. Even for me.

iceman>deadpool.text: Two jokers in one fight? The world's not ready.
The world's fine. The players are the ones suffering.

jean-grey>deadpool.text: Wade, please. Keep your thoughts to yourself.
You're the telepath! That one's on you.

deadpool>psylocke.text: Psychic knife to the brain? Joke's on you, it's already scrambled.

psylocke>deadpool.text: I'll slip right through your defenses, Wilson.
Great, make me reroll my defense. It was a one anyway.

deadpool>rogue.text: Absorb me! You'd get healing AND my charm!
Sugar, I'd rather catch a cold.

rogue>deadpool.text: Heard you can't die, sugar. Must get lonely.
Nah. Death keeps dumping me, but we're still friends.

deadpool>storm.text: Wind, lightning, rain... you're a whole weather app.
And you are about to be struck.

storm>deadpool.text: The storm is coming for you, Wilson.
Using MY dice for YOUR attacks? That's theft!

wolverine>deadpool.text: You know I can't. It's basically my passive ability.

deadpool>headless-horseman.text: You throw your head? I throw my dignity.
Heh heh heh! You have none left to throw!

headless-horseman>deadpool.text: Heh heh heh! I'll have YOUR head, mercenary!
Take it. It grows back. Mutant Healing, baby!

deadpool>necromancer.text: Three kinds of skeletons, and not one can hold a sword right.

necromancer>deadpool.text: Rise, my minions! Crush this clown!
Corpse Explosion? Buddy, I've BEEN that.

pale-lady>deadpool.text: Such dreadful manners, sir. And such a dreadful face.
Hey! I'm told it has character. So much character.

deadpool>raveness.text: Poe fan! Quoth the raven: 'roll better.'
The raven says nothing to fools. He only feeds.

raveness>deadpool.text: Wrong! Mutant Healing says 'evermore.' Look it up.

druid>deadpool.text: The forest doesn't like loud things.
Good thing I brought a bear. ...Wait. You brought the bear.

deadpool>duelist.text: Nice footwork! Teach me? I only know 'stumble.'
Stumbling suits scoundrels. Stand still, swine.

duelist>deadpool.text: It's RED. And ouch, the alliteration hurts more than the sword.

deadpool>forgemaster.text: Is that Ultimanium? Can I lick it?
Lick my armor, lose your tongue.

forgemaster>deadpool.text: Leather and spandex? What kind of armor is that?
Armor? Pal, I've got Mutant Healing and zero defense upgrades.

deadpool>sun-elf.text: Dusk, Dawn... you have a clock on your board? I barely have a plan.
The sun needs no plan. She simply rises.

sun-elf>deadpool.text: Step into the light, poor shadow-dweller.
Careful, I burn easy. Then I heal. Then I burn.

deadpool>santa.text: Am I on the naughty list?
Ho ho ho! Son, you ARE the naughty list.

santa>deadpool.text: Ho ho ho! What'll it be this year, Wade?
A good roll. And a pony. Mostly the pony.

deadpool>krampus.text: Broken toys in a sack? Dude, I AM a broken toy.

krampus>deadpool.text: I have a whole sack just for you.
Aw! Is it presents? Tell me it's presents.

deadpool>alchemist.text: Bottles, bubbles, explosions... you're my kind of mad scientist.
And you're my kind of test subject! You grow back!

alchemist>deadpool.text: Lady, that's the exact line from my last three deaths.

deadpool>mystic-brawler.text: Every hit I land comes back at me doubled? Who designed you, my ex?
The sea, the sky, and the mountain, friend.

mystic-brawler>deadpool.text: You speak loudly, friend. The mountains speak louder.
Do the mountains have finger guns? No? Then I win.

deadpool>jean-grey.text: Jean? Or Phoenix? Which one do I flirt with?

deadpool>pale-lady.text: Three Moon Shards and poof, werewolf? Cheapest transformation in the box.
Cheap? Allow me to show you the price—

deadpool>druid.text: Bear, cat, guy... do you ever pick a form and commit?

necromancer>moon-elf.text: Behold, elf! My army rises beneath YOUR precious moon!
The moon shines on graves too. It is not impressed.

moon-elf>necromancer.text: You need an army to face one elf?

necromancer>ninja.text: Silent assassin? My skeletons are silent too! ...STOP RATTLING!

ninja>necromancer.text: I can kill you before they stand up.
They stand up slowly because they're DRAMATIC.

necromancer>paladin.text: Your god won't save you from the grave, paladin!
He will. And He will save them from you.

paladin>necromancer.text: They're EMPLOYED. Best thing that ever happened to them.

necromancer>pyromancer.text: Tremble before my army of— why are they running?
Because bones burn so nicely! All crackly!

pyromancer>necromancer.text: Your army's already dead? That ruins all the fun!
Then I'll raise whatever's left of you. Fun for everyone!

necromancer>shadow-thief.text: Your shadows are pathetic, thief. Mine have teeth.
Mine get paid. Yours just rattle.

shadow-thief>necromancer.text: Graves are my business too. Always something shiny.
You rob graves?! That's MY thing!

necromancer>treant.text: Your roots dig through graves, old one. We have that in common.
My roots give life back, child. Yours... take it.

treant>necromancer.text: Even the dead deserve rest... child. Let them sleep.
They can sleep when the battle's over. Or never. Probably never.

necromancer>artificer.text: So are yours. Mine, at least, are built to spec.

artificer>necromancer.text: No maintenance protocol. No quality control. Amateur.
They fall apart, I put them back. THAT'S the protocol!

necromancer>cursed-pirate.text: Your cursed crew would make fine soldiers for my army!
Me crew's already cursed, mate. Get yer own dead.

necromancer>gunslinger.text: Your bullets can't kill what's already dead!
Then I'll aim for the one still breathing.

gunslinger>necromancer.text: You dig up folks' kin. Some of us bury ours proper.

necromancer>huntress.text: Your tiger will make a magnificent undead mount!
Say that again, and Nyra eats you. Slowly.

huntress>necromancer.text: Nyra keeps staring at your skeletons.
They're NOT chew toys! ...Hey! Put that femur back!

necromancer>samurai.text: Your ancestors are mine to command, samurai!
Touch them, and you will learn what shame truly is.

samurai>necromancer.text: The dead deserve dignity. Yours are missing pieces.
They're COMPLETE! ...Mostly. Has anyone seen a jaw?

necromancer>seraph.text: Kneel, angel! Death conquers even the heavens!
Death answers to Heaven. Not to a boy in a cloak.

seraph>necromancer.text: The light will cleanse your wretched army.
Good! They could use a bath.

necromancer>tactician.text: My army outnumbers yours ten to one!

tactician>necromancer.text: An army without a chain of command is a mob.
There IS a chain! I yell, and they obey me!

necromancer>vampire-lord.text: Undead to undead, you should really join my army.
Darling, I don't join. I own.

vampire-lord>necromancer.text: Such a pity. Your minions have no blood at all.
I KNOW! You think I'm not aware of their shortcomings?!

necromancer>black-panther.text: Even kings bow to death, Panther!
In Wakanda, the ancestors are honored. Not enslaved.

black-panther>necromancer.text: A king leads the living. Whom do you lead?
Anyone who stops breathing. It's a growing kingdom!

necromancer>black-widow.text: One spy against an army of the dead?
I've faced worse. They were alive, too.

black-widow>necromancer.text: Nice army. Can any of them actually do anything?
They can... stand. Most of the time.

necromancer>captain-marvel.text: Come down and face my legion, flygirl!
Your legion can't reach higher than my boots.

captain-marvel>necromancer.text: I could blast all of them in one shot.
Please don't. Do you know how long a skeleton takes to assemble?

necromancer>doctor-strange.text: A fellow master of the dark arts! Finally, a peer!
Peer? I'm the Sorcerer Supreme. You're a hobbyist.

doctor-strange>necromancer.text: Necromancy. The most desperate of the mystic arts.

necromancer>loki.text: A trickster? My army is no trick!
No. Tricks are supposed to impress.

loki>necromancer.text: A little lord of bones. How adorable.

necromancer>spider-man.text: Kneel, boy! Or join my undead army!
Is there a third option? I'd like the third option.

spider-man>necromancer.text: Okay. Skeletons. Totally normal. I'm fine. Totally fine.

necromancer>scarlet-witch.text: We both know how to bring back what's lost.
No. We both know it never comes back right.

scarlet-witch>necromancer.text: Your army is made of stolen souls.

cursed-pirate>necromancer.text: Ye want dead, lad? I'll show ye dead—

necromancer>thor.text: Your fallen warriors don't reach Valhalla anymore. They reach ME!
THOU STEALEST ODIN'S HONORED DEAD?! Now I am truly wroth!

thor>necromancer.text: Hear me, sorcerer! Thy army shall crumble beneath Mjolnir!
Crumble, then rise again. That's rather the point.

necromancer>cyclops.text: Take off the visor! Let's see if your eyes frighten my army!
You really don't want me to do that.

necromancer>gambit.text: Charged cards? Pfft. I charge my skeletons with DEATH!
An' Gambit charges his wit' style, mon ami.

gambit>necromancer.text: Four aces, sorcerer. What you got?

necromancer>iceman.text: Tremble, ice boy! My army feels no cold!
Great. Then they won't mind being skeleton popsicles.

iceman>necromancer.text: Whoa. Your guys are really... bare-boned.
Was that a PUN? In the middle of my entrance?

jean-grey>necromancer.text: I can feel their minds... there's nothing left in them.
That's what makes them such good listeners!

necromancer>psylocke.text: Go on, ninja, read my skeletons' minds!

psylocke>necromancer.text: Your minions move like drunk puppets.
They're puppets of DEATH. Show some respect!

necromancer>rogue.text: Your touch drains the living! Mine commands the dead!
Then I reckon we won't be holdin' hands, sugar.

rogue>necromancer.text: Wonder what I'd get touchin' one of those bone boys.

necromancer>storm.text: Summon your storms! My army fears no weather!
Your army cannot even stand in the wind.

storm>necromancer.text: My lightning will scatter your bones across the plain.
Fine! I'll rebuild them. I ALWAYS rebuild them.

necromancer>wolverine.text: Metal bones! You'd be my finest skeleton!
Get in line, bub. Lotta people wanted 'em.

wolverine>necromancer.text: Your boys smell worse than me, bub.

necromancer>headless-horseman.text: A headless horseman! Join my army, my headless friend!
Heh heh heh! I join no one! But I'll lend you a head!

headless-horseman>necromancer.text: Heh heh heh! Your skeletons still have heads. How dull!
I can take them off if it makes you feel better!

necromancer>pale-lady.text: A werewolf's skeleton! Oh, I want it SO badly!
How dreadfully forward. Do keep wanting.

necromancer>raveness.text: A fellow child of darkness! Shall we rule the night together?

raveness>necromancer.text: Nevermore feeds on life, sorcerer. Your army has none to give.
So he's USELESS against me! Ha! ...Right?

necromancer>druid.text: Become any beast you like! I'll raise its skeleton after!
Then I'll pick one you can't handle alive.

druid>necromancer.text: Nature takes the dead back. You're stealing from her.
Nature had her turn! Now it's MY turn!

necromancer>duelist.text: Your fancy footwork means nothing to my mindless horde!

duelist>necromancer.text: Such sloppy soldiers, sorcerer. Simply shameful.
At least they don't TALK like that.

necromancer>forgemaster.text: Your armor would fit my Bone Golem perfectly!
Your golem couldn't afford the rivets.

forgemaster>necromancer.text: A golem of bone? Should've been iron, boy.
Iron costs money! Bones are FREE!

necromancer>sun-elf.text: Even the sun sets, elf! And then my army rises!
And every dawn, she finds your graves again.

sun-elf>necromancer.text: Poor thing. You've never stood in the sun, have you?
I tried once. Burned instantly. Never again.

necromancer>santa.text: Santa! I've been VERY evil this year!
Ho ho ho! I know, son. I brought coal. And fists.

santa>necromancer.text: Ho ho ho! My elves work for cookies. What do yours work for?

necromancer>krampus.text: Krampus! Finally, a monster who understands me!
The sack is for naughty children. You qualify.

krampus>necromancer.text: Stolen corpses, broken graves... I remember all of it.
Great! Keep a list! I want credit for every one!

necromancer>alchemist.text: Brew me a potion that makes skeletons obedient!
Ooh! Can I test it on YOU first?

alchemist>necromancer.text: My acids dissolve anything. Even bone!
Go ahead. Bones are the one thing I never run out of.

necromancer>mystic-brawler.text: Your sea and sky won't save you from the grave!
Save me? Friend, they're cheering for me.

mystic-brawler>necromancer.text: The ocean swallows the dead, little one. It won't give them to you.
Then I'll raise an army of skeleton FISH!

necromancer>jean-grey.text: Your Phoenix rises from death. Just like my army!

pale-lady>necromancer.text: Your minions are so noisy. Allow me to quiet them—
Stop eating them! They're not snacks!

pale-lady>moon-elf.text: The moon raised me, dear. You merely borrow her light.
She raised you to howl. She raised me to dance.

moon-elf>pale-lady.text: I dance beneath the full moon. You merely change beneath it.

pale-lady>ninja.text: Hiding in the shadows, dear? I can smell you from here.
Then you smell the poison too.

ninja>pale-lady.text: Only my appetite, dear. Nothing to fear. Yet.

pale-lady>paladin.text: Such heavy armor, sir. Like a tin of supper.
Many have tried to open it. Faith keeps it shut.

paladin>pale-lady.text: The light can still save you, my lady.
How sweet of you, sir. But I do so prefer moonlight.

pale-lady>pyromancer.text: What a cheerful little arsonist. Do you ever stop smiling?
Only when things stop burning! So, never!

pyromancer>pale-lady.text: Ooh, a wolf lady! Fur burns SO nicely!
Ahem. Do forgive me, dear. I'm rather fond of my coat.

pale-lady>shadow-thief.text: Do keep your hands where I can see them, dear.
Sure. You keep your teeth where I can see them.

shadow-thief>pale-lady.text: Not for sale, darling. Your throat, however, is on the menu.

pale-lady>treant.text: Such an old tree. Wolves have marked you for centuries, I imagine.
Many wolves... child. I outlived them all.

treant>pale-lady.text: Two creatures in one skin, child. Both hungry.

pale-lady>artificer.text: Your machines have no scent. How dreadfully dull to hunt.
An oversight. I'll add one. Something that repels dogs.

artificer>pale-lady.text: Unstable biology, zero upgrade path. A deeply flawed design.
I need no upgrades, sir. I simply become something worse.

pale-lady>cursed-pirate.text: Captain, how lovely. Shall we both drop the act—
Ha! Ye call that frightful, lass? Watch—

cursed-pirate>pale-lady.text: A wolf lady, eh? I'm cursed meself, lass—
Oh, how darling. I simply adore bones—

pale-lady>gunslinger.text: Didn't bring any. Figured lead would do.

gunslinger>pale-lady.text: There's a bounty on werewolves out west.
How flattering. Tell me, how many hunters collected it?

pale-lady>huntress.text: What a lovely kitten. Does she know what I become?
She knows. She's been growling since you arrived.

pale-lady>samurai.text: Such rigid manners, sir. Nearly as good as mine.
Yours are a mask. I see the teeth behind them.

samurai>pale-lady.text: You hide a beast beneath silk. There is no honor in deceit.
Hide? Sir, I simply wait for the proper moment.

pale-lady>seraph.text: Such blinding light, madam. Wolves prefer the moon.
Then pray for night. You will not see another.

seraph>pale-lady.text: Abomination? I'm a lady, madam. The abomination arrives later.

pale-lady>tactician.text: You've planned for the lady, sir. Have you planned for the wolf?
I planned for the moon, madam. I know exactly when it rises.

tactician>pale-lady.text: On my maps, your kind is marked "here be monsters."
How accurate. On mine, you're marked "prey."

pale-lady>vampire-lord.text: A vampire. How quaint. Do you still sleep in a box?
A coffin, darling. Something a dog wouldn't appreciate.

vampire-lord>pale-lady.text: Such lovely blood. Pity it smells of wet dog.
And yours of dust, darling. Let me shake it out—

pale-lady>black-panther.text: A king who dresses as a cat. How charming, Your Majesty.
And a lady who hides a wolf. We all wear something.

black-panther>pale-lady.text: Strike me, and I only grow stronger.
Then I'll skip the striking, Your Majesty. Straight to shredding.

pale-lady>black-widow.text: A spider. I do hate stepping on them. The sound.
Funny. I was thinking the same about dogs.

black-widow>pale-lady.text: Nice act. I know a cover identity when I see one.
No cover, dear. We're both quite real.

pale-lady>captain-marvel.text: You glow like the moon, dear. Do hold still while I admire you.
I don't do still. Catch me first.

captain-marvel>pale-lady.text: Big bad wolf? I've punched bigger.
Oh, I don't doubt it, dear. They just didn't bite back.

pale-lady>doctor-strange.text: A doctor! Do you make house calls on full moons?
Only for patients who don't bite.

doctor-strange>pale-lady.text: Lycanthropy. I have a spell for that.
How thoughtful, Doctor. I have teeth for you.

pale-lady>loki.text: Which one of you is real, sir? I'll simply sniff them all.
Sniff away. Every one of me smells divine.

loki>pale-lady.text: Two faces in one body? Madam, you're practically family.
Unlike you, sir, I show both of mine honestly.

pale-lady>spider-man.text: Such a sweet young man. Do run home before the moon rises.
Okay, was that a threat? That totally sounded like a threat.

spider-man>pale-lady.text: Nice lady, nice lady... please stay a nice lady.

pale-lady>scarlet-witch.text: You look so very sad, dear. Grief makes one so tender.

scarlet-witch>pale-lady.text: I could make you human. Forever.
How cruel, dear. Why would I ever want that?

pale-lady>thor.text: Such a loud, cheerful god. Do you ever stop feasting?
Never! And thou art invited, wolf-lady!

thor>pale-lady.text: A wolf! Asgard has wolves too! Mighty ones!
How nice, dear. Were they this mighty—

pale-lady>cyclops.text: Such a serious young man. Do you ever take off those glasses?
They're for your protection. Not mine.

cyclops>pale-lady.text: I've studied your transformation. You're vulnerable before the change.
And after, dear, you'll be the vulnerable one.

pale-lady>gambit.text: Such charm, Mr. LeBeau. Does it work on wolves?
Gambit's charm works on everybody, chère. Even de ones wit' teeth.

gambit>pale-lady.text: Care for a dance, chère? Gambit leads.
How gallant. Mind my claws, dear. I step on toes.

pale-lady>iceman.text: A frozen young man. Do you ever feel anything, dear?
Chills, mostly. You're giving me a lot of them.

iceman>pale-lady.text: A werewolf, huh? Guess you're having a ruff day.
How dreadful, dear. For that, I'll bite twice.

pale-lady>jean-grey.text: We both keep something wild inside, dear. Shall we—

jean-grey>pale-lady.text: I can feel your hunger. It's so loud—
Small, dear? Allow me to correct you—

pale-lady>psylocke.text: Reading my mind, dear? Do mind the mess.
It's not a mess. It's a cage. And it's open.

psylocke>pale-lady.text: Your thoughts are quiet. Your hunger is not.
Do forgive me, dear. I skipped luncheon.

pale-lady>rogue.text: Such long gloves, dear. Afraid of a little touch?
Honey, one touch and I'd be the one growlin'.

rogue>pale-lady.text: Wonder what I'd get if I touched you, sugar.
An appetite, dear. You'd never feel full again.

pale-lady>storm.text: Would you clear the clouds, dear? I do need the moon.
The sky answers to me. Not to you.

storm>pale-lady.text: Howl all you like. My thunder is louder.
Oh, I don't howl for attention, dear. I howl for supper.

pale-lady>wolverine.text: Such claws, sir. And such dreadful grooming.
Look who's talkin', lady. You shed.

wolverine>pale-lady.text: I can smell the wolf on ya, lady.
And I can smell the whiskey on you, dear. Charming.

pale-lady>headless-horseman.text: A gentleman without a head. How can I tell if you're smiling?
Heh heh heh! I'm always smiling, my lady! It's carved!

headless-horseman>pale-lady.text: Heh heh heh! Do werewolves fetch? CATCH!

pale-lady>raveness.text: Your bird keeps staring at me, dear.

raveness>pale-lady.text: Nevermore shall the moon be full for you.
Oh, dear, it always is. Eventually.

pale-lady>druid.text: A fellow shapeshifter! Shall we compare—

druid>pale-lady.text: A kitten? Oh, you darling thing—

pale-lady>duelist.text: You dance so beautifully, sir. May I cut in?
Delighted, dear lady. Do dance delicately.

duelist>pale-lady.text: A lovely lady, a lurking beast... what a wicked waltz.
Then do keep time, sir. I lead on the full moon.

pale-lady>forgemaster.text: So much armor, dear. Is anything soft underneath?
Nothing your teeth can reach, lass. I made sure.

forgemaster>pale-lady.text: No blade, no shield, no armor? What do you fight with, lass?
I never travel without my cutlery, dear—

pale-lady>sun-elf.text: Such a lovely glow, dear. But I do prefer the night.
Every night ends, dear. Every single one.

sun-elf>pale-lady.text: She will burn the beast out of you, poor thing.
Do tell her not to bother, dear. We get along splendidly.

pale-lady>santa.text: Such a jolly man, and so many plump reindeer. How thoughtful.
Ho ho ho! They're not for you, missy!

santa>pale-lady.text: Ho ho ho! Have you been a good girl this year?

pale-lady>krampus.text: Such lovely horns, sir. They'd look wonderful on my wall.
Funny. I have a spot on mine for a wolf pelt.

krampus>pale-lady.text: I remember every villager you ate last winter.
Only the rude ones, dear. I do have standards.

pale-lady>alchemist.text: What do you keep in all those bottles, dear?
Oh, lots! Want to guess which one turns you back?

alchemist>pale-lady.text: Hold still! I want to see what happens if I cure you!
Nothing good, dear. For either of us.

pale-lady>mystic-brawler.text: What a big, cheerful man. Tell me, do legends taste better?
Much better! But I'm not on the menu, sister!

mystic-brawler>pale-lady.text: A wolf-woman! My people tell legends about you!
How flattering, dear. Do they end well?

moon-elf>ninja.text: You hide in shadows, little assassin. I was born in them.
Then you won't see me coming.

ninja>moon-elf.text: You will not hear the one that finds you.

moon-elf>paladin.text: All that armor, and still I will find the gaps.

paladin>moon-elf.text: Come into the light, and face me honestly.
Honesty is for those who cannot hide.

moon-elf>pyromancer.text: Put out that fire. You are ruining the night.
Aww, but the night's so boring when nothing's burning!

pyromancer>moon-elf.text: Ooh, pointy ears! Do elves burn slower or faster?
You will never be close enough to learn.

moon-elf>shadow-thief.text: Your shadows are borrowed, thief. Mine were given freely.
Borrowed, stolen... I don't see the difference.

shadow-thief>moon-elf.text: Hold still. That moonstone would look better in my pocket.
Reach for it. See how many fingers return.

moon-elf>treant.text: Old one, the moon has watched you grow for centuries.
And I... have watched her wane, child. Many times.

treant>moon-elf.text: You never stay in one place, child. Always slipping away.
Like the moon, old one. She never stays either.

moon-elf>artificer.text: Your machines cannot see in the dark, tinker.
Correction. They see in eleven spectrums. So hiding is pointless.

artificer>moon-elf.text: Evasion rate, unacceptably high. I'll need a wider targeting cone.
Build it wider. I will still be elsewhere.

moon-elf>cursed-pirate.text: The moon pulls the tides, pirate. She pulls your curse too.
Aye, and she's welcome to it, lass—

cursed-pirate>moon-elf.text: Ye sail by the moon too, elf?
Then you know she never waits for anyone.

moon-elf>gunslinger.text: Bullets are so crude. An arrow is a song.
Mine's a short song. One note.

gunslinger>moon-elf.text: Hold still, elf. I only need the one shot.
Then make it count. You won't get another.

moon-elf>huntress.text: Your cat hunts by moonlight too. She has good taste.
She likes you. She thinks you'd be easy to catch.

huntress>moon-elf.text: Nyra can smell you through the shadows.
Let her sniff. By the time she finds me, I am gone.

moon-elf>samurai.text: So stiff, so solemn. Do you ever dance, samurai?
I do not dance. I strike once.

samurai>moon-elf.text: You fight from afar. There is no honor in that.
There is no dying in it either. I prefer that.

moon-elf>seraph.text: The light does not dim for the likes of you.

seraph>moon-elf.text: The night kneels to no one.

moon-elf>tactician.text: Plan all you like, general. I will not be where you planned.
Then I've planned for where you'll run.

tactician>moon-elf.text: Archers belong on high ground. You're on my hill.
Then come and take it back. Mind the arrows.

moon-elf>vampire-lord.text: Another creature of the night. Try not to steal my darkness.
Steal? Darling, I was here long before you.

vampire-lord>moon-elf.text: Your blood must taste of moonlight.
Moonlight cannot be caught, vampire. Only admired.

moon-elf>black-panther.text: A cat who hunts at night. We are not so different.
I hunt for my people. Whom do you hunt for?

black-panther>moon-elf.text: In Wakanda, the night belongs to Bast.
Then your goddess and I will have to share it.

moon-elf>black-widow.text: You wear shadows well, spy. For a human.
I don't wear them. I work in them.

black-widow>moon-elf.text: Nice disappearing act. I've seen better in Budapest.
Then you saw nothing. That is the point.

moon-elf>captain-marvel.text: You burn like a falling star. They never last.
Neither do elves who stand in my way.

captain-marvel>moon-elf.text: Hide all you want. I can light up the whole sky.

moon-elf>doctor-strange.text: A sorcerer who hides in mirrors. How very elven of you.
The Mirror Dimension isn't hiding. It's strategy.

doctor-strange>moon-elf.text: I've seen every future. You dodge in none of them.
Then you have been watching the wrong futures, sorcerer.

moon-elf>loki.text: So many of you, and all of them so loud.
And yet you still can't tell which one is real.

loki>moon-elf.text: An elf of illusions? We really must compare notes.
I do not deceive, trickster. I simply am not there.

moon-elf>spider-man.text: You vanish well, little spider. For a beginner.
Thanks! Wait, was that a compliment? Feels like no.

spider-man>moon-elf.text: Okay, I can't see you, you can't see me. Stalemate?
I see you perfectly. Your breathing gives you away.

moon-elf>scarlet-witch.text: You rewrite the world. I only slip through its cracks.

scarlet-witch>moon-elf.text: I could make the moon disappear.
Many have tried. She always returns.

moon-elf>thor.text: So much thunder. Do you ever arrive quietly?
Never! Where is the glory in a quiet entrance?

thor>moon-elf.text: Stand and fight, elf! Cease this dancing about!
Swing that hammer a little faster. Perhaps you will hit something.

moon-elf>cyclops.text: You see so much through that visor. Can you see in the dark?
I don't need to. I just need to see you once.

cyclops>moon-elf.text: I've mapped every angle. There's nowhere left to hide.
Maps are drawn by daylight, soldier.

moon-elf>gambit.text: You gamble with fire, card player. I prefer certainty.
Ain't no fun in certainty, chère. Ask any moon.

gambit>moon-elf.text: A lady who dances in moonlight. Gambit likes dat.
Then watch closely. You will not see it twice.

moon-elf>iceman.text: You leave a trail of frost wherever you go. How easy to follow.
Hey, it's not a trail. It's a signature. Ice-thetic.

iceman>moon-elf.text: Moon Elf, huh? Bet you're a real... night-owl.
I would laugh, but it might wake the owls.

moon-elf>jean-grey.text: There is a fire in you that does not belong to the night.
Then help me keep her in the dark—

jean-grey>moon-elf.text: I can't find your thoughts. They keep slipping away.

moon-elf>psylocke.text: You strike from the mind, I strike from the dark. Shall we see?
The mind is darker than you think.

psylocke>moon-elf.text: You can hide your body. Not your thoughts.
You are welcome to them. They are mostly about you missing.

moon-elf>rogue.text: Such long gloves. Even your touch must hide.
Not hidin', sugar. Just bein' polite.

rogue>moon-elf.text: C'mere, elf. Just a little touch.
First, you would have to catch me.

moon-elf>storm.text: Your clouds hide my moon. Move them.
The sky answers to one queen. And it is not you.

storm>moon-elf.text: You dance beneath my sky, little elf.
Your sky, perhaps. But the night is mine.

moon-elf>wolverine.text: All those claws, and you still cannot catch a shadow.
Don't need to catch it, bub. Just gotta smell it.

wolverine>moon-elf.text: I can smell ya, elf. Hidin' won't help.
Then follow your nose. I am already behind you.

moon-elf>headless-horseman.text: A rider with no head. Do you see by moonlight too?
Heh heh heh! I see by candlelight, elf! It's carved!

headless-horseman>moon-elf.text: Heh heh heh! Lose your head, little elf!

moon-elf>raveness.text: You grieve beneath my moon, witch. She does not mind.
She is the only one who ever listens.

raveness>moon-elf.text: Nevermore sees you, elf. Even in the dark.
Then he is the first. I am almost flattered.

moon-elf>druid.text: Bear, cat, man... which one will I be hunting tonight?

druid>moon-elf.text: My eyes can't find you. My nose can—
Such a big nose. Such a slow bear.

moon-elf>duelist.text: You dance with a blade. I dance without being touched.
Delightful! A dance duel, darling. Do dazzle me.

duelist>moon-elf.text: Such swift steps, sweet shadow. Shall we share a waltz?
Only if you can keep up.

moon-elf>forgemaster.text: So much heavy metal. Can you even run in that?
Don't need to run, lass. My armor does the waitin'.

forgemaster>moon-elf.text: A bow? Wood and string? Pitiful. I'd forge you a real one.
Keep your iron. My arrows sing better.

moon-elf>sun-elf.text: Still worshipping your sun? She leaves you every evening.
And returns every morning. Yours hides half the month, poor thing.

sun-elf>moon-elf.text: Come into the light, sister. She will forgive you.
Forgive me? Your sun cannot even look at me.

moon-elf>santa.text: You travel by night too, old man. We have that in common.
Ho ho ho! But I bring presents. You bring arrows.

santa>moon-elf.text: Ho ho ho! Are you one of my elves?
I do not make toys, old man. I make holes in them.

moon-elf>krampus.text: You hunt in winter darkness. So do I.
Yes. But I always catch mine.

krampus>moon-elf.text: You were very naughty this year, elf.
Then come and catch me. If you can.

moon-elf>alchemist.text: What do you keep in all those bottles?
Nothing that stays in the bottle for long!

alchemist>moon-elf.text: Hold still! I want to see if elves dissolve!
You would have to hit me first, little chemist.

moon-elf>mystic-brawler.text: You are so large. So very easy to hit.
Hit me all you want, little sister! I hit back harder!

mystic-brawler>moon-elf.text: My people sing songs to your moon, little sister!
She has heard them. She says you sing off-key.

sun-elf>ninja.text: You hide from the light, little one. What are you ashamed of?
Nothing. I just don't need you to see me.

ninja>sun-elf.text: Only the guilty wish to hide.

sun-elf>paladin.text: You serve the light too, knight. Which god lends you yours?
Mine asks for faith. Yours only asks for sunburn.

paladin>sun-elf.text: We both walk in the light, elf. Must we fight?
You walk in it, knight. You have never truly worshipped it.

sun-elf>pyromancer.text: You burn like a little sun. It is almost beautiful.
Almost? Oh, give me a minute. It gets SO much better!

pyromancer>sun-elf.text: Your goddess is the biggest fire EVER! I'm her number one fan!
Finally, a true believer. A terrifying one, but a believer.

sun-elf>shadow-thief.text: Poor thing. You live your whole life in the shade.
Shade's where the good stuff gets left unattended.

shadow-thief>sun-elf.text: That sun pendant's real gold, isn't it?
It is blessed. Touch it and learn how blessed.

sun-elf>treant.text: Old one, the sun has fed you for centuries. Surely you are grateful.
I stood here... before your prayers, child. She never needed them.

treant>sun-elf.text: Even the sun... burns the forest, child.
Only what must fall, old one. So something new can grow.

sun-elf>artificer.text: Your machines will never feel the warmth of dawn.
Correct. That is why they never dawdle.

artificer>sun-elf.text: Your output rises over time. Fascinating. I'll simply end this early.
Many have tried to rush the dawn. None succeeded.

sun-elf>cursed-pirate.text: Come into the light, pirate. It may lift your curse.
Careful, lass. The sun shows me true face—

cursed-pirate>sun-elf.text: Sun's hard on sailors, elf. We curse it every day.
And yet she rises for you anyway. Such grace.

sun-elf>gunslinger.text: Revenge is a cold thing. Let the sun warm you.
Sun's never warmed a grave, elf.

gunslinger>sun-elf.text: High noon, elf. My favorite hour.
Mine too. It is when she is strongest.

sun-elf>huntress.text: Your cat basks in the sun. She is wiser than you.
She's not basking. She's waiting for you to get sleepy.

huntress>sun-elf.text: Then she hunts in my goddess's light. She should be grateful.

sun-elf>samurai.text: Your land is named for the rising sun. Do you honor her?
I honor my ancestors. The sun only watches.

samurai>sun-elf.text: Your light is pride. Pride has no honor.
Not pride. Devotion. You would not understand the difference.

sun-elf>seraph.text: Your light is borrowed from heaven. Mine rises on its own.
Heaven lit your sun, elf. Kneel to its maker.

seraph>sun-elf.text: Two lights cannot share one sky.
How fortunate, then, that the sky belongs to her.

sun-elf>tactician.text: You plan for the battle, general. I simply wait for the dawn.
Then I'll finish this before breakfast.

tactician>sun-elf.text: From my hill, you glow like a target.
Then you have been staring at the sun, general. Mind your eyes.

sun-elf>vampire-lord.text: Poor creature. When did you last see the morning?
Centuries ago, darling. I haven't missed it.

vampire-lord>sun-elf.text: Such warm blood. I do love a sunny disposition.
Then stay until sunrise. You will glow too. Briefly.

sun-elf>black-panther.text: A king in black, beneath a golden sun. You should wear gold.
Vibranium, not gold. It shines when it matters.

black-panther>sun-elf.text: In Wakanda, we honor the ancestors. Whom do you honor?
The one who rises over your land every morning, king.

sun-elf>black-widow.text: So many lies, spy. Step into the light and be cleansed.
Light's overrated. It shows your face to people who want it.

black-widow>sun-elf.text: You'd make a terrible spy. You literally glow.
I was not made to hide. I was made to be seen.

sun-elf>captain-marvel.text: You glow like a star. Whom do you pray to?
Nobody. I'm the one people pray to.

captain-marvel>sun-elf.text: I've flown closer to suns than you ever will.
Then you stood in her presence. And learned nothing.

sun-elf>doctor-strange.text: You bend time, sorcerer. Can you make the dawn come faster?
I could. But I'd rather watch you wait.

doctor-strange>sun-elf.text: I've seen your dawn millions of times. It's predictable.
And she was beautiful every single time, was she not?

sun-elf>loki.text: Stand in the sun, trickster. Illusions cast no shadow.
Mine do. I made sure of it.

loki>sun-elf.text: A sun worshipper? How quaint. I prefer gods who talk back.
She need not talk. She will outlast every god. Even you.

sun-elf>spider-man.text: Why hide your face, child? The sun wants to see you.
Uh, secret identity? Also, sunscreen is a thing.

spider-man>sun-elf.text: Is it just me, or is it super bright over here?
It is not you. It is her. Isn't she wonderful?

sun-elf>scarlet-witch.text: Your magic is chaos, witch. Hers is order. She rises on time.
Order is just chaos I haven't touched yet.

scarlet-witch>sun-elf.text: One word from me, and your sun rises in the west.
Then she still rises. That is all that matters.

sun-elf>thor.text: A god of thunder. Do your storms ever let the sun through?
Aye! After every storm, the sun shines brighter! Like my victories!

thor>sun-elf.text: Thy glow is splendid, elf! Like the golden halls of Asgard!
Your golden halls are lit from outside, Thunderer. By her.

sun-elf>cyclops.text: You hide your eyes behind red glass. Do you fear the light?
I don't fear it. I control it.

cyclops>sun-elf.text: Your light is predictable. It rises, it peaks, it sets.
And every day, it returns. Can your plans say the same?

sun-elf>gambit.text: You play with charged light, card player. Crude, but promising.
Crude? Chère, Gambit got more flash than your sunrise.

gambit>sun-elf.text: Sunlight on Gambit's cards, chère. Makes 'em glow even brighter.
Then even your cards know whom to worship.

sun-elf>iceman.text: A boy made of ice. Stand still, child. This will only take a moment.
Whoa, whoa. Is it me, or is it getting drippy in here?

iceman>sun-elf.text: Relax, Sunny. I've got plenty of ice to go around.
And she has all day to melt it.

sun-elf>jean-grey.text: The fire within you burns like a sun. Let it shine.

jean-grey>sun-elf.text: Your light is so warm. She wants to consume it—

sun-elf>psylocke.text: You fight in darkness, blade. Does it never tire you?
Darkness never tires. Only you do.

psylocke>sun-elf.text: Your mind is so bright. And so easy to read.
Read every word. I have nothing to hide.

sun-elf>rogue.text: Why cover your skin, child? The sun would love to touch it.
Sugar, nobody gets to touch it. Not even her.

rogue>sun-elf.text: Wonder what I'd get from touchin' you. A tan?
More than you could hold, child.

sun-elf>storm.text: Your clouds hide her light. Part them, queen.
Even the sun waits for my permission.

storm>sun-elf.text: I command the sky, elf. Sunlight included.
You command the clouds. She simply waits above them.

sun-elf>wolverine.text: So much anger, wanderer. A little warmth would do you good.
Tried warmth once, bub. Didn't take.

wolverine>sun-elf.text: Too damn bright. Tone it down.
She dims for no one. Least of all a grumbling wanderer.

sun-elf>headless-horseman.text: A lantern for a head. How sad, a light so small.
Heh heh heh! Small? It's burned for centuries, elf!

headless-horseman>sun-elf.text: Heh heh heh! My lantern fears no sun!
It is a candle in a pumpkin. It should fear a breeze.

sun-elf>raveness.text: Such a sad, dark little witch. When did you last smile?

raveness>sun-elf.text: Poor bird. Bring him into the sun. He will learn to love it.

sun-elf>druid.text: Every leaf in your forest turns toward the sun, druid.
The forest needs night too. That's when it rests—

druid>sun-elf.text: Seeds need the sun. Roots need the dark. You only see half.
The half that matters, druid. Nothing blooms in the dark.

sun-elf>duelist.text: You dance so gracefully, sir. In her light, you almost shine.
Almost? A dazzling duelist deserves a better description, darling.

duelist>sun-elf.text: Such splendid shine, sweet sun-sister. Shall we spar?
Gladly. The longer we dance, the brighter I become.

sun-elf>forgemaster.text: Your forge burns hot, smith. A pale imitation of her.
Imitation? Her light never shaped a single blade, lass.

forgemaster>sun-elf.text: Cloth and glitter? Where's your armor, lass?
She is my armor. Try to strike through her.

sun-elf>santa.text: You bring joy in the darkest season, old man. She approves.
Ho ho ho! Well, somebody has to while she's on vacation!

santa>sun-elf.text: Ho ho ho! You'd look lovely on top of my tree!
I am not a decoration, old man. I am a blessing.

sun-elf>krampus.text: A creature of winter nights. How long since you felt warmth?
Since the last child cried in my sack.

krampus>sun-elf.text: Winter nights are long, elf. Your sun hides for weeks.
And still she returns each spring. Your winters never win.

sun-elf>alchemist.text: So many colors in your bottles. None as bright as her.
Oh really? Try THIS one! ...Okay, maybe don't look directly at it.

alchemist>sun-elf.text: Stand still! I want to know what makes you glow!
Faith, little chemist. You will not find it in a bottle.

sun-elf>mystic-brawler.text: The sun shines on your islands too, brother. You are blessed.
Blessed? Sister, the sun comes out just to watch ME!

mystic-brawler>sun-elf.text: The sky is one of my powers, little sister!
The sky is only her stage, brother.

ninja>paladin.text: An honest man need not move in silence.

paladin>ninja.text: Strike from the shadows, and you strike without honor.

ninja>pyromancer.text: Fire makes smoke. Smoke hides me.
Ooh, teamwork! I burn, you hide, then I burn you!

pyromancer>ninja.text: You're all wrapped up in cloth! Like kindling!

ninja>shadow-thief.text: Sloppy? It's handmade. My sister would be insulted.

shadow-thief>ninja.text: Two poisoners, one fight. Wanna split the take?

ninja>treant.text: Wait, child? I have waited... since the first rain.

treant>ninja.text: You move... like wind through leaves, child. Silent. Brief.

ninja>artificer.text: Correct. They don't breathe. You chose the wrong opponent.

artificer>ninja.text: No sensors, no armor, no redundancy. An obsolete design.

ninja>cursed-pirate.text: Aye, cursed gold always sings, lass—

cursed-pirate>ninja.text: Poison, eh? Can't poison what's already dead, lass.

ninja>gunslinger.text: Every bullet brings me closer. You're just in the way.

gunslinger>ninja.text: I've buried plenty of folks who tried sneakin' up on me.

ninja>huntress.text: Always. You're small, but she isn't picky.

ninja>samurai.text: And you would strike during it. There is no honor in you.

samurai>ninja.text: Face me openly, shinobi. Blade to blade.

ninja>seraph.text: You will not live to find out.

seraph>ninja.text: There is no shadow my light cannot reach.
Then why haven't you found me?

ninja>tactician.text: Cut off the head. The army falls.
Which is why the head stays on the hill.

tactician>ninja.text: One lone piece against my whole board?
One piece is enough to take a king.

ninja>vampire-lord.text: Try, darling. I'll wash it down with you.

vampire-lord>ninja.text: Such a hidden little throat. Do show it to me.

ninja>black-panther.text: A king. Where are your guards?
A king of Wakanda needs none against one blade.

black-panther>ninja.text: In Wakanda, we too know how to move unseen.

ninja>black-widow.text: Assassin. Let's skip the part where we pretend we're different.

black-widow>ninja.text: The Red Room taught me poisons. Yours is amateur work.

captain-marvel>ninja.text: I'm faster than anything you can throw.

ninja>doctor-strange.text: Precise, not slow. You wouldn't know the difference.

doctor-strange>ninja.text: I've seen fourteen million futures. You're in none of them.

ninja>loki.text: The real one. Do enjoy looking for him.

loki>ninja.text: Hiding in plain sight? I've done that for centuries.

ninja>spider-man.text: What? No! I'm invisible! ...Am I not invisible?

spider-man>ninja.text: Okay, you vanish, I vanish... we're just two empty spots, right?

ninja>scarlet-witch.text: Magic needs hands. I'll take the hands.
Reality doesn't need my hands. Only my will.

scarlet-witch>ninja.text: I could erase every shadow you hide in.

ninja>thor.text: Of course! What warrior hides his name? I am THOR!

thor>ninja.text: Show thyself, shadow-warrior! We shall feast after!

ninja>cyclops.text: Which is why I planned for that too.

cyclops>ninja.text: Stay where I can see you.

ninja>gambit.text: Easier to find in de dark, chère. Unlike you.

gambit>ninja.text: Gambit bets you never even get close, chère.

ninja>iceman.text: Everything freezes. That's kind of my whole deal.

iceman>ninja.text: Why so cold? That's MY job! Cold? Because I'm... made of ice?
And you wonder why someone sent me.

ninja>jean-grey.text: Not this one. Please, don't test her—

jean-grey>ninja.text: I can hear you thinking. You're counting my steps.

ninja>psylocke.text: You know my name. I know your next move.

psylocke>ninja.text: Two blades in the dark. Only one walks out.

ninja>rogue.text: Guess we both oughta keep our hands to ourselves, sugar.

rogue>ninja.text: One touch, sugar, and I'll know every trick you've got.

storm>ninja.text: The wind carries every whisper to me.

ninja>wolverine.text: Been poisoned before, darlin'. Worst it did was ruin my beer.

ninja>headless-horseman.text: Heh heh heh! It always lands on its feet! ...Well. Its face.

headless-horseman>ninja.text: Heh heh heh! Are you afraid of the dark, ninja?

ninja>raveness.text: He watches all who will soon be still.

raveness>ninja.text: Nevermore shall you speak. Silent as a grave.

druid>ninja.text: You can't hide from a cat's eyes—

ninja>duelist.text: Fencing is a conversation, my furtive, faceless foe.

duelist>ninja.text: Step forward, shadowy shinobi! Show some style!

ninja>forgemaster.text: Aye. So's the hammer inside it.

forgemaster>ninja.text: Little knives and throwing stars? I've got nails bigger than that, lass.

ninja>santa.text: Ho ho ho! Loud? I've never woken a single child!

santa>ninja.text: Ho ho ho! What do you want for Christmas, little one?

krampus>ninja.text: Silent little shadow. My sack has no light at all.

ninja>alchemist.text: The best ones! Show me yours and I'll show you mine!

alchemist>ninja.text: What's in your poison? Nightshade? Tell me it's nightshade!

ninja>mystic-brawler.text: The biggest! And every hit comes back twice, little sister!

mystic-brawler>ninja.text: My ancestors see you, little shadow. Even if I can't!

pyromancer>paladin.text: I hope that armor is fireproof!
Faith has carried me through hotter places.

paladin>pyromancer.text: Repent, sorceress. There is still time to be saved.
Aww, you're sweet! I'll save you for last!

pyromancer>shadow-thief.text: Steal whatever you like! It'll all be ash by tonight!
Ash doesn't sell. You're bad for business.

shadow-thief>pyromancer.text: Easy with the fire. My gold melts.
Oh, it drips! It's SO pretty when it drips!

pyromancer>treant.text: Oh my! You're the biggest bonfire I've ever seen!
I have met your kind before... child. The forest remembers.

treant>pyromancer.text: Every tree you ever burned... I felt, child.
You feel EVERYTHING? Oh, this is going to be wonderful!

pyromancer>artificer.text: Metal doesn't burn. It MELTS! That's even better!
My alloys withstand three thousand degrees. Try harder.

artificer>pyromancer.text: Your destruction lacks efficiency. Zero structure.
Structure? Structures are the things I knock DOWN!

pyromancer>cursed-pirate.text: Ships are just big floating firewood, right?

cursed-pirate>pyromancer.text: Fire at sea's the worst way to go, lass.
Ooh! Tell me about it! Every detail!

pyromancer>gunslinger.text: Your family's house burned down? Wasn't me! ...Probably!

gunslinger>pyromancer.text: Gunpowder and fire don't mix, darlin'.
They mix BEAUTIFULLY! That's the whole point!

pyromancer>huntress.text: Here, kitty kitty! I have something warm for you!
Nyra fears nothing. Except you. Smart cat.

huntress>pyromancer.text: The jungle is so GREEN. It needs a little orange!

pyromancer>samurai.text: Is it true samurai would rather die than lose? Ooh, let's test it!
It is true. Test it, and learn what that makes me.

samurai>pyromancer.text: The purpose is that it's FUN! Keep up!

pyromancer>seraph.text: Holy fire? Ooh, can I try some?
It burns the wicked. You most of all.

seraph>pyromancer.text: Kneel, and your soul may yet be cleansed by fire.
Cleansed by fire? We're gonna get along GREAT!

pyromancer>tactician.text: Your soldiers are lined up so neatly! Like matches in a box!

tactician>pyromancer.text: I have a plan for every weapon on this field.
I'm not a weapon, silly. I'm a disaster!

pyromancer>vampire-lord.text: Vampires go up like paper! Is that true? Please say it's true!
Come closer, darling, and I'll show you what's true.

vampire-lord>pyromancer.text: Such hot blood. I do love a spicy vintage.

pyromancer>black-panther.text: Is vibranium fireproof? Let's find out together!
Wakanda has tested it against far worse than you.

black-panther>pyromancer.text: A warrior fights for something. What do you fight for?
The crackling! Have you ever listened to it? It's like music!

pyromancer>black-widow.text: A spy! Do you burn your hideouts when you leave? Can I help next time?
I clean up quietly. You're the opposite of quiet.

black-widow>pyromancer.text: I've seen your type before. You always burn out.
Sure! But I take everything with me!

pyromancer>captain-marvel.text: You're full of cosmic fire! Can I have some? Pleeease?

captain-marvel>pyromancer.text: I've flown through suns. Your fire's cute.
Cute? CUTE? Oh, now I'm really going to enjoy this!

pyromancer>doctor-strange.text: So many old books! You know they're flammable, right?
Those books are older than your entire bloodline.

doctor-strange>pyromancer.text: In every future I've seen, you burn yourself out.
Even the ones where EVERYTHING burns? Tell me about those!

pyromancer>loki.text: Which one's the real you? I'll just burn all of them!
Crude. But I do admire the thoroughness.

loki>pyromancer.text: Chaos, destruction, no remorse... you'd have fit right in on Asgard.
Does Asgard burn? Ooh, is it far?

pyromancer>spider-man.text: Invisible, huh? Everything glows when it's on fire!
Okay, that's the scariest thing anyone's ever said to me.

spider-man>pyromancer.text: Hey, uh, maybe put the fire down? Let's talk?
Sure! Let's talk about what burns first!

pyromancer>scarlet-witch.text: You can change reality? Make EVERYTHING flammable!
Or I make you fireproof, and leave you nothing to burn.

scarlet-witch>pyromancer.text: I could erase your fire with a thought.
Aww. But then what would I be?

pyromancer>thor.text: Your whole world ends in fire? Oh, I'd LOVE to visit!
Ragnarok is no festival, girl! ...Though thou wouldst enjoy it far too much.

thor>pyromancer.text: By Odin's beard! Thou art Ragnarok in a little dress!
Is that a compliment? It FEELS like a compliment!

pyromancer>cyclops.text: Take off the glasses! I want to see what your eyes do to buildings!

cyclops>pyromancer.text: You're reckless. No plan, no restraint.
Plans are so boring! Fire never needs one!

pyromancer>gambit.text: Your cards explode? Oh, I LOVE you already!
Easy, chère. Gambit's heart is taken. Mostly.

gambit>pyromancer.text: Dese cards burn hot, chère. Don't get too close.

pyromancer>iceman.text: An ice boy! How long do you last on high heat?
Long enough to make a joke about it. Uh... I'll think of one.

iceman>pyromancer.text: Chill out, fire girl. Seriously. Please chill out.
Say "chill" one more time! I dare you!

pyromancer>jean-grey.text: You burned a whole planet? Tell me EVERYTHING!

jean-grey>pyromancer.text: Your mind is so... happy. That's what scares me—
Aww! I like you too! Let's burn something together!

pyromancer>psylocke.text: Your blade is made of thoughts? Can thoughts burn?
Yours already have. There's nothing in there but smoke.

psylocke>pyromancer.text: I looked inside your mind. It's all flames.

pyromancer>rogue.text: If you touch me, do you get my fire? Ooh, let's try!
Honey, I'm scared of what else I'd get.

rogue>pyromancer.text: Keep that fire to yourself, sugar.

pyromancer>storm.text: Can you make it windy? Wind makes fire SO much bigger!
Or I make it rain. Choose your next words carefully.

storm>pyromancer.text: The rain answers to me, child.
Then I'll just burn you before it gets here!

pyromancer>wolverine.text: You smell like smoke already! Did you start without me?
It's a cigar, kid. Back off.

wolverine>pyromancer.text: Seen a lotta killers, kid. None of 'em smiled like you.

pyromancer>headless-horseman.text: A pumpkin with a candle inside? That's MY kind of head!
Heh heh heh! Touch my flame, little witch, and lose your own head!

headless-horseman>pyromancer.text: Heh heh heh! My flame burns forever, witch!
Forever? Oh, can I have it when you're done?

pyromancer>raveness.text: Your bird looks like he'd go up really fast!
Touch him, and nevermore shall you feel warmth.

raveness>pyromancer.text: Nevermore shall you dance, child. The ashes will be your grave.
Ooh, spooky! Can my grave be on fire too?

pyromancer>druid.text: You're a whole forest in one guy! My favorite kind of fuel!
Then meet what lives in the forest—

druid>pyromancer.text: Fire has a place in nature. Yours doesn't.
Everything has a place in fire! That's kind of the point!

pyromancer>duelist.text: You dance! Can you dance on hot coals? Let's see!
Deftly, daintily, darling. Don't doubt it.

duelist>pyromancer.text: Say that again! But faster, while you're on fire!

pyromancer>forgemaster.text: You keep fire locked in a little box all day? That's so SAD!
It's called a forge, lass. The fire works for me.

forgemaster>pyromancer.text: Your fire's wasted, lass. Give me a week, I'd have you heating my forge.
Ooh, a job! Can I burn the workshop down on my last day?

pyromancer>santa.text: Do you know how many chimneys I've lit? All of them!
Ho ho ho! I know, dear. My beard hasn't forgiven you.

santa>pyromancer.text: Ho ho ho! You're getting coal this year!
Coal? Oh, Santa, you DO know me!

pyromancer>krampus.text: What's in the sack? Anything flammable?
Children who asked too many questions.

krampus>pyromancer.text: Naughty children go in my sack. You'd set it on fire.

pyromancer>alchemist.text: Which of your bottles goes BOOM the loudest?
Oh, that's easy! The one you're standing next to!

alchemist>pyromancer.text: Fire? How primitive. Real reactions happen in a flask.
Ooh! Can I set the flask on fire?

pyromancer>mystic-brawler.text: Do your islands have volcanoes? Take me to them!
Only if you behave, little sister! ...You won't, will you?

mystic-brawler>pyromancer.text: Fire is sacred to my people, little sister.
Sacred? Me too! I worship it every single day!

alchemist>paladin.text: Does your god heal you? I'd love to measure how fast!
Faith is not measured, child. It is lived.

paladin>alchemist.text: Brewing poison is a sin, alchemist.

alchemist>shadow-thief.text: I brought the antidote to the poison I made you.

shadow-thief>alchemist.text: Your poison works great, sis. Dad would be proud.
Dad would ask for the data. Did you write anything down?

alchemist>treant.text: Sap, bark, root... I need one of each. It'll barely hurt!

treant>alchemist.text: You poison the soil, child. The roots... can taste it.
Really? What does it taste like? Be specific!

alchemist>artificer.text: Hi, Dad. Your robots still can't handle acid.
And your acids have yet to pass a single controlled test.

artificer>alchemist.text: You still work without a safety protocol.
Safety ruins the data, Dad. You taught me that.

alchemist>cursed-pirate.text: Cursed gold! Does the curse live in the metal, or in you?
Both, lass! Grab a coin and see—

cursed-pirate>alchemist.text: Keep yer bottles off me ship, lass. Last chemist aboard sank her.
Sank it? Which formula? I need to know what went wrong!

alchemist>gunslinger.text: Gunpowder is SUCH a simple compound. Want me to improve it?
Mine works fine. Kept me alive this long.

gunslinger>alchemist.text: You sell poison to the wrong kind of folks.
I sell to paying folks. The data's the same either way.

alchemist>huntress.text: Your tiger heals so fast! I need a blood sample. A small one!
Nyra takes samples too. Big ones.

huntress>alchemist.text: Nyra won't eat anything that smells like you.
Fascinating! Which smell? The sulfur or the acid?

alchemist>samurai.text: What a perfect edge! What's the blade tempered with?
Generations of discipline. Something you have never practiced.

samurai>alchemist.text: Poison is the weapon of a coward.
Poison is the weapon of someone who did her homework!

alchemist>seraph.text: Are those wings crystal? How do they bend the light? I need to know!
Mortals are not meant to study the divine.

seraph>alchemist.text: Your concoctions are an abomination before heaven.
Heaven hasn't seen my notes. They'd be SO impressed.

alchemist>tactician.text: A whole army! I've never tested anything on that many people at once!
And you never will. My soldiers carry gas masks.

tactician>alchemist.text: Chemical warfare. Crude, but I respect it.
Crude? I have forty formulas! Want to see the list?

alchemist>vampire-lord.text: Does garlic actually work on you? I brought extract. Lots of it.
Darling, keep the garlic. I'll take the chemist.

vampire-lord>alchemist.text: What curious blood. It smells of chemicals.
That's the preservatives! Keeps me fresh!

alchemist>black-panther.text: Vibranium absorbs energy? Can I take a chunk home? A small one!
No one takes vibranium from Wakanda.

black-panther>alchemist.text: Our scientists would call your methods reckless.

alchemist>black-widow.text: Red Room serums! What was in yours? I need the formula!
Things I've spent years trying to forget.

black-widow>alchemist.text: Chemists are useful. Until they start talking.
Oh, I never stop talking! It helps me think!

alchemist>captain-marvel.text: You absorbed cosmic energy and lived? What does your cell structure look like?
Durable. Throw something and find out.

captain-marvel>alchemist.text: Put the bottles down, lady. This won't take long.
Excellent! Quick results are my favorite kind!

alchemist>doctor-strange.text: Magic is just science nobody bothered to write down!
Say that again, and I'll show you some you can't write down.

doctor-strange>alchemist.text: Alchemy. The mystic arts' clumsy little cousin.
Clumsy? My formulas work every time. Can your spells say that?

alchemist>loki.text: Which one of you is real? Let's check with acid!
How charming. The science of throwing things.

loki>alchemist.text: A poisoner? You'd have been quite popular in Asgard.
Did Asgard have test subjects? Big ones?

alchemist>spider-man.text: You stick to walls! Is it an adhesive? Can I bottle it?
Okay, no. Nobody's bottling any part of me.

spider-man>alchemist.text: Uh, is that bottle supposed to be smoking?
Yes! Well... not THAT much. Duck!

alchemist>scarlet-witch.text: Chaos magic! Is it even stable? Can I keep a jar of it?
Nothing I make is stable. That's the point.

scarlet-witch>alchemist.text: I could turn every one of your potions into water.
Then I'd study THAT! Please do it slowly!

alchemist>thor.text: The hammer only works for the worthy? What's the mechanism?
'Tis no mechanism, little scholar! 'Tis Odin's own enchantment!

thor>alchemist.text: Thy potions smell foul! Hast thou no mead?
Mead is just fermented honey. I can do better! Well, stronger.

alchemist>cyclops.text: Your eyes fire energy nonstop? What if I just... took the visor off?
Then it would be the last experiment you ever ran.

cyclops>alchemist.text: You're a walking hazard. No containment, no procedure.
Containment is for people who don't want to see what happens!

alchemist>gambit.text: Your cards store energy! How do you release it?
Wit' style, chère. Can't bottle dat.

gambit>alchemist.text: Seen your kind back in N'Awlins, chère. Voodoo in a bottle.
Voodoo? Please. Mine comes with a formula.

alchemist>iceman.text: Absolute zero! Can you actually reach it? I brought a thermometer!
Ooh, a thermometer. Very... cool. Sorry. Couldn't resist.

iceman>alchemist.text: Whoa, that bottle's steaming. Want me to cool it down?
No! Heat is the whole reaction! ...Actually, yes, it's getting worse.

alchemist>jean-grey.text: A cosmic entity inside a human host! What's the energy output?

jean-grey>alchemist.text: Your thoughts move so fast. It's all... formulas.
You can read them? Great! Check my math on the third one!

alchemist>psylocke.text: Can you read my mind? Tell me what I'm about to throw!

psylocke>alchemist.text: Your mind never stops. It's exhausting.
Yours is so quiet! Is that a condition? Can I study it?

alchemist>rogue.text: If you touch me, do you get my memories? All my formulas?
Sugar, I got enough voices in my head already.

rogue>alchemist.text: Wonder what I'd get from touchin' you, sugar.
My whole research journal! You'd finally be interesting!

alchemist>storm.text: Do you make the clouds, or just move them around? I need to know!
The sky does not explain itself to you.

storm>alchemist.text: Your fumes poison the sky, chemist.
