alchemist>wolverine.text: Your healing factor! One tiny tissue sample? You'll grow it back!
Last folks who said that ended up in pieces, lady.

wolverine>alchemist.text: Put the bottles down before somebody gets hurt.
Someone ALWAYS gets hurt. That's how you know it worked!

alchemist>headless-horseman.text: How do you move without a head? Where's the nervous system?
Heh heh heh! Right here in the pumpkin, girl!

headless-horseman>alchemist.text: Heh heh heh! Do I frighten you, little scientist?
No! You fascinate me! That's much worse for you!

alchemist>raveness.text: Your raven feeds on life force? How do you even measure that?
By what remains when he is finished.

raveness>alchemist.text: Nevermore? That's not a real timeframe. Be specific!

alchemist>druid.text: How does the shapeshift work? Bones? Muscle? Both at once?

druid>alchemist.text: Nature invented the chemicals! I'm just organizing them!

alchemist>duelist.text: You move so precisely! Is it muscle memory, or pure vanity?

duelist>alchemist.text: Sloppy? Every drop is measured! You're watching the wrong drops!

alchemist>forgemaster.text: Ultimanium! What's the melting point? What's it made of?
Dwarven secrets, lass. Stay out of my mine.

forgemaster>alchemist.text: Glass bottles and no armor? One hit and you shatter, lass.
One hit and the BOTTLES shatter. Then we'll see who's worried!

alchemist>santa.text: Flying reindeer! Is it a potion? Tell me it's a potion!
Ho ho ho! Christmas magic, dear. Not for sale!

santa>alchemist.text: Ho ho ho! Still blowing up the lab, young lady?
Only the parts that deserved it!

alchemist>krampus.text: Your sack holds children? What's the capacity? Is it bigger inside?

krampus>alchemist.text: You poison people for fun. The sack awaits.
Not for fun! For RESEARCH! There's a difference!

alchemist>mystic-brawler.text: Every hit comes back stronger? That breaks at least three laws of nature!
My ancestors never heard of your laws, little sister!

mystic-brawler>alchemist.text: Your bottles can't hurt me, little sister! The ocean protects me!
Then I'll test the ocean first!

paladin>shadow-thief.text: Return what you have stolen, and I will overlook it.
Deal. Oh, and this ring's yours, by the way.

shadow-thief>paladin.text: Relax, holy man. I only rob people who deserve it.
Then in my village, you would starve.

paladin>treant.text: Ancient one. I am honored to stand before you.
Honor... is young, child. But I accept it.

treant>paladin.text: Knights once swore their oaths... beneath my branches, child.
Then I will keep mine beneath them today.

paladin>artificer.text: Your machines fight without conscience. That troubles me.
Conscience is a design flaw. I removed it early.

artificer>paladin.text: Heavy plating, slow response time. You are a fortress with legs.
Thank you. That is the goal.

paladin>cursed-pirate.text: Cursed creature. Your wicked voyage ends here.

cursed-pirate>paladin.text: Holy water don't work on me, knight. Folks have tried.
Then I will use the sword. It works on everyone.

paladin>gunslinger.text: Vengeance is a heavy burden. You need not carry it alone.

gunslinger>paladin.text: You ever kill a man, preacher?
Only when justice demanded it. I remember every one.

paladin>huntress.text: Your tiger guards you as a knight guards his lord.
Nyra is no servant. We are family.

huntress>paladin.text: Your armor won't stop Nyra's teeth.
It has stopped worse, my lady. She is welcome to try.

paladin>samurai.text: You serve a code, as I do. I respect that.
Then let us see whose code breaks first.

samurai>paladin.text: Your order and my clan would have been allies.
Then let us fight as allies would. Fairly.

paladin>seraph.text: An angel of the Light! I have served your cause my whole life!
And yet you stand, when you should kneel.

seraph>paladin.text: It grieves heaven that two servants of the Light must clash.
It grieves me too, holy one. But the Light will know we both fought true.

paladin>tactician.text: Do your soldiers know you see them as game pieces?
They know they win. That's enough for them.

tactician>paladin.text: One knight. Predictable. Moves only in straight lines.
A straight line is the shortest path to justice.

paladin>vampire-lord.text: Creature of the night, I offer you one chance to surrender.
How gallant. I offer you one chance to bleed quietly.

vampire-lord>paladin.text: Such a pure heart. I do so love to ruin those.
Many have tried, my lady. The Light has not left me yet.

paladin>black-panther.text: You carry a crown and a sword. That is a heavy burden.
Heavier than armor, knight. But I never set it down.

black-panther>paladin.text: You fight for your god. I fight for my people.
Then we both fight for something greater than ourselves.

paladin>black-widow.text: There is still time to clear your ledger, my lady.
Nice thought. The ledger doesn't care about your god.

black-widow>paladin.text: You're the easiest man I've ever read. No secrets at all.
Thank you. I work very hard at that.

paladin>captain-marvel.text: You fly into battle alone. Where is your squadron?
Right here. I am the squadron.

captain-marvel>paladin.text: Big armor, big sword. Compensating for something?
Yes. For all those who cannot protect themselves.

paladin>doctor-strange.text: Doctor. You swore an oath to do no harm.
I've sworn many oaths. That one has flexible wording.

doctor-strange>paladin.text: Your god is one of many I've met, knight.
Then you have much to be humble about.

paladin>loki.text: Which of you is the real Loki? Please step forward, sir.
Such manners! I almost feel bad for lying to you.

loki>paladin.text: Tell me, knight. Have you ever told a single lie?
Once. As a boy. I still think about it.

paladin>spider-man.text: Young man, is it safe to be up on that wall?
Totally safe! Mostly! It's a spider thing!

spider-man>paladin.text: Whoa, a real knight! Do you, like, save princesses?
I save whoever needs saving. Princesses rarely do.

paladin>scarlet-witch.text: Power without restraint is a danger to the innocent.
Then pray the innocent stay out of my way.

scarlet-witch>paladin.text: I could erase your god from this reality.
Then I would keep believing. That is what faith means.

paladin>thor.text: A god of thunder, fighting among mortals. Why?
Because mortals fight so gloriously! Thou shalt see!

thor>paladin.text: A knight in shining armor! Wilt thou drink with me after?
Water only, friend. But yes, gladly.

paladin>cyclops.text: You lead your people into danger. Does it weigh on you?
Every day. That's how I know I'm doing it right.

cyclops>paladin.text: You'd make a good soldier. Ever thought about joining a team?
I already serve. But thank you. That is kind.

paladin>gambit.text: Everyt'ing fun is a vice, mon ami. Dat's how you know.

gambit>paladin.text: Pick a card, knight. Any card.

paladin>iceman.text: You mock your enemies, young man. It is unbecoming.
Sorry, sir. I'll try to keep it... cool.

iceman>paladin.text: Hey, tin man! Mind if I skate on your shield?
I would prefer you did not. I just polished it.

paladin>jean-grey.text: I sense a great fire within you, my lady. Is it holy?

jean-grey>paladin.text: Your prayers are so loud in your head. It's... comforting.
Then listen as long as you need, my lady.

paladin>psylocke.text: Lower your blade, my lady. I do not wish to harm you.

psylocke>paladin.text: I could make you drop that sword with a single thought.
Then I would pick it up again. I am very stubborn.

paladin>rogue.text: May I shake your hand before we fight, my lady? It is custom.
Honey, that'd be the last custom you ever kept.

rogue>paladin.text: One touch, and all that holy power'd be mine, sugar.
Then I hope it serves you well. Use it kindly.

paladin>storm.text: Your storms could flood a village, my lady. Please be careful.
I have never harmed the innocent, knight. Only fools.

storm>paladin.text: I know. It has happened before. Twice.

paladin>wolverine.text: You carry much pain, friend. Have you tried confession?
Bub, the priest would need a vacation.

wolverine>paladin.text: Too clean, too shiny, too nice. Can't stand guys like you.
Then I will try to be less shiny. For you.

paladin>headless-horseman.text: Unholy rider! Return to the grave you crawled from!
Heh heh heh! I just left it, knight! It's so BORING down there!

headless-horseman>paladin.text: Heh heh heh! Your head would look lovely on my saddle, knight!
It is attached, and it will stay attached.

paladin>raveness.text: Your raven feeds on the living. Call it back, witch.
Nevermore does he answer to anyone but hunger.

raveness>paladin.text: Nevermore shall your light shine, knight. It will make a lovely darkness.
Darkness has surrounded me before. I am still here.

paladin>druid.text: You guard the forest as I guard the innocent. We are not so different.

druid>paladin.text: Your armor won't help you against—
A... kitten. I will fight it with honor.

paladin>duelist.text: You fight for glory, sir. That is a hollow reason.
Hollow? Hardly! Heroic, handsome, and highly entertaining!

duelist>paladin.text: Plodding paladin, prepare to be positively pirouetted!
I do not know what that means. But I am prepared.

paladin>forgemaster.text: Fine craftsmanship, master smith. Did you forge that armor yourself?
Every rivet, lad. Yours was made by an amateur.

forgemaster>paladin.text: That sword's got more notches than a tally stick, lad.
Each one is a life it saved. I will not have it mended.

paladin>santa.text: Santa! I asked you for a sword when I was seven.
Ho ho ho! And you got a wooden one, as I recall!

santa>paladin.text: Ho ho ho! Nice list, every single year! Well done, son!
Thank you, Santa. It has not always been easy.

paladin>krampus.text: Demon! You punish children. There is no justice in that.
There is justice. There is simply no mercy.

krampus>paladin.text: You have never been naughty, knight. How disappointing.
I once ate dessert before supper. I confessed the next day.

paladin>mystic-brawler.text: Your ancestors walk beside you. Mine pray for me.
Then let's give them all something to watch, brother!

mystic-brawler>paladin.text: Hit me as hard as you can, knight!
Strike me, and it returns to you as well. We may be here a while.

shadow-thief>treant.text: Relax, old timer. I'm not here for the wood.
Your pockets... are full of my acorns, child.

treant>shadow-thief.text: You hide in my shadow, child. It is not yours to take.
Shadows are free, big guy. That's the beauty of 'em.

shadow-thief>artificer.text: Hey, Dad. Nice robots. How much for the small one?
More than you stole from me last year. With interest.

artificer>shadow-thief.text: You wasted your potential, son. You could have been an engineer.
I engineer other people's pockets, Dad. Same thing.

shadow-thief>cursed-pirate.text: Cursed gold? Doesn't bother me. Gold's gold.

cursed-pirate>shadow-thief.text: Stay away from me ship, ye slippery little—
You talk with your hands. Big mistake.

shadow-thief>gunslinger.text: Bounty hunter, huh? What's the going rate on me?
Not enough to be worth the trouble. I'm doin' it anyway.

gunslinger>shadow-thief.text: Outlaw. I've put plenty of your kind in the ground.
Not my kind. We never stay where you put us.

shadow-thief>huntress.text: Does the cat do tricks? I do tricks.
She does one. You won't like it.

huntress>shadow-thief.text: Nyra can smell a thief a mile away.
Relax. Nothing out here worth stealing anyway.

shadow-thief>samurai.text: Two swords? Nice. I'd settle for one.
Touch either, and lose the hand.

samurai>shadow-thief.text: Sure I do. I stole it off a samurai.

shadow-thief>seraph.text: Look, angel, I'll confess everything. Just not today.
Heaven already knows. Every coin. Every blade.

seraph>shadow-thief.text: Your soul is black with sin, thief.
Black goes with everything. It's practical.

shadow-thief>tactician.text: Nice army. Anybody guarding the supply wagons?

tactician>shadow-thief.text: Mercenary. Name your price, and switch sides.
Double. And I keep whatever I lift from your tent.

shadow-thief>vampire-lord.text: Castle full of antiques, no guards at night. Tempting.
Oh, there's a guard, darling. She's simply very hungry.

vampire-lord>shadow-thief.text: A little thief in my castle. However did you get in?
Same way I'm getting out. With your silverware.

shadow-thief>black-panther.text: A whole kingdom full of vibranium? Where do I apply?
Many have come looking. None found the way in.

black-panther>shadow-thief.text: Every thief who came for Wakanda's vibranium sits in a cell.

shadow-thief>black-widow.text: A spy and a thief. We should team up.
I've worked with thieves. They always check my pockets.

black-widow>shadow-thief.text: I know your type. All charm, no loyalty.

shadow-thief>captain-marvel.text: Photon blasts are so flashy. Ever try doing something quietly?
Nope. Where's the fun in that?

captain-marvel>shadow-thief.text: Stand still, sneaky. This'll take two seconds.
Two seconds? I'll be gone in one.

shadow-thief>doctor-strange.text: Got anything in that sanctum worth taking, Doc?
Plenty. None of it would let you leave alive.

doctor-strange>shadow-thief.text: Your shadows are a cheap trick, thief.
Cheap tricks pay the rent, Doc.

shadow-thief>loki.text: God of mischief, huh? We're practically colleagues.

loki>shadow-thief.text: I could teach you real deception, little thief.
Sure. Right after you teach me how to lose a throne.

shadow-thief>spider-man.text: Friendly neighborhood, huh? I love friendly neighborhoods. Unlocked doors.
Okay, that's creepy, and I'm telling everyone to lock their doors.

spider-man>shadow-thief.text: My spider-sense is going crazy. Is that... you?

shadow-thief>scarlet-witch.text: You can change reality? Change my pockets to full.

scarlet-witch>shadow-thief.text: Everything you've ever stolen, I could return with a thought.
Please don't. Some of those people were awful.

shadow-thief>thor.text: Nice hammer. Be a shame if somebody stole it, huh?
HA! Try it, little thief! I shall wait!

thor>shadow-thief.text: Face me in the open, thief! Hiding is for cowards!
Hiding is for people who want to see tomorrow.

shadow-thief>cyclops.text: Team leader, huh? Who's watching your back right now?
Nobody needs to. I saw you coming.

cyclops>shadow-thief.text: I've got every exit covered. All four of them.

shadow-thief>gambit.text: A fellow thief! Let's compare hauls.
Gambit already got yours, mon ami. Check your belt.

gambit>shadow-thief.text: De Thieves Guild taught Gambit everyt'ing, mon ami.

shadow-thief>iceman.text: Can you freeze a lock solid? Asking for a friend.
I could. But then I'd be your accomplice. And that's not cool.

iceman>shadow-thief.text: Freeze! ...Get it? Like guards say? Because I'm ice?
Kid, I've heard that from real guards. They were funnier.

shadow-thief>jean-grey.text: Mind reader, huh? Then you know I'm not stealing anything.
You're planning to rob me right now—

jean-grey>shadow-thief.text: Your mind is full of locks. It's kind of impressive.
Lady, I pick locks. I don't leave mine open.

shadow-thief>psylocke.text: Assassin, huh? What's the pay like these days?
Better than yours. And I never get caught.

psylocke>shadow-thief.text: Poison on the blade. An amateur's crutch.
Amateur? It's the reason I'm still alive.

shadow-thief>rogue.text: You steal powers with one touch? You'd be a legend in my line of work.
Ain't a gift I'd wish on anybody, sugar.

rogue>shadow-thief.text: Keep your hands where I can see 'em, sugar.
Same to you. Yours are way more dangerous.

shadow-thief>storm.text: Queen of the weather, huh? What's a crown like that worth?

storm>shadow-thief.text: Your shadows vanish when my lightning strikes.
So do I. That's the trick.

shadow-thief>wolverine.text: Easy, pal. Just looking for a drink. Maybe your wallet.
Wallet's in the jacket. Touch the jacket, lose the hand.

wolverine>shadow-thief.text: I can smell your poison from here, bub.
Good. Then you know I'm not bluffing.

shadow-thief>headless-horseman.text: Headless, huh? Guess I can't steal your hat.
Heh heh heh! Steal my head instead, thief! It BITES!

headless-horseman>shadow-thief.text: Heh heh heh! Lost something, thief? Your nerve, perhaps?
Says the guy who lost his whole head.

shadow-thief>raveness.text: Your bird likes shiny things. So do I. We should talk.
He takes what shines. Then he takes the eyes.

raveness>shadow-thief.text: Nevermore shall your hands find another purse.
Then I'll use my feet. I'm flexible.

shadow-thief>druid.text: Relax, nature boy. Just passing through your woods.
With pockets full of my herbs—

druid>shadow-thief.text: I can smell you in the shadows—
Nice kitty. Real nice. I'm backing away now.

shadow-thief>duelist.text: You dance, I pick pockets. Same skill, different fans.
Delightful deduction, devious dodger. Dreadful comparison.

duelist>shadow-thief.text: Sneaky swindler, show your shameless self!

shadow-thief>forgemaster.text: Heard your mine has great locks.
Forged 'em myself, lad. Try one and lose the fingers.

forgemaster>shadow-thief.text: My hammer's gone missing. Funny thing, that.

shadow-thief>santa.text: A whole sleigh full of presents and no guards?
Ho ho ho! I've got reindeer, son. They kick.

santa>shadow-thief.text: Ho ho ho! Naughty list again this year!
Keep the coal. I'll take the sleigh.

shadow-thief>krampus.text: Your sack's full of naughty kids? I was one. I got out.
Then you already know the way back in.

krampus>shadow-thief.text: I remember every purse you ever lifted.
Great memory. So where'd you put your wallet?

shadow-thief>mystic-brawler.text: Big guy, big heart. Big purse?
Only what the sea gives me, little brother! Want some sand?

mystic-brawler>shadow-thief.text: My ancestors see every trick, little brother!
Then they've got a great view. Tell 'em to watch closely.

treant>artificer.text: Your machines smell... of sawdust, little tinker.
An efficient material. Renewable, too. Mostly.

artificer>treant.text: Growth rate: one ring per year. Unacceptably slow.
And yet... I will outlast every gear you make, sapling.

treant>cursed-pirate.text: Your ship... was once my cousin, sailor.
Aye, and a fine lass she was—

cursed-pirate>treant.text: Blimey, a walkin' tree! Ye'd make a grand mast!
Many ships have wanted me, mayfly. The sea... has all of them now.

treant>gunslinger.text: Vengeance... is a short season, young one. It always ends.
Mine ends when he's in the ground.

gunslinger>treant.text: Bullets don't care how old you are, tree.
Neither did the woodpeckers... I outlived them all.

treant>huntress.text: You and your cat... belong to the green, young one. As I do.
Then you know the jungle has no friends. Only hunters and hunted.

huntress>treant.text: Nyra wants to sharpen her claws on you.
Let her, little one... Bark grows back. Slowly.

treant>samurai.text: Your ancestors planted cherry trees, young warrior. I remember them.
Then you honor them as I do. Let us fight well.

samurai>treant.text: One clean cut, and even the oldest tree falls.
Many have said so... over a thousand winters. Their axes... are rust.

treant>seraph.text: Heaven is young, bright one. I remember... when the sky was empty.
Blasphemy. Heaven was before all things.

seraph>treant.text: Kneel before the Light, ancient one.
My roots do not bend, little flame. Not for storms. Not for you.

treant>tactician.text: You plan for today, commander. I plan... for centuries.
Centuries? I only need until sundown.

tactician>treant.text: My army could clear this forest in a day.
And in a hundred years... it will grow over your army's graves.

treant>vampire-lord.text: You call yourself old, night-thing? You are... a seedling.
Five hundred years, darling. Do show some respect.

vampire-lord>treant.text: Not a drop of blood in you. What a waste of a feast.
Sap runs slower, little bat... and lasts longer.

treant>black-panther.text: Your heart-shaped herb grows nowhere else, young king.
And it is guarded more closely than any throne.

black-panther>treant.text: The ancestors speak to me. Do they speak to you?
Some of them... are me, young king.

treant>black-widow.text: You have lived many lives, short-lived one. Yet so few years.

black-widow>treant.text: Big, slow target. This won't take long.
The last woodcutter said that... His bones feed my roots.

treant>captain-marvel.text: You race across the sky, little sprout. Where is the hurry?
Somebody's always in trouble somewhere. Can't wait around for it.

captain-marvel>treant.text: Big, slow, and rooted. You're a sitting target.
And you... must come to me. Eventually.

treant>doctor-strange.text: You bend time, sorcerer. I simply... wait for it.
Admirable patience. Unfortunately, I'm in a hurry.

doctor-strange>treant.text: I've met ancient beings before. Most were far more talkative.
Most... were in a hurry to be heard.

treant>loki.text: Your lies are quick, little trickster. The truth grows slower.
And yet it never catches up. How tragic.

loki>treant.text: A talking tree. Yggdrasil sends her regards.

treant>spider-man.text: You climb like a squirrel, little one. They also chatter.
Hey! I'm way cooler than a squirrel! ...Right?

spider-man>treant.text: Hey, big guy! Don't worry, I'll go easy on the branches.
Kind, little sprout... Unnecessary. But kind.

treant>scarlet-witch.text: You rewrite the world in an afternoon, young one. It took me ages to grow.
Then be glad I haven't touched you yet.

scarlet-witch>treant.text: I could turn you back into a seed.

treant>thor.text: Your world rests on the branches of Yggdrasil, thunder-child. Show respect.
I do! And when I win, I shall tell the World Tree of thy valor!

thor>treant.text: Art thou kin to Yggdrasil, old one? Thou hast her bark!
Distant kin, young god... She was always... the showy one.

treant>cyclops.text: Your eyes burn everything they touch, young one. Keep them... from my leaves.
That's what the visor's for. Mostly.

cyclops>treant.text: Big target. Optic blasts at full power should do it.
Lightning has struck me... four times, young leader. Your eyes are not lightning.

treant>gambit.text: Your cards... were trees once, gambler.
Den dey went out wit' a bang, mon ami. Gambit made sure.

gambit>treant.text: Wanna play a hand, old-timer? We got time.
I have time, little bayou-frog... You have less than you think.

treant>iceman.text: Winter again, little frost?... I have slept through a thousand of you.
Wow. Rude. But also kind of impressive.

iceman>treant.text: Hey, big guy, want me to frost your leaves? Very seasonal.
Frost comes every year, young one... It is never invited.

treant>jean-grey.text: The fire inside you, young one... Keep it far from the forest.

jean-grey>treant.text: Your thoughts are so slow. Like... sap moving.
Slow thoughts... go deep, little leaf.

treant>psylocke.text: You strike inside the mind, young blade. Mine is... very old. Crowded.
Then I'll take my time. There's a lot to cut.

psylocke>treant.text: Your mind is enormous. And quiet. Almost peaceful.
Rest a while, little one... Then we fight.

treant>rogue.text: Your touch takes... what is not yours, young one.
Try tellin' it to stop, sugar. It don't listen.

rogue>treant.text: Wonder what I'd get from touchin' a tree. Patience?

treant>storm.text: You call the rain, weather-queen. The forest... thanks you.
Then forgive me, old one, for the lightning that follows.

storm>treant.text: I could topple you with a single gale.
Many storms have tried, young goddess... I am still here.

treant>wolverine.text: You have lived long, young one. For a human. I see it... in your eyes.
Long enough to hate everybody, tree.

wolverine>treant.text: Think I can't cut through a tree this thick? Watch me.
I have met many axes, little claw... They all went dull.

treant>headless-horseman.text: Your forest was a sleepy one, rider... You taught it fear.
Heh heh heh! It was BORING! Now it screams!

headless-horseman>treant.text: Heh heh heh! Hollow trees make the best hiding spots!
Hollow trees... are the dead ones, pumpkin. Remember that.

treant>raveness.text: Your raven nests in branches like mine, dark one.
He nests in dead ones. Soon, perhaps, yours.

raveness>treant.text: Nevermore shall your leaves turn green.
Winter says that every year, young one... Spring disagrees.

treant>druid.text: Little brother of the wild... It saddens me that we meet like this.
Me too, old one. Let's make it quick. And kind.

druid>treant.text: I've guarded the forest since I was a boy. You guarded it long before any of us.
And I have watched you guard it, little brother... You did well.

treant>duelist.text: So much dancing, little sprout. So little... standing still.
Standing still is strictly for statues. And, sadly, for stumps.

duelist>treant.text: Tremble, towering tree! Your timber is terribly tempting!
...Must every word begin... with the same sound, young one?

treant>forgemaster.text: Your forges... ate whole forests, little miner.
Aye. And made the finest steel in the world. Worth it.

forgemaster>treant.text: Oak, eh? Hard wood. Makes a fine axe handle.
...And dwarves make fine soil, little miner.

treant>santa.text: Every winter, your people cut down... my young ones. For your holiday.
Ho ho ho... Well. That's awkward.

santa>treant.text: Ho ho ho! You'd look lovely with some lights and a star on top!
Put a star on me, old man... and see how far it flies.

treant>krampus.text: You punish children, winter-beast. To me... all the world is children.
Then you should appreciate my work.

krampus>treant.text: Your roots crush graves. I carry off children. We are not so different.
The dead come willingly to my roots, goat-beast... Your children do not.

treant>mystic-brawler.text: Your ancestors carved canoes... from my kin, young one.
And sang to every tree before they cut it! We're respectful!

mystic-brawler>treant.text: The mountain is my strength, old one! What's yours?
Roots, loud one... The mountain rests on them.

artificer>cursed-pirate.text: Your coins glow. Enchanted? Radioactive? I brought a scanner.

cursed-pirate>artificer.text: Ye build metal men, tinker? Can they swab a deck?
They could sink your ship in eleven seconds. Swabbing is beneath them.

gunslinger>artificer.text: Your robots bleed oil. I'll make 'em bleed plenty.
Oil is cheap. I have barrels. You have six bullets.

artificer>huntress.text: A tiger. Magnificent musculature. I'll build a better one.
Build all you want. Nyra's never lost to a toy.

huntress>artificer.text: Your machines have no scent. Nyra hates that.
Deliberate. She hunts by smell. Mine hunt by radar.

artificer>samurai.text: Folded steel, a thousand layers. I respect the process, if not the product.
The product has ended better men than you.

samurai>artificer.text: You send machines to fight for you. Coward.
I send machines because I value my time.

artificer>seraph.text: Heaven sends one soldier. I've built forty.
Then heaven sees forty pieces of scrap.

seraph>artificer.text: Your machines have no souls to save.
Then they will never need your services.

artificer>tactician.text: Your soldiers eat, sleep, and desert. Mine do none of those.
And yours can't improvise. That's why I'll win.

tactician>artificer.text: I could use an engineer. Name your price.
Your entire army. As spare parts.

artificer>vampire-lord.text: You don't age. What is your cellular maintenance schedule?
Blood, darling. Nightly. Would you care to volunteer?

vampire-lord>artificer.text: Your servants have no pulse, darling. Whatever shall I drink?
Nothing. I designed them with you in mind.

artificer>black-panther.text: Vibranium. I would sell my own children for an ounce.
From what I hear, they would sell you first.

black-panther>artificer.text: Wakanda solved your problems before you were born.
Then show me the blueprints. I'll find the flaws.

artificer>black-widow.text: Your explosives. Homemade? The wiring is amateur.
It doesn't need to be pretty. It needs to go off.

black-widow>artificer.text: Every machine has an off switch. I'll find yours.
I removed it. Switches are for those who expect to lose.

artificer>captain-marvel.text: Kree energy inside a human body? I must take you apart.
Get in line, gearhead. Lots of people have tried.

captain-marvel>artificer.text: Your bots can't even reach me up here.
The newer models fly. Say hello.

artificer>doctor-strange.text: You rely on artifacts you did not build. How humiliating.
And you build things you don't understand. How dangerous.

doctor-strange>artificer.text: Your robots wouldn't last a minute in the Mirror Dimension.
Then I'll build ones that do. Show me the way in.

artificer>loki.text: Seven of you. My scanner registers zero heat signatures.
Then build a better scanner. I'll wait. All seven of me.

loki>artificer.text: Mortal toys. One whisper, and they'd turn on you.
They have no ears. I designed them for people like you.

artificer>spider-man.text: Wrist-mounted web launchers. Crude construction. Promising, though.
Crude? Okay, rude. Wait, did you just say promising?

spider-man>artificer.text: Whoa, cool robots! Wait. Are they gonna attack me? They're gonna attack me.

artificer>scarlet-witch.text: You rewrite physics without equipment. Explain the mechanism. Slowly.
There is no mechanism. That's what frightens you.

scarlet-witch>artificer.text: Every machine you build, I can unmake with a thought.
And every one you unmake, I rebuild improved. Keep going.

artificer>thor.text: Your hammer returns on its own. Magnetic? Remote-controlled?
'Tis WORTHINESS, tinker! Something thou canst not build!

thor>artificer.text: Metal warriors! Do they fight with honor?
They fight with precision. It is far more reliable.

artificer>cyclops.text: Ruby quartz visor. Primitive. I could build you a better one.
People have tried. Their better ones all melted.

cyclops>artificer.text: Your robots attack in a predictable pattern.
Deliberately. The unpredictable one is behind you.

artificer>gambit.text: You charge playing cards with kinetic energy? Paper. Why paper?
Cheap, stylish, an' Gambit never runs out, mon ami.

gambit>artificer.text: Wanna bet your machines don' last a minute, tinker?
I don't bet. I calculate. You lose in forty seconds.

artificer>iceman.text: My freezers draw forty amps to do what you do for free.
Aw, thanks. I'm super energy-efficient. Very cool of you to notice.

iceman>artificer.text: Want me to chill your robots? Keeps 'em from overheating.
They have liquid cooling. You are redundant.

artificer>jean-grey.text: That cosmic fire. Properly contained, it could run a factory.
Please don't try to contain her—

jean-grey>artificer.text: Your mind is all gears and blueprints. It's almost peaceful.
Efficient. Emotions are a wasteful subroutine.

artificer>psylocke.text: A blade made of thought. I've built a helmet for that.
Wear it. I'll go through the eye slit.

psylocke>artificer.text: Your mind hums like an engine. Cold. Empty.

artificer>rogue.text: Your absorption. I'd like to measure the transfer rate.
Touch me and find out, sugar. Won't be a long study.

rogue>artificer.text: You talk to your machines more than people, don't you, sugar?

artificer>storm.text: Lightning on command. How many volts? I could power my workshop with you.
I was worshipped as a goddess. I am not a battery.

storm>artificer.text: Your machines are metal. Metal draws lightning.
Grounded, insulated, rubber-coated. I anticipated you.

artificer>wolverine.text: Metal claws grafted to bone. Sloppy welding, but ambitious.
Guys who did it are dead, bub. Wanna be next?

wolverine>artificer.text: Adamantium, bub. Your tin cans can't even scratch it.
Then I'll build the next ones out of you.

artificer>headless-horseman.text: A pumpkin with no brain that still talks. Where's the processor?
Heh heh heh! Crack me open and look, tinker!

headless-horseman>artificer.text: Heh heh heh! Can your metal men scream, tinker?
I removed the speakers. Screaming is inefficient.

artificer>raveness.text: Your raven. Organic? I built a mechanical one. It never needs feeding.
Then it shall never know the taste of a soul.

raveness>artificer.text: Nevermore shall your gears turn, tinker. They shall rust.
Stainless alloy. Your raven needs better poetry.

artificer>druid.text: Instant bone reconfiguration. Show me how it works.

druid>artificer.text: Build a machine that can do this—

artificer>duelist.text: Your footwork repeats. My targeting system has already learned it.
Repeats? Please. Pure, perfect, poetic improvisation!

duelist>artificer.text: Clanking, clumsy contraptions! Can they even curtsy?
No. But they can calculate your next step.

artificer>forgemaster.text: Hand-forged steel. Charming. My press makes a hundred of those an hour.
A hundred bad ones. I make one, and it lasts forever.

forgemaster>artificer.text: Show me one blade your machines made that I can't break.
Show me one hammer of yours that hits a target a mile away.

artificer>santa.text: Your toy output. Automated? The numbers don't work otherwise.
Ho ho ho! Elves, son. Elves and love!

santa>artificer.text: Ho ho ho! What does a man who builds everything want for Christmas?
Your workshop. I'll bring my own staff.

artificer>krampus.text: Broken toys, sent into battle? Give them to me. I'll fix them.
Fixed toys don't bite. Mine do.

krampus>artificer.text: My sack is for broken toys. Your robots will fit nicely.
My robots don't break. They fail gracefully.

artificer>mystic-brawler.text: No armor, no weapon, no machine. You came to fight me with tattoos?
And the sea, the sky and the mountain!

mystic-brawler>artificer.text: Your machines don't have ancestors, little brother!
They don't need them. Each generation improves on the last.

loki>cursed-pirate.text: Cursed gold? I've been cursed by better. Mostly by my father.
Ye want a real curse, prince? Look close—

cursed-pirate>loki.text: Ye lie like a sailor, mate. I like ye.
How kind. I'd return the compliment, but I'd be lying.

loki>gunslinger.text: Revenge? How provincial. Try conquest. It scales.
Ain't aimin' for the world. Just for you.

gunslinger>loki.text: I'll shoot the one that's talkin'.
Then you'll shoot him. I'm over here.

loki>huntress.text: I could become a tiger too, you know. A much prettier one.
Nyra would still know. You'd smell like lies.

loki>samurai.text: Honor, loyalty, a lifetime of obedience. I tried that once. Dreadful.

samurai>loki.text: A man who lies has no face.

loki>seraph.text: An angel? Darling, I'm a god. You work for people like me.
I serve the Light. You are merely standing in it.

seraph>loki.text: Confess your lies, trickster, and be judged.
All of them? We'll be here for centuries.

loki>tactician.text: Your plan is flawless, general. Which is why I've already changed it.
And I planned for that change. Twice.

tactician>loki.text: Your illusions would make a fine diversion on my flank.
A diversion? General, I'd be the diversion, the flank, and the victory.

loki>vampire-lord.text: Centuries old and still sleeping in a box? I expected more from royalty.
And I, darling, expected more from a prince without a throne.

vampire-lord>loki.text: Such lovely lies. I wonder if your blood is honest.

loki>black-panther.text: A king who shares his throne with his people? How wasteful.
A throne you must steal is not worth sitting on.

black-panther>loki.text: In Wakanda, a king's word is his bond.
In Asgard, a prince's word is a suggestion.

loki>black-widow.text: Agent Romanoff. Still carrying that ledger?
Still falling for the same trick?

black-widow>loki.text: Last time we talked, you told me your whole plan.
Then this time I shall say nothing at all. ...Starting now.

loki>captain-marvel.text: Kneel, and I'll make you my general.
I don't kneel, I don't take orders, and I don't wear horns.

captain-marvel>loki.text: I could knock you all the way back to Asgard from here.
Please do. Lovely trip. They'll never let me in.

loki>doctor-strange.text: A sorcerer guarding the world. And who guards you from me?
A cloak with opinions. It's been dying to meet you.

doctor-strange>loki.text: I see through every illusion you cast.
Then you're watching the wrong ones.

loki>spider-man.text: A child in a mask. Where are the adults?
Hey, I'm fifteen, not five! ...Okay, my voice cracked, but still.

spider-man>loki.text: Wait, you're the guy who attacked New York? My dad told me about you.
How flattering. I'm a bedtime story.

loki>scarlet-witch.text: Chaos magic. Wild, unfocused, loud. You need a teacher.
I learned alone. That's why no one controls me.

scarlet-witch>loki.text: You bend the truth. I bend reality.
Reality is just a lie everyone agreed on. I'm very good at those.

loki>thor.text: Aye! Until thou stabbed me. Again.

thor>loki.text: Loki! Is that truly thee, or another illusion?
Throw something at me and find out.

loki>cyclops.text: Your team follows you so blindly. How touching.
They follow me because I've never lied to them.

cyclops>loki.text: I have a plan for every illusion you throw.
Adorable. How many do you think I have?

loki>gambit.text: Your deck has five aces, Cajun. Sloppy.
Six, mon ami. You only found de one Gambit wanted found.

gambit>loki.text: Pick a card, prince. Any card.
I already did. Check your deck.

loki>iceman.text: Ice? How quaint. I was born in colder places than you'll ever see.
Whoa. Cool origin story. Like, literally.

iceman>loki.text: Dude, you've got a whole grand monologue ready, don't you?

loki>jean-grey.text: A telepath. Go on, then. What am I thinking?

jean-grey>loki.text: Your thoughts are a maze. Every door opens on another lie.
And yet you keep opening them. How rude.

loki>psylocke.text: An assassin who works for heroes now? How disappointingly reformed.
Reformed? No. I simply choose my targets now.

psylocke>loki.text: Your illusions can't fool a telepath.
No. But they keep your eyes busy.

loki>rogue.text: You fly without wings or magic. How terribly common.
Common got me farther than your fancy tricks, sugar.

rogue>loki.text: Sweet talk don't work on me, sugar. Remy's been tryin' for years.

loki>storm.text: A queen of the weather. My brother does that too. Louder.
Your brother asks the sky. I command it.

storm>loki.text: I was worshipped as a goddess once. I chose to walk away.
Walked away from worship? Madness. I'd have demanded more.

loki>wolverine.text: You heal from anything? What a wonderful target for practice.
Stab away, bub. Won't stop me from guttin' you.

wolverine>loki.text: You and me, bub. Two guys nobody trusts.
Speak for yourself. Everybody trusts me. Once.

loki>headless-horseman.text: A flaming pumpkin for a head? My, what a crown.
Heh heh heh! Better than yours, trickster! Mine bites!

headless-horseman>loki.text: Heh heh heh! Are you afraid of me, godling?
I was raised in Asgard. Nothing frightens me but family dinners.

loki>raveness.text: Your raven speaks one word. Odin's ravens were far chattier.

raveness>loki.text: Nevermore shall your lies be believed.
Pity. They've been going so well for millennia.

loki>druid.text: A shapeshifter? I've been a snake, a hawk, an old woman. Your record?
Only a few. But mine bite—

druid>loki.text: Really? Not even the cat you keep turning into?

loki>duelist.text: Such fancy footwork. Pity you'll be fencing a phantom.
Phantom or prince, I'll parry your pretty pretense!

duelist>loki.text: A prince? Prove it! Parry, riposte, perform!
Princes don't perform. We watch others perform, then boo.

loki>forgemaster.text: Dwarves forged my brother's hammer. Make me something better.
Could. Won't. Ye'd stab me with it.

forgemaster>loki.text: The gold on your armor's fake, lad. I can tell from here.
Everything about me is fake. Isn't it marvelous?

loki>santa.text: You lie to every child on earth about who brings the gifts? I'm impressed.
Ho ho ho! I AM who brings the gifts, son.

santa>loki.text: Ho ho ho! You've topped the naughty list for a thousand years, son.

loki>krampus.text: You drag children off in a sack? And they call ME the villain.
They call you worse. I've heard them.

krampus>loki.text: Mischief. Lies. Stabbing your brother. I remember it all.

loki>mystic-brawler.text: The sea, the sky, and the mountain? Greedy, for a mortal.
Not greedy, brother! Chosen! They picked me!

mystic-brawler>loki.text: My ancestors don't trust you, little trickster!

duelist>cursed-pirate.text: Pirate! Put down that pistol and parry like a proper person!
Proper? Me? Ye've got the wrong lass—

cursed-pirate>duelist.text: Fancy clothes, fancy sword, fancy talk. Ye'd fetch a fine ransom, mate.
Ransom? Ridiculous! Royalty would riot to reclaim me!

duelist>gunslinger.text: A duel at dawn, dear desperado? Ten paces, then we dance?
Ten paces, then I draw. There ain't no dance.

gunslinger>duelist.text: You bring a sword to a gunfight?
Guns are gauche, gunslinger. Gracelessly, grotesquely gauche.

duelist>huntress.text: Barefoot, bare-armed, beastly! Barbaric, but bold!
Bold? Nyra can spot your colors from across the jungle.

huntress>duelist.text: You move like prey. Nyra likes prey that moves.
Prey? Preposterous! I'm the prettiest predator present.

duelist>samurai.text: A sword saint! Superb! Shall we see whose steel sings sweeter?
A blade does not sing. It decides.

samurai>duelist.text: You fight for applause. That is not a duel. It is theater.
Theater is triumph, tin-plated tortoise. Take a bow.

duelist>seraph.text: Heavenly herald! Your halo is handsome. Hardly as handsome as me.
Vanity is a sin. You wear it like a cape.

duelist>tactician.text: Hiding on hills, having henchmen handle your honor? How horribly hollow.
Honor is for duelists. I win wars.

tactician>duelist.text: One man with a sword. How quaint. I command ten thousand.
Ten thousand? Then I'll have ten thousand tiny triumphs.

duelist>vampire-lord.text: Pale, pointy, positively predatory! Pardon, madam, but you need sunlight.
And you need humility, darling. Neither of us will get it.

vampire-lord>duelist.text: Such a lively heartbeat. All that prancing must stir the blood.
Stirred, sweetened, and strictly not for sipping.

duelist>black-panther.text: A king in cat claws? Curious costume, your Majesty.
It is a suit, not a costume. Yours is the costume.

black-panther>duelist.text: Your blade is steel. My claws are vibranium.
Vibranium is valuable. Virtuosity is invaluable.

duelist>black-widow.text: Red-haired, resourceful, ruthless! A rare, remarkable rival!
Flattery. I was trained to ignore it.

black-widow>duelist.text: You announce every move out loud. That's a problem.

duelist>captain-marvel.text: Flying, flashing, fearsomely fast! Fight me on the floor, flygirl!
Flygirl? Okay, that one's actually kind of great.

captain-marvel>duelist.text: Nice cape. Doesn't it slow you down?
Capes captivate crowds, Captain. You clearly wouldn't know.

duelist>doctor-strange.text: A cloak that moves on its own? Marvelous! Mine merely makes me magnificent.
Mine has saved the universe. Yours has embroidery.

doctor-strange>duelist.text: I've seen every step you'll take before you take it.
Splendid! Then sit back and savor the show.

duelist>spider-man.text: Spry, sticky, surprisingly slippery! A splendid sparring spider!
Okay, that's a lot of S's. Are you okay?

spider-man>duelist.text: Whoa, a real sword! Can I try? Just once? I'll give it back.
Absolutely not, adolescent. Acquire your own.

duelist>scarlet-witch.text: Crimson, cryptic, captivating! Care for a courtly contest, countess?
Keep dancing. I'll decide where your feet land.

scarlet-witch>duelist.text: I could make you trip over your own feet.
Impossible. I improvise, I impress, I'm impeccable.

duelist>thor.text: A hammer? Heavy, hulking, hopelessly ham-fisted!
HA! Thou speakest strangely, little dancer! I like thee!

thor>duelist.text: Thy sword is but a needle, friend! Canst it stop Mjolnir?
Needles are nimble, noble Norseman. Hammers merely hope.

duelist>cyclops.text: Stern, strict, stiff-necked soldier! Smile, sir! Just once!
I'll smile when this is over.

cyclops>duelist.text: I've studied your footwork. Forward to strike, back to block.
Studied? Superb! Sadly, I've studied you studying me.

duelist>gambit.text: Cards? Cheap, childish conjuring! Cross swords, Cajun, if you dare.
Gambit got a staff, a deck, an' a grin. Dat's plenty, mon ami.

gambit>duelist.text: Gambit bets you trip on dat fancy footwork.
Bet big, bayou boy. Bankruptcy becomes you.

duelist>iceman.text: Frosty, frivolous, frightfully foolish! Freeze, fellow!
Freeze? Dude, that's MY line. Get your own puns.

iceman>duelist.text: I'll ice the floor. Let's see that fancy footwork now.
Slippery? Superb! Skating is simply swordplay with style.

duelist>jean-grey.text: Graceful, gifted, gorgeous Grey! Grant me a gallant bout!
Gallant? You're sweet, but she's not—

jean-grey>duelist.text: You're so sure of every step. I can feel how proud you are.

duelist>psylocke.text: Silent, sleek, sinister. Say something, sweet shinobi!
I don't waste words. You should try it.

psylocke>duelist.text: You'd be dead three times over, if I'd wanted.
Dead? Doubtful. Distracted by my dashing demeanor, doubtless.

duelist>rogue.text: Soaring southern sweetheart! Swoop down, spar a spell!
Spar? Sugar, I'll just drop on you from up here.

rogue>duelist.text: Honey, you talk more than Remy, and that's sayin' somethin'.
Remy wishes he were remotely this riveting.

duelist>storm.text: Sovereign of storms! Such stately stillness! Surely you can spar?
I do not spar. I strike, from above.

storm>duelist.text: You call this a duel? I have fought hurricanes with more grace.
Hurricanes have force, madam. Finesse is far finer.

duelist>wolverine.text: Claws? Crude, clumsy cutlery! Civilized swordsmen carry one blade.
I carry six. Do the math, bub.

wolverine>duelist.text: You talk like that on purpose, bub?

duelist>headless-horseman.text: Headless? How horribly hasty! Who handled your haircut?
Heh heh heh! Keep talking, dandy! You'll lose yours too!

headless-horseman>duelist.text: Heh heh heh! Lose your head, dandy! It's liberating!
Lose this lovely face? Laughable. Look at it.

duelist>raveness.text: Ravens, rhymes, relentless gloom! Rather ruins the room.
And your chatter, sir, has ruined the silence.

raveness>duelist.text: Nevermore shall you prance, fair fool.

duelist>druid.text: Bear, beast, or bumpkin? Be brave and pick one!

druid>duelist.text: Feline footwork? Fantastic! Finally, a fitting foe!

duelist>forgemaster.text: Plated, portly, painfully plodding! Pick up the pace, pint-size!
This armor weighs more than your ego. Barely.

forgemaster>duelist.text: That sword's thin as a toothpick. Who forged it?
A master maker. Marvelous, meticulous, and mercifully quiet.

duelist>santa.text: Jolly, jiggly, jarringly jovial! Join me for a jaunty joust!
Ho ho ho! Joust away, son. I punch.

santa>duelist.text: Ho ho ho! Naughty list, son. For vanity.

duelist>krampus.text: Chains, cloven hooves, clattering bells! A cacophonous costume, creature!

krampus>duelist.text: I remember you as a child. Always admiring yourself in the mirror.

duelist>mystic-brawler.text: Mighty, muscled, magnificently mythic! Almost as marvelous as me!
Almost? Brother, the mountains bow when I pass!

mystic-brawler>duelist.text: Hit me with that little needle, brother! I dare you!
Delighted! Delicately, deftly, dozens of times.

tactician>cursed-pirate.text: My warships outgun yours, Captain. Three broadsides to your one.

cursed-pirate>tactician.text: Yer army can't march on water, admiral.
General. And it needn't. My cannons reach the bay.

tactician>gunslinger.text: Six shots, madam? My firing line has six hundred.
Only need one. And I know which tent's yours.

gunslinger>tactician.text: Men in uniforms rode through my town once. Yours?
If they were mine, madam, your town wouldn't still be standing.

tactician>huntress.text: A tiger. I'd trade an entire cavalry regiment for her.
Nyra's not for trade. Your horses are for dinner.

huntress>tactician.text: Everything follows orders, madam. Some just need more artillery.

tactician>samurai.text: One swordsman against my regiments. Admirable. Pointless.
One blade with honor outweighs a thousand without.

samurai>tactician.text: You send others to die while you watch. Shameful.
I send them to win. Dying is their own mistake.

tactician>seraph.text: Command of the skies, madam. Your only advantage. I've planned around it.
You planned for wings. Not for heaven.

seraph>tactician.text: Generals don't kneel. We accept surrenders. Yours, ideally.

tactician>vampire-lord.text: My men march by day, and my camp stays lit all night.
How thoughtful, general. I do like to see my dinner.

vampire-lord>tactician.text: So many soldiers. A marching banquet, general.
A banquet that fires back in volleys, madam.

tactician>black-panther.text: A king on the front line? Reckless command.
A king of Wakanda asks nothing he would not do himself.

black-panther>tactician.text: I will use every weapon I have to protect Wakanda.

tactician>black-widow.text: Every army needs intelligence. Defect, agent. I pay better.
Everyone says that. Then they check the budget.

black-widow>tactician.text: One of your scouts sold me your battle map.
Of course he did. I gave it to him. It's wrong.

tactician>captain-marvel.text: Anti-air batteries on the north flank. I prepared for you, Captain.

captain-marvel>tactician.text: I've led fleets in space. You lead guys with rifles.
And yet, Captain, you came down to fight them.

tactician>doctor-strange.text: A sorcerer on the field. Noted. Revising the battle plan.
Revise all you like. I've already seen the new one.

doctor-strange>tactician.text: Your strategy is sound. Unfortunately, reality is negotiable.
Then I negotiate with cannons, Doctor. They're very persuasive.

tactician>spider-man.text: Recruit! Stand up straight. You'd make a fine scout.
Uh, thanks? I can't enlist, though. I have homework.

spider-man>tactician.text: Whoa, a real general! Do you, like, yell a lot?
Only when my orders are ignored. So, rarely. And very loudly.

tactician>scarlet-witch.text: Unpredictable forces, madam. I have a contingency for you too.
Then I'll change what your contingency means.

scarlet-witch>tactician.text: I could erase your army with a thought.
Then I'd call up the reserves. There are always reserves, madam.

tactician>thor.text: A god with a hammer. Excellent. My cannons need a proper test.
HA! Bring thy cannons! Mjolnir hungers for iron!

thor>tactician.text: A general! Where is thy steed, thine axe, thy war song?
Behind me. Ten thousand of each. Minus the singing.

tactician>cyclops.text: A field commander. At last, someone here who can read a map.
I read yours. Your left flank is exposed.

cyclops>tactician.text: Leaders fight beside their team, not behind it.
Leaders survive to lead, son. Your team knows that too.

tactician>gambit.text: I don't play the odds, Cajun. I arrange them.
Den Gambit just rearranged 'em back, général.

gambit>tactician.text: Wanna bet on who walks away, général?
I never bet on a battle that's already decided.

tactician>iceman.text: Frozen rivers make excellent bridges. My infantry thanks you.
Oh cool, I'm infrastructure now. Literally cool.

iceman>tactician.text: Dude, you're way too stiff. Chill out a little.
I've won winter campaigns, boy. Your cold doesn't frighten my men.

tactician>jean-grey.text: Read my plan, telepath. Knowing it changes nothing.

jean-grey>tactician.text: Thousands of soldiers in your head. You know every name?
Every name, every rank. Command is memory, madam.

tactician>psylocke.text: Assassins are cheap. I've hired dozens and outlived them all.

psylocke>tactician.text: Your sentries were asleep when I walked in.
Decoys, madam. The real ones are watching you now.

tactician>rogue.text: Flight, strength, borrowed talents. You'd be a formidable soldier.
Sugar, I don't take orders. Ask anybody who's tried.

rogue>tactician.text: One touch, and I'd know every plan in that head.
Then you'd find the plan where you touch me. It ends badly.

tactician>storm.text: Weather wins wars, madam. Join me, and I'll give you an army.
The sky has no ranks, general. And I answer to no one.

storm>tactician.text: Your army cannot march through my storm.
My engineers built roads through monsoons, madam. Rain is a scheduling issue.

tactician>wolverine.text: A veteran. I can tell from here. Which wars?

wolverine>tactician.text: Guys like you plan the war. Guys like me bleed in it.
And guys like you always come back. That's why I hire them.

tactician>headless-horseman.text: Cavalry without a head. Every general's nightmare.
Heh heh heh! Every general's LAST nightmare!

headless-horseman>tactician.text: Heh heh heh! Your men are trembling, general!
Good. A trembling soldier never sleeps on watch.

tactician>raveness.text: Your raven would make a fine messenger for the front.
He carries only one message. Nevermore.

raveness>tactician.text: Nevermore dines on every battlefield you leave behind.
Then he's been eating well for years, madam.

tactician>druid.text: A bear to hold the line, a cat to pursue. A one-man army.
Not one man. A whole forest—

druid>tactician.text: Your army cut down half this forest for firewood.
And the other half for barricades. War is expensive.

tactician>forgemaster.text: Superb armor, smith. I'll order ten thousand suits.
Ten thousand? Lad, I make one a year.

forgemaster>tactician.text: Factory rifles and tin helmets? Your whole army's scrap, lad.
Scrap that outnumbers you a thousand to one, master smith.

tactician>santa.text: One night, every house, not a single delay. Flawless logistics.
Ho ho ho! Took me centuries to plan, general!

santa>tactician.text: Ho ho ho! Every boy wants toy soldiers for Christmas!
I got mine. Then I got real ones.

tactician>krampus.text: Horns, chains, a sack. Your intimidation tactics are outdated.
And yet your soldiers still check under their beds.

krampus>tactician.text: I remember every soldier you sent to die.
So do I. Write it down. History will want it.

tactician>mystic-brawler.text: Your island? One order, and it's gone from every map.
Then the ocean will raise me a new one!

mystic-brawler>tactician.text: Hit me with everything you've got, general! It all comes back!
Everything is two hundred cannons. Let's see how much comes back.

cursed-pirate>gunslinger.text: Revenge, eh? I sailed for revenge once. Look where it got me.

gunslinger>cursed-pirate.text: Your poster says wanted, dead or alive.
Dead or alive, eh? What if I'm—

cursed-pirate>huntress.text: Here, kitty! Every ship needs a cat for the rats.
Nyra doesn't catch rats. She catches captains.

huntress>cursed-pirate.text: You smell like salt and something dead.
Salt's the sea, love. The dead part's a family heirloom.

cursed-pirate>samurai.text: Honor, eh? Can't spend it, can't drink it. Useless, mate.
It is the only treasure no one can steal.

samurai>cursed-pirate.text: You cheat death itself. That is the deepest dishonor.
Cheat? Nay, mate, I just refused to pay—

cursed-pirate>seraph.text: An angel! Tell me, lass, is there rum up there?
There is judgment. You will find it soon enough.

seraph>cursed-pirate.text: Your soul is bound to cursed gold. Heaven rejects you.
Heaven rejected me years ago, love. Hell sent me back too.

cursed-pirate>vampire-lord.text: Ye can't die either? Cheers, mate. To never dyin'!
I chose eternity, darling. You were merely cursed with it.

vampire-lord>cursed-pirate.text: I wonder what cursed blood tastes like.
Seawater and rum, love. Mostly rum.

cursed-pirate>black-panther.text: A whole kingdom of treasure, hidden away? Point me the way in, mate.
Wakanda has hidden it for centuries. From better pirates than you.

black-panther>cursed-pirate.text: Your gold is cursed. Why not let it go?
Tried, mate. Threw it overboard. Woke up holdin' it.

cursed-pirate>black-widow.text: A spy, eh? Bet ye've got a treasure map hidden somewhere.
I've got files. They're worth more, and they don't rust.

black-widow>cursed-pirate.text: Nobody outruns their past. Trust me.
Aye, mine follows me everywhere, lass—

cursed-pirate>captain-marvel.text: Ye sail the stars, lass? What's the wind like up there?
There isn't any. That's what engines are for.

captain-marvel>cursed-pirate.text: Pirates, huh? I've fought space pirates. Way better ships.
Better ships, aye. But did they come back from the dead?

cursed-pirate>doctor-strange.text: A doctor! Take a look at me, Doc. How long've I got?
Medically? You died years ago. Mystically, it's complicated.

doctor-strange>cursed-pirate.text: That curse is ancient. And it's feeding on you.
Aye, and I'm feedin' on it. Fair trade, Doc.

cursed-pirate>spider-man.text: Ye climb like a cabin boy up the riggin'!
Thanks! I think? Is cabin boy a good job?

spider-man>cursed-pirate.text: Wait, you're a real pirate? Like, a real one? That's so cool.
Aye, lad, and a real ghost too—

cursed-pirate>scarlet-witch.text: Could ye break me curse, lass? Just askin'.
I could. You might not like who's left underneath.

scarlet-witch>cursed-pirate.text: Your curse has a pulse. I can feel it.
Then it's healthier than me, lass.

cursed-pirate>thor.text: A god who drinks! Finally, a proper mate!
HA! And when I defeat thee, thy rum is mine!

thor>cursed-pirate.text: Hela would claim thee, pirate! Thou art half dead already!
Half, aye. Tell her the other half's busy.

cursed-pirate>cyclops.text: Nice spyglass, lad. Built right into yer face.
It's a visor. And you don't want me looking at you without it.

cyclops>cursed-pirate.text: You fight with no plan. Just chaos and cannonballs.
Aye! And it's worked every time so far!

cursed-pirate>gambit.text: A card sharp! Fancy a game for me gold?
Gambit don' touch cursed gold, chère. Bad luck.

gambit>cursed-pirate.text: Gambit likes a woman wit' a little danger, chère.

cursed-pirate>iceman.text: Ye're made of ice, lad? Me rum could use a cube.
Hey, I'm not a mini-fridge. ...Okay, one cube.

iceman>cursed-pirate.text: A ghost pirate? That's a chilling career choice.
Wasn't a choice, lad. The gold chose me.

cursed-pirate>jean-grey.text: A fire inside ye, lass? I've a curse. Watch—

jean-grey>cursed-pirate.text: You don't even fight your curse, do you—
Fight it? Lass, I AM the curse—

cursed-pirate>psylocke.text: A ninja! Can ye sneak onto a ship without one creak?
I already did. Yours. Last night.

psylocke>cursed-pirate.text: You laugh a lot for someone who's dead.
Death's a long voyage, lass. Might as well enjoy it.

cursed-pirate>rogue.text: Gloves in this heat, lass? What're ye hidin'?
Same as you, sugar. Somethin' nobody should touch.

rogue>cursed-pirate.text: Cursed, huh? Guess we're both stuck with what we got, sugar.
Aye. But mine came with treasure. Yours came with gloves.

cursed-pirate>storm.text: Blow me a good wind, lass, and I'll share me treasure.
I do not trade winds for cursed gold.

storm>cursed-pirate.text: I have sunk ships with a single storm.
Aye, mine's been sunk before, lass—

cursed-pirate>wolverine.text: Ye can't die either, mate? Welcome to the club.
Ain't a club, lady. It's a sentence.

wolverine>cursed-pirate.text: You smell like rum and a graveyard.
And you smell like rum and a bar fight. Cheers.

cursed-pirate>headless-horseman.text: Lost yer head, mate? I lost me whole life. Beat that.
Heh heh heh! Lost it and kept laughing! Beat THAT, pirate!

headless-horseman>cursed-pirate.text: Heh heh heh! A fellow corpse who won't lie down!
Lie down? Mate, the grave's got a waitin' list.

cursed-pirate>raveness.text: Yer bird's been circlin' me ship for days, lass.
He knows a wreck when he sees one.

raveness>cursed-pirate.text: Nevermore shall you see the shore.
Lass, I never liked the shore anyway.

cursed-pirate>druid.text: A beast-man! Let's see who's scarier—

druid>cursed-pirate.text: The sea's no place for a creature like me—
Then stay ashore, mate, before I—

cursed-pirate>forgemaster.text: Fine blade, dwarf. I'll trade ye a chest of gold for it.
Cursed gold for dwarven steel? I'm no fool, lass.

forgemaster>cursed-pirate.text: A cutlass and a pistol? Rust and luck. That's all ye've got.
And a curse, mate. Beats any armor ye've ever made.

cursed-pirate>santa.text: Ye come down chimneys, I come aboard ships. We're both breakin' in, mate.
Ho ho ho! Difference is, dear, I leave presents. You take them.

santa>cursed-pirate.text: Ho ho ho! Naughty list, captain! Year after year after year!
Every single year, old man? Where's me trophy?

cursed-pirate>krampus.text: Horns, chains and a sack? Ye'd make a grand figurehead, mate.
And you'd make a fine anchor. You already know how to sink.

krampus>cursed-pirate.text: Your plundering is on my list. The long one.
Only the plundering, mate? I've done worse—

cursed-pirate>mystic-brawler.text: Word is there's treasure buried on yer island, mate.
Dig on my island, sister, and the mountain buries YOU.

mystic-brawler>cursed-pirate.text: The ocean is my ancestors' gift, sister! What did she give you?
A curse, mate. She plays favorites.

gunslinger>huntress.text: Out west, we shoot big cats that wander into town.
Nyra doesn't wander. She hunts. Towns included.

huntress>gunslinger.text: You smell like gunpowder and dust.
Occupational hazard. You smell like wet cat.

gunslinger>samurai.text: My pa died with your blade in him. I came to return it.
Shoot me, then. And let his true killer walk free.

samurai>gunslinger.text: Lower your pistols. I did not kill your father.
Then you got nothin' to fear. Draw.

gunslinger>seraph.text: You judge sinners? Saves me the trouble of huntin' 'em.
I judge all. Even vengeful little gunslingers.

seraph>gunslinger.text: Vengeance belongs to heaven, not to you.
Heaven's been takin' its sweet time.

gunslinger>vampire-lord.text: Heard you move faster than a bullet.
Faster than the girl firing it, darling.

vampire-lord>gunslinger.text: Such a hard life, darling. Your blood must be bitter.
Taste it and find out. It'll be your last meal.

gunslinger>black-panther.text: You got a whole country behind you. I got two pistols.
And still you came. That, I respect.

black-panther>gunslinger.text: I chased vengeance once. It left me empty.
Then I'll be empty. And he'll be buried.

gunslinger>black-widow.text: Your ledger's red. Mine's got one name left on it.
Careful. After the last name, you find out who you are.

black-widow>gunslinger.text: Two pistols, one target. You'd have made a decent operative.
Ain't nobody's operative. I ride alone.

gunslinger>captain-marvel.text: You glow like a lantern. Easy shot at night.
Try it. Bullets melt before they reach me.

captain-marvel>gunslinger.text: I break the sound barrier before breakfast, cowgirl.
Then I'll aim where you're gonna be.

gunslinger>doctor-strange.text: You see the future, Doc? Tell me if I get him.
You do. You won't like what comes after.

doctor-strange>gunslinger.text: Pistols against a sorcerer? Bold choice.
Your spells need both those shaky hands, Doc. Mine need one finger.

gunslinger>spider-man.text: Kid, you're too young to be out here.
Everybody says that! Right before I save them.

spider-man>gunslinger.text: Whoa, a real cowboy! Do you say "yeehaw"?
Once. Didn't like how it sounded.

gunslinger>scarlet-witch.text: Heard you can bring folks back. Can you bring back my pa?
I could. He would not be your father anymore.

scarlet-witch>gunslinger.text: Your grief is loud. I know that sound.

gunslinger>thor.text: Big fella with a hammer. You ever lose a fight?
Never willingly! And never to a tiny pistol!

thor>gunslinger.text: Thy weapons roar, gunslinger! Like little thunder!

gunslinger>cyclops.text: You shoot from the eyes? Guess we're both quick draws.

cyclops>gunslinger.text: You work alone. That's how people get killed.
Workin' with others is how people get betrayed.

gunslinger>gambit.text: A card sharp. I've shot men for cheatin' at poker.
Gambit never cheats, chère. He just never loses.

gambit>gunslinger.text: Gambit bets you can't hit a card in de air, chère.

gunslinger>iceman.text: Desert's hot, kid. You'll be a puddle by noon.
Then I'll be the coolest puddle in the West.

iceman>gunslinger.text: Revenge is best served cold, right? I can totally help!
I serve mine hot. Straight from the barrel.

gunslinger>jean-grey.text: Heard there's a fire in you. There's fire in gunpowder too.

jean-grey>gunslinger.text: You haven't slept a full night in years, have you?
Sleep's for folks with nobody left to find.

gunslinger>psylocke.text: Heard you were an assassin. Who hired you last?
Nobody who's still alive to answer.

psylocke>gunslinger.text: Your finger twitches right before you draw.
Yeah. Nobody's lived long enough to notice.

gunslinger>rogue.text: You're from the South, ain't ya? Long way from home.
Same as you, sugar. Home don't want us back.

rogue>gunslinger.text: Revenge ain't gonna fill that hole, sugar. Trust me.
Won't fill it. But it'll make it quieter.

gunslinger>storm.text: Out west, folks pray for rain. Never for you.
They should. I answer more often than their gods.

storm>gunslinger.text: Lightning is faster than any bullet.
Lightning don't pick its target. I do.

gunslinger>wolverine.text: You look like a man who's buried a lot of friends.
Every one of 'em, kid. Don't be next.

wolverine>gunslinger.text: Revenge, huh? Been there, kid. Nothin' at the end.
Then I'll see that for myself.

gunslinger>headless-horseman.text: Rode a hundred miles of haunted trail to find you.
Heh heh heh! And now you'll ride it forever!

headless-horseman>gunslinger.text: Heh heh heh! Can you shoot what you can't see, cowgirl?
Your pumpkin's lit up bright. I see just fine.

gunslinger>raveness.text: Your bird's followed me from town to town.
He follows death. You simply lead him there.

raveness>gunslinger.text: Nevermore sings of death, gunslinger. Like your pistols.
Difference is, mine only sing once.

gunslinger>druid.text: Out west, a bear hide's worth ten dollars.

druid>gunslinger.text: You track by the trail. I track by scent.
Then you already know I've been here an hour.

gunslinger>forgemaster.text: You make fine steel, dwarf. Ever made a gun?
Guns? Loud, cheap, and they jam. I make things that last.

forgemaster>gunslinger.text: Two pistols and a belt of lead? Where's your armor, lass?
Dead men don't hit back. Don't need any.

gunslinger>santa.text: You ever give a girl her father back for Christmas?
Ho... ho. No, dear. Some gifts even I can't give.

santa>gunslinger.text: Ho ho ho! Naughty list, young lady! All that shooting!

gunslinger>krampus.text: You punish the wicked. So why's the man who killed my pa still breathin'?
Because I am saving him. For last.

krampus>gunslinger.text: My list has your name on it, gunslinger. In red.
Then put the man who killed my pa above me.

gunslinger>mystic-brawler.text: You talk big, mister. Let's see if you're as fast as you are loud.
Fast? Sister, I once raced a tidal wave. And won!

mystic-brawler>gunslinger.text: Put the pistols down, sister! Fight me with your fists!
Fists are for folks who ain't in a hurry.

seraph>huntress.text: You guard your jungle as heaven guards the world. You are seen.
Nyra sees you too. She's deciding if you're prey.

huntress>seraph.text: Nyra wants to know if angels taste like chicken.
Tell her to look up. That is as close as she will get.

seraph>samurai.text: Your honor is a light of its own, warrior. Heaven notices.
Then heaven will see me fight with it.

samurai>seraph.text: You fight from above. A true warrior stands on the ground.
I stand where heaven places me. Humble yourself, and look up.

seraph>vampire-lord.text: Creature of the night. My blades were forged for you.
Darling, I've survived priests, sunrises and bad wine.

vampire-lord>seraph.text: An angel. I've always wondered how holy blood tastes.
Like fire. You will not live for the second sip.

seraph>black-panther.text: A king who shields his people. Heaven honors such kings.
Then let us fight as honored foes.

black-panther>seraph.text: In Wakanda, the gods walk among us. Do you?
I walk above you, king. Yet I see you clearly.

seraph>black-widow.text: Your ledger is drenched in red. Heaven has read every page.
Then heaven knows I'm working on it.

black-widow>seraph.text: You judge everyone. Who judges you?
The hand that sent me. It has not judged you lost. Yet.

seraph>captain-marvel.text: You fly without wings and shine without heaven's blessing.
Didn't need a blessing. Just a crash and some attitude.

captain-marvel>seraph.text: Race you to the clouds, angel.
The clouds are beneath me. Still, you fly well. For a mortal.

seraph>doctor-strange.text: Your magic is borrowed from powers you do not understand.
Says the angel running someone else's errand.

doctor-strange>seraph.text: I've faced demons, gods and things beyond reality. You're... bright.
Avert your gaze, sorcerer. You are squinting.

seraph>spider-man.text: So young, and still you stand against evil. Heaven is pleased.
Wait, really? Can heaven, like, tell my mom?

spider-man>seraph.text: Whoa, real wings! Are you, like, an actual angel?
Avert your eyes, child. I would not blind a good heart.

seraph>scarlet-witch.text: You bend creation itself. That right belongs to heaven.

scarlet-witch>seraph.text: I could make you mortal. Just for a moment.
Even mortal, I would remain the hand of God.

seraph>thor.text: A god of thunder who fights for the weak. Heaven respects that.
HA! And I respect thy wings! Now, have at thee!

thor>seraph.text: Winged warrior! Art thou one of Odin's Valkyries?

seraph>cyclops.text: You hide your eyes. Wise. Mine cannot be looked upon either.
Mine can't look at anything without destroying it. Different problem.

cyclops>seraph.text: Your light's an advantage. I've already planned around it.
You planned around the sun. It still rose.

seraph>gambit.text: A thief and a gambler. Every sin is counted, Cajun.
Den count 'em twice, chère. Gambit likes big numbers.

gambit>seraph.text: Gambit bets even angels got a weakness, chère.
Mine is patience. Yours has run out.

seraph>iceman.text: You jest in the face of heaven, boy.
Hey, somebody's gotta lighten the mood up there.

iceman>seraph.text: Is it hot in here, or is that just your holy presence?
It is my presence, boy. Enjoy it. You will melt soon.

seraph>jean-grey.text: The fire within you is no gift of heaven.

jean-grey>seraph.text: Your mind is so certain. There isn't one doubt in it.
Doubt is for those who cannot see the hand of God.

seraph>psylocke.text: You were an assassin. Heaven does not forget blood.
Neither do I. That's why I'm good at it.

psylocke>seraph.text: Your light blinds. The dark doesn't need eyes.
Then I will burn away the dark.

seraph>rogue.text: Your gift is a burden. Heaven sees how you carry it.
Then heaven coulda given it to somebody else, sugar.

rogue>seraph.text: Heaven never did much for me, sugar. Why start now?
It did. It let you choose the light.

seraph>storm.text: You were worshipped as a goddess. A blasphemy.
I never asked for worship. Unlike you.

storm>seraph.text: My storms will ground those wings.
Your storms have never reached where I fly.

seraph>wolverine.text: You have killed more than you can count, beast.
Get in line, angel. Plenty've judged me. I'm still here.

wolverine>seraph.text: Get that light outta my face, angel.
It is not for your face. It is for your sins.

seraph>headless-horseman.text: A soul that fled judgment. You will not flee again.
Heh heh heh! Catch me first, birdie!

headless-horseman>seraph.text: Heh heh heh! Holy light, eh? Let's see it light my pumpkin!
It will burn you hollow. Hollower.

seraph>raveness.text: Your raven feeds on souls meant for heaven.
Heaven was late. He was hungry.

raveness>seraph.text: Nevermore shall your light touch me.
Light does not ask permission, witch.

seraph>druid.text: Bear, cat, man. Heaven made every shape you wear, druid.
Then heaven won't mind which one wins.

druid>seraph.text: The wild doesn't need your heaven.
Heaven made the wild, druid. You tend it well.

seraph>forgemaster.text: Your armor is thick, dwarf. It will not hide you from my light.
Didn't forge it to hide, lass. Polished it this mornin'. Shine away.

forgemaster>seraph.text: Those blades of yours. Who forged 'em? Not bad work.
Heaven forged them. "Not bad" is blasphemy.

seraph>santa.text: You bring joy to the innocent. Heaven smiles upon you, old man.
Ho ho ho! Then maybe heaven could help carry the sack!

santa>seraph.text: Ho ho ho! Have you been good this year, angel?
I am the definition of good.

seraph>krampus.text: You punish children. Heaven will punish you.
Then we are in the same business.

krampus>seraph.text: Even angels have sins. I remember yours.

seraph>mystic-brawler.text: Your ancestors watch over you. Heaven watches over them.
Then we've got a crowd, sister! Let's give 'em a show!

mystic-brawler>seraph.text: Shine all you want, sister! I've stared down the sun!
The sun is merely my lantern.

druid>huntress.text: Your tiger trusts you. That's rare. Respect it.

huntress>druid.text: Nyra says you smell like three different animals.
She's right. Want to meet the biggest—

druid>samurai.text: You meditate before battle. I sleep through winter. Same idea.
Stillness is the root of every strike. Yes.

samurai>druid.text: Show me your true face, shapeshifter. I will not fight a mask.
Every face is true. This one just talks more.

druid>vampire-lord.text: Nature ends everything. You're long overdue.
Darling, I've been overdue for centuries. Nature keeps waiting.

vampire-lord>druid.text: Animal blood. How rustic. I suppose you'll do.

druid>black-panther.text: You wear the panther. I become—
Bast chose me. Who chose you?

black-panther>druid.text: Wakanda's jungle is sacred. Do you protect yours?
With teeth, when I have to.

druid>black-widow.text: You smell like the city. Smoke and secrets.
And you smell like a zoo. We all have jobs.

black-widow>druid.text: Animals are easy to read. Fear, hunger, anger.
People too. You're somewhere between fear and anger.

druid>captain-marvel.text: I can't turn into a bird. So you'll have to come down.
Or I just blast you from up here.

captain-marvel>druid.text: Bear, cat... ever tried being something that flies?

druid>doctor-strange.text: Your magic comes from books. Mine comes from the ground.
Mine comes from dimensions your ground has never seen.

doctor-strange>druid.text: I could make you a bear permanently. Save you the effort.

druid>spider-man.text: A spider that talks. Nature surprises me every day.
Wait, are you gonna turn into a bird and eat me?

spider-man>druid.text: So you're, like, part bear? Do you eat honey? That's a real question.
Only when the bees aren't looking.

druid>scarlet-witch.text: You bend nature. Nature always bends back.
Not when I'm the one bending.

scarlet-witch>druid.text: I could lock you in one shape. Forever.

druid>thor.text: Your thunder scares the animals in my forest.
Then let them cheer instead! 'Tis only I!

thor>druid.text: A shapeshifter! Like my brother! Art thou also a liar?
Animals don't lie. Neither do I.

druid>cyclops.text: You lead a team. I lead a pack, when I need one.
My team follows orders. Packs follow whoever's strongest.

cyclops>druid.text: Bear to defend, cat to strike. I've read your pattern.
Nature changes its pattern every season.

druid>gambit.text: Your swamps are loud with frogs. I miss them.
Come visit, mon ami. Gambit knows de best gumbo.

gambit>druid.text: Gambit bets on de cat, not de bear.

druid>iceman.text: Winter is part of nature. You're just early.
Early? I'm, like, way ahead of schedule.

iceman>druid.text: A bear, huh? Want me to help you hibernate?

druid>jean-grey.text: It's all instinct now. And she's—

jean-grey>druid.text: Your mind is so calm. She hates calm—

druid>psylocke.text: You move like a cat. Almost.

psylocke>druid.text: Which mind do I cut? The man's, or the beast's?

druid>rogue.text: You fly alone a lot. Even birds fly in flocks.
Birds don't hurt what they touch, sugar.

rogue>druid.text: A bear and a cat? Sugar, you're a whole petting zoo.
Pet the cat if you like. The bear's not for petting.

druid>storm.text: Your rain feeds my forest. Thank you.
Then your forest will forgive what comes next.

storm>druid.text: The wild answers to the storm.
The wild answers to nobody. It just survives you.

druid>wolverine.text: You fight like an animal. I respect that.
Don't. Animals don't choose. I did.

wolverine>druid.text: A bear, huh? Fought one up in Canada once.

druid>headless-horseman.text: The animals flee when you ride through my forest.
Heh heh heh! So do the people! So does EVERYONE!

headless-horseman>druid.text: Heh heh heh! Can you turn into something with no head?
No. But my bear can crack a pumpkin.

druid>raveness.text: Ravens belong to the wild. Yours belongs to death.
Death is the wildest thing of all.

raveness>druid.text: Nevermore feasts in your forest every winter.
Winter takes what it needs. Spring takes it back.

druid>forgemaster.text: Your mines poison my rivers, dwarf.
Your rivers rust my tools. We're even.

forgemaster>druid.text: Dwarves build things that last a thousand years. What do druids build?

druid>santa.text: Your reindeer look tired, old man.
Ho ho ho! One night a year, son. They'll manage!

santa>druid.text: Ho ho ho! What does a bear want for Christmas?

druid>krampus.text: You're wild too, goat. But your wild is cruel.
Cruel is just winter being honest.

krampus>druid.text: Winter is mine, druid. Your forest sleeps in my sack.
And wakes up every spring. Without asking you.

druid>mystic-brawler.text: The sea, the sky, the mountain. You're a whole world, brother.
And you're a whole forest, brother! Together we're a planet!

mystic-brawler>druid.text: Show me your mightiest beast, brother!
It's the one that knows when not to fight.

raveness>huntress.text: Nevermore hunts souls, huntress. Your tiger merely hunts flesh.

huntress>raveness.text: He is counting her lives. She has fewer than she thinks.

raveness>samurai.text: Nevermore shall you grow old, warrior. Honor dies young.
A brief life with honor outlasts a long one without.

samurai>raveness.text: You hide behind a bird. Face me yourself.
Nevermore do I stand alone, warrior. He is my blade.

raveness>vampire-lord.text: Nevermore shall we see the sun. Yet you feast, and I mourn.
I stopped mourning the sun centuries ago, darling. Do try it.

vampire-lord>raveness.text: Such a gloomy little thing. Do you ever dance, darling?

raveness>black-panther.text: Nevermore shall your ancestors whisper to you. Mine fell silent long ago.
Mine will whisper as long as Wakanda stands.

black-panther>raveness.text: Your raven hunts from the shadows. So do panthers.
Then let us see whose shadow swallows whose.

raveness>black-widow.text: Nevermore shall your buried names rest, spy. Do they knock at midnight?

black-widow>raveness.text: Nice bird. Is it trained, or just creepy?

raveness>captain-marvel.text: Nevermore shall a star burn forever. Not even you.

captain-marvel>raveness.text: Your bird's gonna have a hard time keeping up with me.
He has kept pace with death itself. You are slower.

raveness>doctor-strange.text: Nevermore came tapping at your sanctum last night, sorcerer.
I heard. I chose not to answer. I've read the poem.

doctor-strange>raveness.text: That bird isn't natural. What dimension did it crawl out of?
The dark between all of yours.

raveness>spider-man.text: Nevermore shall your young heart beat so loudly, child.
Okay, super creepy. Can we, like, turn on a light?

spider-man>raveness.text: Is that a raven? Like the poem? We read that in school!
Then you know how it ends, child.

raveness>scarlet-witch.text: Nevermore shall we forget what we lost, sister.
I don't grieve anymore. I rewrite.
