scarlet-witch>raveness.text: I could make your raven sing like a songbird.
Then you would hear the saddest song of all.

raveness>thor.text: Nevermore shall your father's ravens bring good news, thunderer.
HA! They sing of my glory daily!

thor>raveness.text: Two ravens sit upon my father's shoulders! Thou hast only one!
One is enough, when he is hungry.

raveness>cyclops.text: Nevermore shall you see the world in color, soldier.
Says the woman in black with a pet raven.

cyclops>raveness.text: I can't stop your raven. So I'll stop the witch.
Nevermore, soldier. He will not allow it.

raveness>gambit.text: Nevermore shall your luck hold, gambler. I have read your fate.
Fate's just a card nobody's flipped yet, chère.

gambit>raveness.text: Gambit got a card for you, chère. De Queen of Spades.
Death's own card. You flatter me.

raveness>iceman.text: Hey, somebody's gotta keep winter fun.

iceman>raveness.text: You're so gloomy. Wanna make a snowman together?
Only if it melts slowly. I enjoy watching things fade.

raveness>jean-grey.text: Nevermore waits, phoenix. Your kind rises. Mine is patient.

jean-grey>raveness.text: Your mind is so quiet. Like a house after a funeral.
Then do wipe your feet, telepath.

raveness>psylocke.text: Nevermore shall we share the dark, assassin. One of us must leave.

psylocke>raveness.text: Your raven's mind is darker than yours.
He carries what I cannot bear to remember.

raveness>rogue.text: Nevermore shall you touch another soul. How exquisitely tragic.
Don't write a poem about it, sugar.

rogue>raveness.text: Sugar, you look like somebody who ain't laughed in years.

raveness>storm.text: Nevermore flies best in the rain. Summon your storm.
Then he will fly into my lightning.

storm>raveness.text: Your raven cannot outfly my winds.
He does not fight them. He rides them to you.

raveness>wolverine.text: Nevermore shall you die. How I envy you. How I pity you.

wolverine>raveness.text: That bird's been starin' at me for an hour.
He smells the graves you carry.

raveness>headless-horseman.text: Nevermore shall you find your head, rider. I wrote a poem about it.
Heh heh heh! Is it scary? Tell me it's scary!

headless-horseman>raveness.text: Heh heh heh! Two horrors in one night! Shall we haunt a village together?
You haunt with laughter. I haunt with silence. Silence lingers longer.

raveness>forgemaster.text: Nevermore shall your treasures shine for you, dwarf. Only upon your tomb.
Keep that bird away from my metals, lass. Every last one of 'em.

forgemaster>raveness.text: A raven? Bad omen in the mines, lass. Every miner knows it.

raveness>santa.text: Nevermore came down your chimney last night. He left no gift.
Ho ho ho! Then he's on the naughty list, dear!

santa>raveness.text: Ho ho ho! What would you like for Christmas, dear?
A silent night. A truly silent one.

raveness>krampus.text: Nevermore shall the wicked sleep soundly. You and I see to that.
Careful, witch. The sack does not check who is helping.

krampus>raveness.text: Your raven would make a fine addition to my sack.
He has been in far darker places than your sack.

raveness>mystic-brawler.text: Nevermore shall my ancestors walk beside me, as yours do.
Then call them down, sister! There's room at the feast!

mystic-brawler>raveness.text: Your bird looks sad, sister! Bring him to my island. The fish will cheer him up!
He does not eat fish. He eats hope.

krampus>huntress.text: Your cat would make a fine rug for my lair.
Nyra would make a fine meal of your goat legs.

huntress>krampus.text: Nyra doesn't like your smell. Wet goat.
Nobody likes it. That is the point.

krampus>samurai.text: I remember the day you lost your honor, samurai.

samurai>krampus.text: A demon wearing bells. How do you ever catch anyone?
They hear me coming. That is the fun.

krampus>vampire-lord.text: Centuries of naughtiness. My sack has been waiting for you.
Darling, I don't fit in sacks. I prefer coffins.

vampire-lord>krampus.text: A creature who only comes out in winter. How seasonal, darling.
Winter nights are long. Long enough for both of us.

krampus>black-panther.text: Kings are the naughtiest children of all.
Then you have never met a king who serves his people.

black-panther>krampus.text: A demon who punishes children. Wakanda would never allow you.
Every land has naughty children, king. Even yours.

krampus>black-widow.text: I remember a little girl from the Red Room. Very naughty.
She had no choice. Go take the ones who trained her.

black-widow>krampus.text: Bells on your chains. Terrible for sneaking.
I do not sneak. I arrive.

krampus>captain-marvel.text: Your pilot friends broke curfew every night. So did you.

captain-marvel>krampus.text: I've fought aliens way scarier than you.
Aliens do not know where you sleep.

krampus>doctor-strange.text: A sorcerer. I keep a special sack for those who meddle with time.
I've been trapped in far worse dimensions. I escaped.

doctor-strange>krampus.text: I've banished demons far older than you.
None of them knew what you did last winter.

krampus>spider-man.text: Sneaking out at night. Lying to your mother. Naughty boy.
Okay, how do you know that?! Who told you?!

spider-man>krampus.text: Dude, you're, like, the scariest Christmas thing ever.
Thank you. I work very hard on it.

krampus>scarlet-witch.text: You broke the world's rules, witch. Rule-breakers belong to me.
Then come collect. Reality might not let you leave.

scarlet-witch>krampus.text: I could turn you into a harmless little toy.
I have a sack full of those. They bite.

krampus>thor.text: Loud, reckless, disobedient. You were a terrible child, thunderer.
HA! And a magnificent one! Ask my father!

thor>krampus.text: A winter beast! We have those in Asgard! I slew three!
Then I am the fourth. The one who slays back.

krampus>cyclops.text: Always the good boy. Always following the rules. How boring.

cyclops>krampus.text: You punish kids. I teach them. We're not the same.
And yet some of your students are on my list.

krampus>gambit.text: I remember every card you ever hid up your sleeve, Cajun.
Den you know Gambit got one more, mon ami.

gambit>krampus.text: Gambit bets you got a soft spot somewhere, goat.
Only in my sack. Saved for you.

krampus>iceman.text: Winter belongs to me, boy. You are trespassing.
Relax, I brought extra snow. Consider it rent.

iceman>krampus.text: Hey, Krampus! Wanna make snow angels?

krampus>jean-grey.text: The phoenix inside you has been very naughty.
I know. I'm so sorry for—

jean-grey>krampus.text: There's no joy in your mind at all. Only winter.
Winter is a kind of joy. Ask the wolves.

krampus>psylocke.text: You kill quietly. I appreciate a quiet worker.

psylocke>krampus.text: Your sack would never hold me. I'd slip out.
They all say that. Then they reach the bottom.

krampus>rogue.text: You ran away from home, girl. Naughty.
Home ran from me first, sugar.

rogue>krampus.text: Heard you drag off bad kids. I was one.
I know. You were the one who got away.

krampus>storm.text: Your blizzards help my work. Thank you, weather queen.
My snow is not for your cruelty.

storm>krampus.text: Winter's weather, yes. Winter's darkness answers to me.

krampus>wolverine.text: I remember you, Logan. Naughty for a very, very long time.
Took you long enough to notice.

wolverine>krampus.text: You smell like a barn, bub.
And you smell like every bar in Canada.

krampus>headless-horseman.text: A rider with no head. What goes in the sack? The pumpkin?
Heh heh heh! Put it in! It'll bite its way out!

headless-horseman>krampus.text: Heh heh heh! Two holiday horrors! Halloween AND Christmas!
Your holiday ends in November. Mine never does.

krampus>forgemaster.text: Every greedy dwarf ends up in my sack eventually.
Then I'll bring a pickaxe and dig out the bottom.

forgemaster>krampus.text: Fine horns, goat. They'd make good handles for a hammer.
And your beard would make good rope for my sack.

krampus>santa.text: You bring gifts. I bring consequences. Guess who they remember?
Ho ho ho! Me, Krampus. Always me.

santa>krampus.text: Ho ho ho! Every year you make my job harder!
And every year, you make mine necessary.

krampus>mystic-brawler.text: Loud, proud, and never punished. You need my sack, islander.
Your sack couldn't hold my left arm, brother!

mystic-brawler>krampus.text: Brother, you need sunshine! Come to my island!
Sunshine is where naughty children hide from me.

vampire-lord>huntress.text: Your kitten has lovely manners. Unlike you, darling.
Nyra's manners end at your throat.

huntress>vampire-lord.text: Nyra won't eat you. You smell like a tomb.
I smell like history, darling. Your cat has no taste.

vampire-lord>samurai.text: Such devotion to your lord. I had servants like you once.
Servants obey. I serve by choice.

samurai>vampire-lord.text: Five hundred years, and not one of them lived with honor.
Honor is for the short-lived, darling. I have time to be interesting.

vampire-lord>black-panther.text: A fellow royal. Tell me, king, how do you keep your subjects loyal?
I protect them. You feed on them.

black-panther>vampire-lord.text: You rule through fear. It never lasts.
Five hundred years, darling. It lasts quite well.

vampire-lord>black-widow.text: Look into my eyes, spy. Tell me all your secrets.
Nice try. The Red Room trained that out of me.

black-widow>vampire-lord.text: Castle, cape, mind control. You're a walking cliché.
Darling, I was the original. They all copied me.

vampire-lord>captain-marvel.text: Such a lovely glow, darling. Like a candle I could snuff out.
Try it. This candle hits back.

captain-marvel>vampire-lord.text: You hate the sun, huh? Guess what I basically am.
Stars burn out, darling. I've watched thousands do so.

vampire-lord>doctor-strange.text: You bargain with demons, sorcerer. I'm far better company.
Demons at least keep their promises.

doctor-strange>vampire-lord.text: Vampirism. A curse I could cure in an afternoon.
Cure? Darling, it's the only gift I ever wanted.

vampire-lord>spider-man.text: Out swinging at midnight, little spider? Didn't your mother warn you about me?
She warned me about, like, everything. You were probably on the list.

spider-man>vampire-lord.text: Wait, can you actually turn into a bat? That's so cool.
Darling, the bat is only my second-best look.

vampire-lord>scarlet-witch.text: Such power, and you still look so sad. What a waste, darling.
Sadness is what makes it strong.

scarlet-witch>vampire-lord.text: I could give you a heartbeat again.
How dreadful. I'd have to feel things again.

vampire-lord>thor.text: A god with warm blood. You'd be a feast, darling.
HA! Then come dine, vampire! I'll bring the hammer!

thor>vampire-lord.text: Foul creature of night! Asgard has slain thy kind!
Asgard never met me, darling. Few survive the introduction.

vampire-lord>cyclops.text: Tell me, soldier. What's redder? Your eyes, or your blood?
You'll never get close enough to compare.

cyclops>vampire-lord.text: Your trance needs eye contact. I'm not giving it.

vampire-lord>gambit.text: Such a charmer. But I've been charming for five centuries.
Den let's see who blinks first, chère.

gambit>vampire-lord.text: Gambit's cards glow in de dark, chère. Just like your eyes.
Flattery, darling? I expected more from a thief.

vampire-lord>iceman.text: Cold as the grave. Are you sure you're alive, darling?
Pretty sure. Wait, lemme check. Yep, still got a pulse.

iceman>vampire-lord.text: Cold-blooded, huh? Welcome to the club.
Darling, my blood isn't cold. It's borrowed.

vampire-lord>jean-grey.text: So much power in one little body, darling. Does it ever hunger?
Always. That's why I'm so careful—

jean-grey>vampire-lord.text: You've outlived everyone you ever loved, haven't you?
Darling, I made sure of it.

vampire-lord>psylocke.text: A ninja who won't meet my eyes? How unfair, darling.
Your gaze is slow. My blade isn't.

psylocke>vampire-lord.text: You hunt at night. So do I. Stay out of my way.
The night is mine, darling. You're simply visiting.

vampire-lord>rogue.text: We both take what we need from others, darling.
Difference is, sugar, I hate every second of it.

rogue>vampire-lord.text: Pale, cold, lonely. You're what I'm scared of turnin' into.
Oh, darling. Loneliness gets so much easier with practice.

vampire-lord>storm.text: Could you arrange an eternal night, darling? For me?
The sun rises for everyone. Even you.

storm>vampire-lord.text: My lightning will light up your darkness.
Lightning lasts a moment, darling. Darkness waits.

vampire-lord>wolverine.text: You heal so quickly, darling. An endless supply.
Take a number, lady. Everybody wants a piece of me.

wolverine>vampire-lord.text: You smell like a crypt, lady.
And you like a tavern brawl. We all have our perfumes.

vampire-lord>headless-horseman.text: A guest without a head. Wherever shall I bite?
Heh heh heh! Nowhere, bloodsucker! I'm all pumpkin!

headless-horseman>vampire-lord.text: Heh heh heh! Fancy castle, vampire! Mind if I haunt it?
Darling, it's already haunted. Mostly by me.

vampire-lord>forgemaster.text: No armor ever forged will keep my fangs from your throat, darling.
Ye haven't met MY armor, lass. Bite it and see who loses teeth.

forgemaster>vampire-lord.text: Finest weapons in the world, and ye die to a pointy stick? Insultin'.
Tragic, isn't it, darling? All that craftsmanship, wasted.

vampire-lord>santa.text: You enter homes uninvited every year. I'm so jealous, darling.
Ho ho ho! Cookies are my invitation, dear!

santa>vampire-lord.text: Ho ho ho! No presents for you, dear. Not this century. Not the next.
How cruel, darling. I'll just take someone else's.

vampire-lord>mystic-brawler.text: Such warm island blood. I do love a tropical vintage.
Sorry, sister! This vintage isn't for tasting!

mystic-brawler>vampire-lord.text: Sister, you're so pale! Come to my island, get some sun!
You don't know much about vampires, do you, darling?

forgemaster>huntress.text: That spear's tipped with stone, lass. Stone! In this day and age!
Stone doesn't rust. Neither does Nyra.

huntress>forgemaster.text: Nyra wants to know if you taste like metal.
Only on the outside, lass. Tell her to bring a can opener.

forgemaster>samurai.text: Folded steel, a thousand layers. Aye, I'll admit it. Fine work.
From you, dwarf, that is high honor.

samurai>forgemaster.text: You forge for gold. I fight for honor.

forgemaster>black-panther.text: Vibranium. Heard of it. Never touched it. Let me touch it.

black-panther>forgemaster.text: Your armor is heavy. Mine absorbs every blow.
Aye? Mine just makes the blow regret it.

forgemaster>black-widow.text: What's that suit made of, lass? Ye call that armor?
I call it dodging. You should try it sometime.

black-widow>forgemaster.text: Loud, slow, and shiny. You'd make the worst spy ever.
Didn't come to spy, lass. Came to hit things.

forgemaster>captain-marvel.text: No armor, no weapon, just glowin'? Ye make me job look useless.
Your job's easy. Mine is saving the galaxy.

captain-marvel>forgemaster.text: I could punch through that armor in one shot.
Many said that, lass. I keep a shelf of their broken knuckles.

forgemaster>doctor-strange.text: Magic shields? Can't hammer 'em, can't sell 'em. Useless.
They've stopped more than your armor ever will.

doctor-strange>forgemaster.text: I've seen a future where you find Ultimanium. You die right after.

forgemaster>spider-man.text: Ye climb walls in pajamas, lad. Where's yer armor?
Armor? I can barely afford a new suit.

spider-man>forgemaster.text: Whoa, full armor! Is that heavy? That looks super heavy.
Heavier than you, lad. And twice as useful.

forgemaster>scarlet-witch.text: Could ye turn this rock into Ultimanium, lass? Just the one?
I could. But then you'd want more.

scarlet-witch>forgemaster.text: I could turn your armor into sand.
Then I'd forge it back. Sand makes good glass too.

forgemaster>thor.text: Uru metal, forged in a dying star. I'd trade my whole mine to study it.
Then study it closely, smith! It flies straight for thee!

thor>forgemaster.text: Couldst thou forge a hammer to rival Mjolnir, little smith?
Give me a dying star and a century, lad. Then we'll talk.

forgemaster>cyclops.text: Ye lead a team with no armor? Madness, lad.
Armor slows you down. My team moves fast.

cyclops>forgemaster.text: That armor has to slow you down. I'll outmaneuver you.
Go outmaneuver a wall, lad. Tell me how it goes.

forgemaster>gambit.text: Ye blow up cards? Waste of good paper, lad.
An' you hoard rocks, mon ami. We all got our vices.

gambit>forgemaster.text: Gambit bets he can lift dat Ultimanium right off your belt.
Try it. I'll forge yer fingers into a keychain.

forgemaster>iceman.text: Me forge takes three days to heat. Ye'd cool it in three seconds. Stay back.
Wow, okay. Ice to meet you too.

iceman>forgemaster.text: I bet I could make ice armor faster than you make steel.
Aye. And it'd break faster too.

forgemaster>jean-grey.text: Can yer mind find ore underground, lass? I'd pay handsomely.
I could try, but she'd rather—

jean-grey>forgemaster.text: Your mind is just... rocks. Rocks and gold.
Aye. Best thoughts a dwarf can have.

forgemaster>psylocke.text: A blade ye never have to sharpen? That's just unfair, lass.
Life isn't fair, dwarf. Neither am I.

psylocke>forgemaster.text: So much armor. What are you hiding underneath?
More armor, lass. It's armor all the way down.

forgemaster>rogue.text: Ye've the strength of ten, lass. I could use ye in the mines.
Only if nobody down there bumps into me, sugar.

rogue>forgemaster.text: All that armor. Guess you don't like bein' touched either, sugar.
I like bein' touched fine, lass. I just don't like bein' hit.

forgemaster>storm.text: Yer lightning could forge a blade in a heartbeat, lass. Come work for me.
I have been called a goddess, dwarf. Never an employee.

storm>forgemaster.text: Metal armor in a thunderstorm? How unwise.
Aye, but I'm short. Lightning goes for the tall ones.

forgemaster>wolverine.text: Watch it, shorty. I'm still taller than you.

wolverine>forgemaster.text: Adamantium claws, bub. Your armor won't stop 'em.
When I win, lad, those claws become materials for my masterpiece.

forgemaster>headless-horseman.text: No head, no helmet. Saves ye a fortune, lad.
Heh heh heh! And I never need a haircut!

headless-horseman>forgemaster.text: Heh heh heh! Your helmet's hollow too, dwarf!
Hollow? It holds the finest head in the mountains.

forgemaster>santa.text: Now THAT'S a beard! Ye're welcome in my forge anytime, old man.
Ho ho ho! And you're welcome in my workshop, friend!

santa>forgemaster.text: Ho ho ho! Want to make toys with my elves this year?
Toys? I don't make toys. I make heirlooms.

forgemaster>mystic-brawler.text: No armor at all? Just tattoos? Lad, ye're practically naked.
The mountain is my armor, brother!

mystic-brawler>forgemaster.text: Brother, my island's mountains are full of rock! Want some?
Is there Ultimanium in it? Then I want all of it.

huntress>samurai.text: You bow before you fight. Nyra just pounces.
A beast needs no courtesy. You do.

samurai>huntress.text: Your beast fights for you. Where is your honor?
Nyra is my mother. We fight together. That's honor.

huntress>black-panther.text: Nyra says you smell like a cat. But not a real one.
A king of Wakanda carries the spirit of the panther. Not its scent.

black-panther>huntress.text: A great cat who guards her cub. Bast would approve.
Nyra doesn't need your goddess's approval. But thanks.

black-widow>huntress.text: Raised by a tiger? And I thought my childhood was rough.
Mine was warm. Yours sounds cold.

huntress>captain-marvel.text: Nyra is watching you. She's never seen a bird that big.
Tell her this bird bites back.

huntress>doctor-strange.text: Your cloak moves by itself. Nyra wants to chase it.

doctor-strange>huntress.text: A soul bond with a sabertooth? Fascinating magic.

huntress>spider-man.text: You swing through the trees like a monkey.
Hey, I'm a spider! Totally different animal!

spider-man>huntress.text: Okay, is it safe to pet the giant tiger? Asking for me.
Only if you want to swing one-handed.

huntress>scarlet-witch.text: Nyra's fur stands up around you. Your magic smells wrong.

scarlet-witch>huntress.text: I could make your tiger forget you ever existed.
She'd still find me. She always does.

huntress>thor.text: Your hammer's too loud. It scares away all the prey.
Then we shall hunt each other, huntress! HA!

thor>huntress.text: A warrior raised by a great beast! Thou art like a saga!
I don't know your stories. I only know the hunt.

huntress>cyclops.text: You give orders to your pack. Nyra and I never need words.
That's called teamwork. I just say it out loud.

cyclops>huntress.text: You and the tiger. Two targets, one plan.

huntress>gambit.text: Your cards smell like smoke and swamp.
Dat's de smell of home, chère.

gambit>huntress.text: Gambit always had a soft spot for big cats, chère.
Nyra has no soft spot for anyone. Except me.

huntress>iceman.text: You leave frost everywhere. Easy to track.
Yeah, stealth isn't really my thing.

iceman>huntress.text: Whoa, a sabertooth! Did you, like, defrost her from a glacier?
She found me in the jungle. Not the other way around.

huntress>jean-grey.text: Your fire scares Nyra. Nothing scares Nyra.

jean-grey>huntress.text: I can feel Nyra's mind. She loves you so much.
I know. She's all I've ever had.

huntress>psylocke.text: You move quietly. Almost as quietly as Nyra.
Almost? I'll take that as a challenge.

psylocke>huntress.text: Your tiger's mind is simple. Hunger and loyalty.
That's more than most minds have.

huntress>rogue.text: You can't touch anyone? I've never been without Nyra's fur.
Lucky girl. You hold on to her tight, sugar.

rogue>huntress.text: That tiger never leaves your side, huh?
Never. Not since I was a baby.

huntress>storm.text: The rains came early this year. Your doing?
The jungle needed them. You're welcome.

storm>huntress.text: When I call the storm, even the tiger hides.
Nyra doesn't hide. She hunts in the rain. It covers our scent.

huntress>wolverine.text: You smell like a wild animal.
Takes one to know one, kid.

wolverine>huntress.text: Big cat. Bigger than me. I like her.
Scratch behind her ear. Gently. Then you'll be friends forever.

huntress>headless-horseman.text: Nyra won't hunt you. You smell like rotten pumpkin.
Heh heh heh! Fresh pumpkin, girl! Carved this morning!

headless-horseman>huntress.text: Heh heh heh! Your tiger is afraid of me!
She's not afraid. She's waiting for you to stop laughing.

huntress>santa.text: You make toys? Nyra's favorite toy is a wild boar.
Ho ho ho! I don't think that fits in the sleigh!

santa>huntress.text: Ho ho ho! Have you and your kitty been good this year?
We hunted. We ate. We slept. That's good.

huntress>mystic-brawler.text: You're loud. The whole jungle hears you coming.
Good! Then it knows a legend has arrived!

mystic-brawler>huntress.text: A tiger mother! My ancestors would sing songs about you, sister!
Nyra doesn't like singing. She likes quiet.

samurai>black-panther.text: A king who fights beside his warriors. You are worthy of my blade.
And you of mine. Let us honor our ancestors.

black-panther>samurai.text: Your blade is steel. Mine are vibranium claws.
The metal matters little. The hand that holds it decides.

samurai>black-widow.text: You changed sides, spy. A warrior serves one master.
I serve my conscience now. It's pickier than any master.

black-widow>samurai.text: Bowing before a fight? That's a lot of time to stab you.
Only a coward strikes a bowed head. You are not a coward, spy.

samurai>captain-marvel.text: You fight from the sky. Come down and face my blade.
Why would I? Up here, I win.

captain-marvel>samurai.text: Swords? Seriously? What century is this?
The century does not matter. The edge is always sharp.

samurai>doctor-strange.text: You hide behind spells and portals. Draw a blade, sorcerer.
Your blade takes lives. Mine used to save them.

doctor-strange>samurai.text: You judge every opponent as worthy or unworthy. Exhausting, isn't it?
Only for those who are unworthy.

samurai>spider-man.text: You mock your enemies while you fight. Where is your discipline, boy?
Uh, somewhere between homework and saving the city?

spider-man>samurai.text: Whoa, a real samurai! Can I see the sword? Just, like, from here?
Look quickly. It is not drawn for long.

samurai>scarlet-witch.text: You bend the world to your will. That is not strength. It is fear.
You've never lost what I've lost.

scarlet-witch>samurai.text: I could erase your whole bloodline.
Then I would be the last. And I would still stand.

samurai>thor.text: A god who fights with honor. You are a rare foe.
And thou a rare warrior! Come, let us make this glorious!

thor>samurai.text: Thy blade is so thin! Doth it truly cut?
It has cut through stone. Thy hammer will not be the first.

samurai>cyclops.text: You train young warriors. A master's duty. I honor it.
Then you know the hardest part is sending them into battle.

cyclops>samurai.text: I've studied your stance. Front-heavy. You'll overcommit.
A samurai commits everything. That is the point.

samurai>gambit.text: A thief who gambles. You are shame in its purest form.
Gambit's been called worse, mon ami. By better.

gambit>samurai.text: You would lose. I smile when the shameful fall.

samurai>iceman.text: You joke at the edge of a blade. That is either courage or foolishness.

iceman>samurai.text: Ice katana! Look, I made one! We match!
A blade that melts is an insult to the craft.

samurai>jean-grey.text: You carry a power you cannot control. There is shame in that.
I'm trying. Every day, I'm trying—

jean-grey>samurai.text: Your mind is so ordered. Like a temple.
Then do not bring your fire into it.

samurai>psylocke.text: A sharp mind makes a sharp blade. Is yours as honed as mine?
Sharper. My blade is my mind.

psylocke>samurai.text: Your clan and mine were enemies once.
And today, our blades will decide which was right.

samurai>rogue.text: Stealing the strength of others is the path of the dishonored.
Wasn't my choice, sugar. Ain't no shame in surviving.

rogue>samurai.text: Fightin' with a sword? Sugar, I can fly.
Then fly. The blade will wait until you land.

samurai>storm.text: Your lightning is swift. But can it face a blade that does not fear it?
Fear or not, steel draws lightning, samurai. Stand tall and see.

storm>samurai.text: Your blade is useless against a storm.
Every storm passes. The blade remains.

samurai>wolverine.text: You have lived in my land. You know our ways.
Yeah. Best years of my life, bub. Some of 'em.

wolverine>samurai.text: Seen a lotta samurai. Most ended up on my claws.
Then you have never seen one with honor.

samurai>headless-horseman.text: You lost your head. Did you lose your honor with it?
Heh heh heh! Never had any, samurai!

headless-horseman>samurai.text: Heh heh heh! One swing and your head could join mine!
A warrior who loses his head deserved to lose it.

samurai>mystic-brawler.text: Your ancestors walk beside you. Mine watch from the shrine.
Then let them watch, brother! We'll give them a good show!

mystic-brawler>samurai.text: No sword needed, brother! My fists are enough!
Then I will sheathe mine. Honor demands a fair fight.

samurai>santa.text: You judge children as naughty or nice. A code of your own. I respect it.
Ho ho ho! Thank you, son! Though mine comes with cookies.

santa>samurai.text: Ho ho ho! What does a samurai want for Christmas?
A worthy opponent. You will do.

headless-horseman>black-panther.text: Heh heh heh! Kneel, king! Your crown would look lovely on my pumpkin!
My crown is earned. You have nowhere to put it.

black-panther>headless-horseman.text: You terrorize villages for sport. A king protects them.
Heh heh heh! Then protect them from THIS!

headless-horseman>black-widow.text: Heh heh heh! A spy in the dark! Can you hear my hooves, spy?
I heard them a mile away. You're not subtle.

black-widow>headless-horseman.text: I've been hunted by the best. You're loud and on fire.
Heh heh heh! That's the fun part, spy!

headless-horseman>captain-marvel.text: Heh heh heh! You fly fast, girl! But my horse never tires!

captain-marvel>headless-horseman.text: A talking pumpkin? That's what I'm fighting today?
Heh heh heh! Talking, laughing, and thirsting for your head!

headless-horseman>doctor-strange.text: Heh heh heh! A doctor! Can you tell me where I left my head?
Somewhere I'd rather not open a portal to.

doctor-strange>headless-horseman.text: I've faced the Dread Dormammu. You're a seasonal decoration.
Heh heh heh! A decoration with an axe!

headless-horseman>spider-man.text: Heh heh heh! Run, little spider! I love a good chase!
Great. Another guy throwing pumpkins at me. What is it with you people?

spider-man>headless-horseman.text: Flaming pumpkins, evil laughing... okay, where's your glider?
Heh heh heh! Glider? I ride a HORSE from HELL, boy!

headless-horseman>scarlet-witch.text: Heh heh heh! Change reality all you like, witch! I'm still headless!
I could give you a head. You wouldn't like which one.

scarlet-witch>headless-horseman.text: Your fear feeds on others. Mine feeds on nothing.
Heh heh heh! Then let me feed on YOURS!

headless-horseman>thor.text: Heh heh heh! Nice hammer, thunder boy! My axe is sharper!
Sharper, perhaps! But mine comes back when thrown!

thor>headless-horseman.text: A headless foe! How shall I know when thou art defeated?
Heh heh heh! When I stop laughing! So, never!

headless-horseman>cyclops.text: Heh heh heh! You shoot beams from your eyes? I shoot MY WHOLE HEAD!
Yeah. I noticed. It's very weird.

cyclops>headless-horseman.text: You're easy to spot, with that pumpkin burning in the dark.
Heh heh heh! Good! I want you to see me coming!

headless-horseman>gambit.text: Heh heh heh! Throwin' cards, Cajun? I throw my HEAD!
Gambit's cards explode, mon ami. What does your head do?

gambit>headless-horseman.text: Gambit bets dat pumpkin burns real nice.
Heh heh heh! It already does! Forever!

headless-horseman>iceman.text: Heh heh heh! Brr! You're colder than my grave, boy!
Aw, thanks. Nobody ever compliments the chill factor.

iceman>headless-horseman.text: Whoa. Your pumpkin's on fire. Want me to put it out?
Heh heh heh! Put it out, and I light YOU up!

headless-horseman>jean-grey.text: Heh heh heh! Read my mind, redhead! Oh wait, there isn't one!

jean-grey>headless-horseman.text: Your laughter echoes. But there's no one inside to laugh.
Heh heh heh! Then who's laughing now, redhead?

headless-horseman>psylocke.text: Heh heh heh! A silent ninja! Scream for me, just once!
You'll hear me when it's already too late.

psylocke>headless-horseman.text: No mind to cut. No head to take. What are you?
Heh heh heh! Your nightmare, ninja! Galloping!

headless-horseman>rogue.text: Heh heh heh! Southern belle! Want a ride? My horse loves company!
Sugar, I can fly. Why would I ride with a pumpkin?

rogue>headless-horseman.text: You ride around scarin' folks for fun, sugar?
Heh heh heh! What else is there to do out here?

headless-horseman>storm.text: Heh heh heh! A storm on Halloween night! Perfect for a ride!
I did not summon it for you.

storm>headless-horseman.text: My rain will put out that ghastly flame.
Heh heh heh! It burns in the rain, witch! It burns in the grave!

headless-horseman>wolverine.text: Heh heh heh! Three claws per hand! Careful with my pumpkin, beast!
Relax, bub. I'm just gonna give it a new face.

wolverine>headless-horseman.text: Hold still, pumpkin. I'm carvin' you a smile.
Heh heh heh! It's already smiling! Wider, please!

headless-horseman>santa.text: Heh heh heh! My holiday comes first, fat man! October beats December!
Ho ho ho! But mine lasts longer, dear!

santa>headless-horseman.text: Ho ho ho! Naughty list, horseman! Two hundred years running!
Heh heh heh! Only two hundred? I must try harder!

headless-horseman>mystic-brawler.text: Heh heh heh! Big man! Big head! Can I borrow it?
Sorry, brother! This head belongs to a legend!

mystic-brawler>headless-horseman.text: Your pumpkin looks lonely, brother! Want a coconut to keep it company?
Heh heh heh! Only if it screams!

black-panther>black-widow.text: You once spied on Wakanda, Romanoff. What did you find?

black-widow>black-panther.text: Everyone has a weak spot. I'm still looking for yours.
My people. And they are very far from here.

black-panther>captain-marvel.text: You fight like a soldier. Who gives your orders?
Nobody. That's kind of the whole appeal.

captain-marvel>black-panther.text: I absorb energy too, you know. Let's see who fills up first.
Then whoever strikes first loses. How inconvenient.

black-panther>doctor-strange.text: Our shamans speak of a sorcerer who guards this world.
They're well informed. Not well trained, though. Not like me.

doctor-strange>black-panther.text: I've read texts older than Wakanda.
Then you have not read ours. They were never written for outsiders.

black-panther>spider-man.text: Show me how a spider fights, young one.
Upside down, mostly. Hope you're cool with that.

spider-man>black-panther.text: Do I bow? Do I curtsy? Nobody told me the royal rules!
Fight well. That is the only rule.

black-panther>scarlet-witch.text: Power like yours needs something to answer to.
I answered to others once. Never again.

scarlet-witch>black-panther.text: I could make Wakanda vanish from every map.
We spent centuries doing that ourselves.

black-panther>thor.text: Your hammer chose you. The Panther chose me.
Then two worthy warriors meet today! Glorious!

thor>black-panther.text: Thy claws are vibranium! Canst they scratch Uru?

black-panther>cyclops.text: You lead people who were never given a home.
So we built one. You'd understand.

cyclops>black-panther.text: I've planned for your suit. Every angle.
My sister designed it. She planned for you.

black-panther>gambit.text: Thief. Your eyes keep drifting to my claws.
Gambit just appreciates fine craftsmanship, mon roi.

gambit>black-panther.text: A king, eh? Pretty card. But Gambit always holds de ace.
An ace wins one hand. A king rules the table.

black-panther>iceman.text: Keep your ice away from my people's crops, young man.
Relax, I'm a professional. ...Mostly. Sorry about the papayas.

iceman>black-panther.text: Hey, Panther! Wakanda ever get snow? I could fix that.
We have mountains of it. The tribe up there would like you.

black-panther>jean-grey.text: Great power in you, Jean. Held back with great effort.

jean-grey>black-panther.text: Your mind carries so many voices. Your ancestors?
They guide me. Do not disturb them.

black-panther>psylocke.text: You and my Dora Milaje would have much to discuss.

psylocke>black-panther.text: Your guards were sloppy. I got within ten feet of you.
Nine. The Dora Milaje let you.

black-panther>rogue.text: The X-Men speak of you with respect, Rogue.
That's 'cause they've seen me angry, sugar.

rogue>black-panther.text: Sugar, you're awful polite for a man with claws.
A king's manners never leave. Neither do his claws.

black-panther>storm.text: Ororo. It has been too long.
Not long enough to forget, T'Challa.

storm>black-panther.text: Do you still watch the sky over Wakanda, T'Challa?
Every storm. Hoping it is you.

black-panther>wolverine.text: Adamantium. A lesser metal than vibranium, Logan.

wolverine>black-panther.text: Good. Trust what I do, not what I am.

black-panther>santa.text: Every year, my sister tries to catch you on camera.
Ho ho ho! Tell her she came very close last year!

santa>black-panther.text: Ho ho ho! Nice list, Your Majesty! Every year since you were a cub!
My father would be glad to hear it.

black-panther>mystic-brawler.text: You carry your ancestors with you. So do I.
Then tell yours to sit with mine! They'll get along!

mystic-brawler>black-panther.text: Hit me, brother! Everything you give comes back double!
Mine as well. Then neither of us falls first.

black-widow>captain-marvel.text: Last time I needed backup, you were three galaxies away.
And you still won. So what's the problem?

captain-marvel>black-widow.text: No powers, no suit, no ship. How are you still standing?
Practice. And people underestimating me. Like right now.

black-widow>doctor-strange.text: You see every outcome, Doc. Seen the one where I win?
Once. I'm still trying to figure out how you did it.

doctor-strange>black-widow.text: Magic doesn't care how well you were trained.
Neither does a knife in the dark. Yet here we are.

black-widow>spider-man.text: I've been following you for three blocks, kid.
Three blocks?! My spider-sense didn't even— okay, that's embarrassing.

spider-man>black-widow.text: Spider-Man, Black Widow... are we, like, a spider team?
Sure. You're the friendly one. I'm the other one.

black-widow>scarlet-witch.text: Wanda. I've seen what you do when you're scared.
Then you know not to scare me.

scarlet-witch>black-widow.text: Gods, mutants, witches. And you walk in with a pistol.
And somehow, I'm still the one they all plan around.

black-widow>thor.text: Nice hammer. Your aim, less so.
Mjolnir always returns! Usually through whatever stands between!

thor>black-widow.text: Lady Natasha! The only mortal I fear in a sparring ring!

black-widow>cyclops.text: You make a plan and a backup plan. Cute. I make five.
And I make six. One for when you betray us.

cyclops>black-widow.text: You work alone. My team works together. That's how we win.
I've been on a team. Their plan was usually mine.

black-widow>gambit.text: Charming, reckless, bad at keeping promises. I've dated your type.
Den you already know how dis ends, chère. Badly. And worth it.

gambit>black-widow.text: Gambit bets he steals your heart before dis fight ends.
Bet small. I left it somewhere in Russia.

black-widow>iceman.text: I grew up in Russian winters. Your cold doesn't impress me.
Great! Then you won't mind if I make it colder.

iceman>black-widow.text: Black Widow, huh? So what do I call you? Blackie? Widdy?
Call me that again and find out.

black-widow>jean-grey.text: I was trained to think in circles around telepaths.

jean-grey>black-widow.text: You've been lied to so many times. Even by your own memories.
I know. I check twice now.

black-widow>psylocke.text: Trained to kill as children. Both switched sides.
Yes. But I never pretended to be sorry.

psylocke>black-widow.text: Your stance gives you away. Left side is weaker.
It's supposed to be. That's where you'll aim.

black-widow>rogue.text: You ran away young. So did I, in a way.
Difference is, sugar, I ran toward somethin'.

rogue>black-widow.text: You ever smile, spy? Or is that classified?
Classified. I'll make an exception if you lose.

black-widow>storm.text: Weather control. Great for a mission. Terrible for staying hidden.
I have never needed to hide.

storm>black-widow.text: You walk in shadows, Natasha. I walk in the sky.
Shadows don't get hit by lightning.

black-widow>wolverine.text: I've read every file on you. Half of them contradict the other half.
Yeah. I don't remember which half's true either.

wolverine>black-widow.text: Whatever you're plannin', skip it. I'll just heal.
I know. That's why I brought two plans.

black-widow>santa.text: Lists, surveillance, knowing who's asleep. You'd make a great spy.
Ho ho ho! Who says I'm not, dear?

santa>black-widow.text: Ho ho ho! I never had your address growing up, dear. They moved you so much.
It's fine. I didn't believe in you anyway.

black-widow>mystic-brawler.text: Big, loud and proud of it. You'd never survive a stakeout.
A stakeout? Sister, I'd bring the whole island!

mystic-brawler>black-widow.text: So small, sister! Where do you keep all that danger?

santa>captain-marvel.text: Ho ho ho! One night, every rooftop on Earth. Beat that, pilot.
Call me when your reindeer break the sound barrier.

captain-marvel>santa.text: Nice sleigh. What's the top speed on that thing?
Ho ho ho! Depends how many cookies I've had.

santa>doctor-strange.text: Ho ho ho! Every chimney in one night, Doctor. And not a single spell.
I've examined your route. That's absolutely a spell.

doctor-strange>santa.text: The Eye of Agamotto could tell me what's in your sack.
Ho ho ho! Put it away, Doctor. Peeking ruins the surprise.

santa>spider-man.text: Ho ho ho! I keep every letter you send me, Miles. Every single one.
Then you know I've asked for the same sneakers three years running.

spider-man>santa.text: My friends say you're not real. I told them they're wrong. Don't make me look bad.
Ho ho ho! Son, kids like you are the reason I'm still here.

santa>scarlet-witch.text: Ho ho ho! Careful with that red magic, dear. Red is my color.
Then we'll see which red lasts.

scarlet-witch>santa.text: I could erase Christmas from every memory on Earth.
Ho ho ho! Christmas spirit outlasts chaos, dear. Every single year.

santa>thor.text: Ho ho ho! Goats pull your chariot, son? Mine have antlers.
Thou art blessed! Mine scream the whole way. Wilt thou trade?

thor>santa.text: Cookies and milk in every house on Midgard? A feast without end!
Ho ho ho! One cookie per house, son. I have a figure to keep.

santa>cyclops.text: Ho ho ho! Presents for your whole school, Scott. That's a lot of chimneys.
Leave them at the front gate. The security system doesn't know you.

cyclops>santa.text: I've studied your route. Every chimney. You're predictable.
Ho ho ho! That's the whole point, son. Children count on it.

santa>gambit.text: Ho ho ho! Remy, those bayou bonfires light my way in every year.
Gambit lit a few himself, Père Noël. Some wit' cards.

gambit>santa.text: Gambit bets you can't guess what he wants dis year, Père Noël.
Ho ho ho! Same as always, son. For her to say yes.

santa>iceman.text: Ho ho ho! Bobby, you froze my sleigh to your roof last year.
In my defense, I really wanted you to stay longer.

iceman>santa.text: Hey, Santa Claus! Or should I say... Santa Frost? No? Tough crowd.
Ho ho ho! Coal, Bobby. Just for that one.

santa>jean-grey.text: Ho ho ho! Jean, dear. I brought a little something for both of you.
Both? That's so kind, but she—

jean-grey>santa.text: Your mind is so warm. Just... cocoa and laughter.
Ho ho ho! Stay as long as you like, dear. There's always room by the fire.

santa>psylocke.text: Ho ho ho! You came in without a sound, dear. You'd make a fine elf.
Elves make toys. I make silence.

psylocke>santa.text: No one enters a house unseen. No one but me.
Ho ho ho! Every Christmas Eve for centuries, dear.

santa>rogue.text: Ho ho ho! You always leave cookies for the reindeer too, dear.
Somebody's gotta be sweet to 'em, sugar. They work hard.

rogue>santa.text: Remy asked you for me every Christmas, didn't he, sugar?
Ho ho ho! Every year, dear. I told him that one's up to you.

santa>storm.text: Ho ho ho! Thank you for every white Christmas, Ororo.
I do not do it for you, old man. I do it for the children.

storm>santa.text: My storms have grounded armies. Your sleigh will not fly tonight.
Ho ho ho! Dear, I've flown through worse. Every single year.

santa>wolverine.text: Ho ho ho! Logan, you've never once let me skip your coal.
Kept me warm a few winters, old man. Thanks.

wolverine>santa.text: Don't gimme the jolly act, bub. I seen you fight.
Ho ho ho! The jolly's no act, son. Neither is the fighting.

santa>mystic-brawler.text: Ho ho ho! No chimneys on your island, son. Where do I leave presents?
In the sand, brother! The ocean wraps them!

mystic-brawler>santa.text: You look strong under all that red, brother! Show me!
Ho ho ho! Careful what you ask for, son. This belly hits back.

cyclops>captain-marvel.text: You fly, Danvers? So do I. The Blackbird, anyway.

captain-marvel>cyclops.text: On weekends. This isn't a weekend.

cyclops>doctor-strange.text: Doctor. Next time you open a portal in my school, knock first.
I did knock. Your door was in another dimension at the time.

doctor-strange>cyclops.text: You carry every mutant alive on your shoulders, Summers. Impressive posture.
You carry the whole universe. Try standing up straighter.

cyclops>spider-man.text: You're young, Morales. The school has room for you.
I'm not a mutant. Also, I already have a school. And homework.

spider-man>cyclops.text: Mr. Summers, sir. Do you, like, ever smile?

cyclops>scarlet-witch.text: In three words, Wanda, you erased millions of my people.
I know what I said. I live with it.

scarlet-witch>cyclops.text: I could change what you see when you open your eyes.
Everyone wants that. Nobody wants to be standing there when it happens.

cyclops>thor.text: You fight like it's a party.
Is it not? Laugh, son of Summers! Battle is joy!

thor>cyclops.text: Son of Summers! Thou leadest warriors! Come, drink with me after!
I don't drink on duty. I'm always on duty.

cyclops>gambit.text: Gambit's never late, mon ami. Everybody else is early.

gambit>cyclops.text: Gambit got a card for you, Scotty. Jack o' Diamonds. All rules, no fun.
A jack still outranks a joker.

cyclops>iceman.text: Bobby. You were fifteen when we started. You haven't aged a day.
And you got old. And boring. What happened, Scott?

iceman>cyclops.text: Hey Scott, why so frosty? ...That's usually my job.
Bobby, I've heard that joke since we were fifteen.

cyclops>jean-grey.text: Jean. I'm not fighting you. I'm fighting for you.
I know, Scott. That's what scares her—

jean-grey>cyclops.text: Scott, whatever happens, don't hate me—

cyclops>psylocke.text: You were trained to kill, Kwannon. Here, we train to protect.

psylocke>cyclops.text: Your students talk about you, Summers. Mostly in whispers.

cyclops>rogue.text: Rogue. You flew into a fight I told you to stay out of.
The team was losin', sugar. I wasn't gonna sit and watch.

rogue>cyclops.text: You ever do anything without a plan, Summers?

cyclops>storm.text: Ororo. The kids listen to you more than me.
Because I do not lecture them, Scott.

storm>cyclops.text: You lead with your head, Scott. I lead with the sky.
The sky doesn't file mission reports.

cyclops>wolverine.text: Every time you walk out, Logan, I'm the one left cleaning up.
Somebody's gotta do the dirty work, Slim. You never had the stomach.

wolverine>cyclops.text: Maybe not. But she chose me. Every time.

cyclops>mystic-brawler.text: Big, loud, fearless. You'd have made a terrible student.

mystic-brawler>cyclops.text: So serious, brother! Laugh a little! The ocean likes laughter!
The ocean isn't responsible for a school full of kids.

storm>captain-marvel.text: You fly as if the sky owes you something, Carol.
It does. I've saved it enough times.

captain-marvel>storm.text: Air Force taught me to fly around storms. Not with them.

storm>doctor-strange.text: Strange. Every time you show up, the sky turns purple.
On good days. On bad days, it opens.

doctor-strange>storm.text: Your powers are elemental, Ororo. Mine are dimensional. Mine are bigger.
Bigger is not the same as wiser, Stephen.

storm>spider-man.text: Miles, your spider-sense warns you before my lightning strikes. Impressive.
Storm just called me impressive. I'm telling literally everyone.

spider-man>storm.text: Can you make it snow on demand? Because school closures...
I do not cancel school, child. I teach at one.

storm>scarlet-witch.text: Wanda. We both carry power that frightens others.
Let them be frightened. Fear keeps them at a distance.

scarlet-witch>storm.text: Your lightning follows the laws of nature. Mine rewrites them.
Nature has outlived every hand that tried to rewrite it.

storm>thor.text: The god of thunder. I have been curious about you.
And I of thee! Two storms on one field! Glorious!

thor>storm.text: Thy lightning is fair, lady! Mine is louder!
Thunder is only the echo, Odinson. I bring the lightning.

storm>gambit.text: Remy, put the cards away. We are friends.
Dat's why Gambit's only usin' de low numbers.

gambit>storm.text: Rain on Gambit's cards again, stormy, an' he's sendin' you de bill.

storm>iceman.text: Bobby, do you remember your first snow day at the school?

iceman>storm.text: Race you, Ororo! Your blizzard versus my snowstorm!
Bobby, your snowstorm is one boy throwing snowballs.

storm>jean-grey.text: Jean. You are my sister in all but blood.
I know, Ororo. Please forgive what she—

jean-grey>storm.text: Your mind is so calm, Ororo. Like the eye of a hurricane.
Someone in this family has to be.

storm>psylocke.text: You move without a sound, Kwannon. Even the wind cannot hear you.
Then your wind is learning manners.

psylocke>storm.text: The eye of a storm is silent. That is where I will stand.
Few survive long enough to reach it, Kwannon.

storm>rogue.text: Rogue, you fly like a hurricane. Learn to fly like a breeze.

rogue>storm.text: Ororo, you're the only one who never looked at me scared.
Because I saw a lost child, not a threat.

storm>wolverine.text: Logan. The children are watching. Try to fight with dignity.
Dignity's your department, 'Ro. I handle the rest.

wolverine>storm.text: Rain, 'Ro? Really? I just dried off.
It is not rain, Logan. It is a warning.

storm>mystic-brawler.text: I have sent rain to your islands for many seasons.
And we danced in every drop, sister!

mystic-brawler>storm.text: The sky is one of my powers too, sister! Let's share!
The sky does not share, brother. But it will make room for you.

gambit>captain-marvel.text: You go all in every hand, chère. Gambit respects dat.
Folding's for people who plan on losing.

captain-marvel>gambit.text: Nice poker face, LeBeau. Mine's better.
Chère, yours glows. Dat's what dey call a tell.

gambit>doctor-strange.text: You see every future, docteur? Den Gambit ain't playin' cards wit' you.
Wise. In most of them, you cheat anyway.

doctor-strange>gambit.text: I've already seen how this hand ends, LeBeau.
Den you know when to fold, docteur.

gambit>spider-man.text: Petit, you got de worst poker face Gambit ever seen.
It's a mask! You literally can't see my face!

spider-man>gambit.text: Wait, can you teach me that card shuffle thing?
First lesson's free, petit. Second one costs your lunch money.

gambit>scarlet-witch.text: Chaos magic, chère? Dat's just a deck wit' no rules.
In my deck, Remy, every card is wild.

scarlet-witch>gambit.text: I could change every card in your hand.
Den Gambit plays whatever you deal him, chère. Still wins.

gambit>thor.text: Ante up, blondie. Dat hammer's worth a lot in dis pot.
Ha! None but the worthy may lift it! Wager something else!

thor>gambit.text: A game of chance! Teach me, Cajun!
Rule one, mon ami. Never shout when you got a good hand.

gambit>iceman.text: Ice in your veins, Bobby. Perfect for poker.
Deal me in. I'm the coolest guy at the table.

iceman>gambit.text: Hey Remy, how'd you know I was bluffing?
Your nose froze, mon ami. Every time.

gambit>jean-grey.text: Gambit don't play cards wit' telepaths, chère.
I'd never peek, Remy. But she—

jean-grey>gambit.text: You're bluffing, Remy. I can feel it from here.
Chère, Gambit's always bluffin'. Dat's de trick.

gambit>psylocke.text: Best poker face in de room, chère. Scary.
I have no tells, Cajun. I was trained not to.

psylocke>gambit.text: You talk too much for a gambler.
Dat's de trick, chère. Nobody watches de hands.

gambit>rogue.text: Chère, Gambit's all in. Always has been.
Sugar, you went all in the day we met.

rogue>gambit.text: Deal me in, Swamp Rat. And no cheatin'.
For you, chère? Gambit plays de honest hand. Always.

gambit>wolverine.text: Poker night, Logan. You still owe Gambit from last time.
You cheated, Cajun. I could smell it.

wolverine>gambit.text: Can't, mon ami. Me an' de deck, we're a pair.

gambit>mystic-brawler.text: You play wit' your ancestors watchin', mon ami? Crowded table.
And they never let me fold, brother!

mystic-brawler>gambit.text: Cards? Cute toys, brother! Let me show you real power!
Big talk, mon ami. At dis table, we call dat a bluff.

spider-man>captain-marvel.text: You fly faster than the subway. Can I get a ride to school?
Sure, kid. Hope you like breaking the sound barrier.

captain-marvel>spider-man.text: You glow when you punch, kid. Didn't know spiders did that.
Venom Strike! Pretty sure you glow more, though.

spider-man>doctor-strange.text: Can you make my math homework disappear? Like, magically?
I can. I won't. Do your homework, Morales.

doctor-strange>spider-man.text: There are many Spider-Men across the multiverse, Miles.
Yeah, I've met, like, half of them. Long story.

spider-man>scarlet-witch.text: Ms. Maximoff, your magic makes my hair stand up. Literally.
That is the least it can do.

scarlet-witch>spider-man.text: You're young to carry this much responsibility, Miles.
Somebody's gotta do it. Might as well be me.

spider-man>thor.text: Can I hold the hammer? Just hold it. No pressure.
Try, young spider! If thou art worthy, I shall weep with joy!

thor>spider-man.text: Hail, spider-child! Thou art small but mighty!
I'm average height! Everyone here is just huge!

spider-man>iceman.text: Yo, can you make an ice slide from here to Brooklyn?

iceman>spider-man.text: Spider-Man! Wait, which one? There's like a hundred of you.

spider-man>jean-grey.text: Please don't read my mind. It's super embarrassing in there.

jean-grey>spider-man.text: You're afraid your father will find out, Miles. He'd be proud.
Wait, you can see that?! Okay, don't tell him. Please.

spider-man>psylocke.text: How are you so quiet? My sneakers squeak on everything.
Years of training. And better shoes.

psylocke>spider-man.text: You hide well, boy. For an amateur.
From you? That's basically a compliment. I'll take it.

spider-man>rogue.text: That white streak is so cool. Did you dye it?
Nope. Got it the hard way, sugar.

rogue>spider-man.text: Brooklyn boy, huh? You look like you ain't slept in a week.
Patrol at night, school in the morning. What's sleep?

spider-man>wolverine.text: Don't call me mister, kid. I'm old enough without it.

wolverine>spider-man.text: Kid, go home. This ain't a fight for you.
Funny. I was about to tell you the same thing, old man.

spider-man>mystic-brawler.text: You talk about your ancestors a lot. I hear my uncle sometimes too.
Then he walks with you, little brother. Always.

mystic-brawler>spider-man.text: Little spider! Why hide your face? A hero should be seen!
My mom would ground me for a year. Mask stays on.

thor>captain-marvel.text: Captain! Thou fliest as swift as the Bifrost!
Faster. And I don't leave scorch marks on the lawn.

captain-marvel>thor.text: Last time we sparred, you said you'd go easy on me.
And I did! Thou hast no idea how much!

thor>doctor-strange.text: Sorcerer! Open a portal to Asgard! I'm late for supper!

doctor-strange>thor.text: Your hammer's enchantment is remarkable. Centuries old.
Forged in the heart of a dying star! Thou hast fine taste, wizard!

thor>scarlet-witch.text: Thy magic reeks of chaos, witch! My brother would adore thee!
I've met your brother. The feeling isn't mutual.

scarlet-witch>thor.text: You speak of worthiness, Odinson. Who decides?
The hammer, lady. It hath never once been wrong.

thor>iceman.text: Cold as a frost giant! Art thou of Jotunheim, boy?
Long Island, actually. But I'll take it as a compliment.

iceman>thor.text: Hey Thor, do they have ice cream in Asgard?
Nay! What is this "ice cream"? Bring me some at once!

thor>jean-grey.text: Thy fire burns like Muspelheim, lady!
I'm keeping it low, Thor. She'd rather—

jean-grey>thor.text: Your mind is so loud, Thor. Mostly shouting.
'Tis how Asgardians think! Loudly and with joy!

thor>psylocke.text: Thou movest unseen, lady! Most warriors announce themselves!

psylocke>thor.text: You walk like thunder, Odinson. I heard you three halls away.
Good! Let every hall know Thor approaches!

thor>rogue.text: Lady Rogue! Thou art strong for a Midgardian!

rogue>thor.text: You talk mighty fancy for a fella with a hammer.
'Tis how we speak in Asgard! Thou shouldst hear my father!

thor>wolverine.text: Two centuries, Logan? A mere babe! I am fifteen hundred!
An' still actin' like a teenager, bub.

wolverine>thor.text: Lemme guess. You're gonna yell somethin' fancy before you swing.

thor>mystic-brawler.text: Thou laughest in battle, friend! At last, a kindred spirit!
Who fights without laughing, brother? Sad people!

mystic-brawler>thor.text: You fly with a hammer, brother? I ride the waves!
Then race me to the horizon, friend!

scarlet-witch>captain-marvel.text: Carol. We were Avengers together once. Do you still trust me?

captain-marvel>scarlet-witch.text: Your magic makes my instruments go haywire, Wanda.
It does that to everyone's. Even mine.

scarlet-witch>doctor-strange.text: Your magic needs words and gestures, Stephen. Mine just happens.
That's not a strength, Wanda. That's a warning label.

doctor-strange>scarlet-witch.text: Magic always takes something back, Wanda. What has it taken from you?
Enough that I stopped keeping score.

scarlet-witch>iceman.text: You smile too much for someone in a fight, Bobby.
And you don't smile enough for someone who can do literally anything.

iceman>scarlet-witch.text: Fire and ice, I get. Chaos and ice? How does that even work?

scarlet-witch>jean-grey.text: We both know what it is to hold too much power, Jean.
And to lose control of it—

jean-grey>scarlet-witch.text: Your mind is full of children's laughter, Wanda.
My boys. Don't go any deeper.

scarlet-witch>psylocke.text: They made you into a weapon, Kwannon. They did the same to me.
Then we both chose what to cut.

psylocke>scarlet-witch.text: You hesitate before every spell, Wanda. I noticed.
That's not hesitation. That's me holding back.

scarlet-witch>rogue.text: Rogue. We both got powers no one taught us to hold.
And we both learned the hard way, sugar.

rogue>scarlet-witch.text: Red's a bold color, sugar. You wear it like a warnin'.

scarlet-witch>wolverine.text: Your claws won't help you against chaos, Logan.

wolverine>scarlet-witch.text: Last time you got upset, the world changed. Stay calm, 'kay?

scarlet-witch>mystic-brawler.text: Your power flows from the land. Mine flows from chaos.
Then let's see which one dances better, sister!

mystic-brawler>scarlet-witch.text: Your hands glow red, sister! Like lava from my mountains!

iceman>captain-marvel.text: Want me to cool you down? You're glowing a little hot there.
Kid, I absorb stars. Your ice won't last a second.

captain-marvel>iceman.text: You're cold, I'm cosmic. This won't take long.
Hey, snow need to be rude about it.

iceman>doctor-strange.text: You've got a Cloak of Levitation? I've got a cloak of refrigeration.

doctor-strange>iceman.text: One more pun, Drake, and I banish you to the hottest dimension I can find.
Give me five minutes. It'll be the coolest place in the multiverse.

iceman>jean-grey.text: Fire versus ice, Jean. Classic matchup. I like my odds.

jean-grey>iceman.text: Bobby, we were the first five X-Men. Remember how young we were?
I remember. I was the short one. Still am.

iceman>psylocke.text: You're so quiet. Is that a ninja thing or a you thing?

psylocke>iceman.text: Cutting into your mind would be like crushing ice.
Might help with the brain freeze.

iceman>rogue.text: Rogue, you're my favorite. Don't tell the others.
Sugar, you tell that to everybody.

rogue>iceman.text: Get ready, Bobby. I ain't goin' easy on you.
Great. Now I've got cold feet.

iceman>wolverine.text: I was an X-Man before you even showed up, Logan.
An' you're still the kid, popsicle.

wolverine>iceman.text: Kid, my beer's warm. Make yourself useful.
One ice cube, coming up. That'll be five bucks.

iceman>mystic-brawler.text: Ever seen snow, big guy? I could make it fall on your island.
Snow?! My ancestors never told me about this!

mystic-brawler>iceman.text: Brother! I've never seen a man made of ice! Are you a spirit?
Nope. Just the coolest guy you'll ever meet.

doctor-strange>captain-marvel.text: Captain. Do you ever land, or is that beneath you?
Only when someone's worth landing for.

captain-marvel>doctor-strange.text: You wave your hands a lot for a guy who can fly.
Precision, Captain. Not everything is solved by punching.

doctor-strange>jean-grey.text: I sense two auras in you, Jean. One is far too bright.
That's not an aura, Stephen. It's—

jean-grey>doctor-strange.text: Your mind has more locked doors than anyone I've met, Stephen.

doctor-strange>psylocke.text: Your mind is a fortress, Kwannon. Even I can't see in.

psylocke>doctor-strange.text: I could reach you before your first gesture, Doctor.
Try it. My hands are faster than they look.

doctor-strange>rogue.text: I have studied a hundred ways to stop a power like yours.
Studyin' is fine, Doc. But I'm the one with the hands-on experience.

rogue>doctor-strange.text: You talk like a textbook, Doc.
And you talk like a country song. We all have our gifts.

doctor-strange>wolverine.text: As a doctor, Logan, your healing factor offends me.

wolverine>doctor-strange.text: These claws cut through anything, Doc.
Then try cutting your way home from the dimension I leave you in.

doctor-strange>mystic-brawler.text: Your ancestors follow you everywhere. I can see them.
Wave hello, doctor! They're very friendly!

mystic-brawler>doctor-strange.text: I've fought sea monsters, doctor! What have you fought?

jean-grey>captain-marvel.text: You fly like you have something to prove, Carol.

captain-marvel>jean-grey.text: Heard you can lift a jet with your mind, Grey.

jean-grey>psylocke.text: Your thoughts are sealed tight, Kwannon. I won't force the door.
Wise. What waits behind it is not kind.

psylocke>jean-grey.text: I fight in silence. Can you?

jean-grey>rogue.text: This is a fight you can't win.
Well, bless your heart, sugar. I've whupped bigger than you before breakfast.

rogue>jean-grey.text: Sugar, you look like you're holdin' back a storm.

jean-grey>wolverine.text: Logan... I'm sorry it has to be you.
Wouldn't let it be anybody else, Red.

wolverine>jean-grey.text: If the bird ever takes over, Red, I'll be the one to stop you.
—YOU ARE WELCOME TO TRY, LITTLE BEAST.

jean-grey>mystic-brawler.text: You're very loud, Brawler. Inside and out.
A legend should be heard, sister! Everywhere!

mystic-brawler>jean-grey.text: Sister! Your fire is beautiful! Like a volcano at night!
Volcanoes sleep for years, Brawler. She—

rogue>captain-marvel.text: Your powers, darlin'. My rules. Let's go.
Bring it! But you'll never be as strong as the original.

captain-marvel>rogue.text: Every time you punch, Rogue, I see my own moves.
Funny. They look better on me, darlin'.

rogue>psylocke.text: You barely say a word, do ya? Lord, I'd go crazy.
You would. You talk enough for both of us.

psylocke>rogue.text: You charge in loud and proud. No subtlety.
Subtle's for folks who can't take a punch, hon.

rogue>wolverine.text: Logan, you always had my back. Today I'm gonna whup it.

wolverine>rogue.text: Logan, I been waitin' years to put you on your back.

rogue>mystic-brawler.text: Heard you hit back harder every time you're hit. Me too, darlin'.
Then this will be the longest fight in history, sister!

mystic-brawler>rogue.text: You fight like a hurricane over the sea, sister!
Honey, I fight like a Mississippi summer. Hot an' mean.

captain-marvel>psylocke.text: I've fought whole armadas. You're one woman with a knife.

psylocke>captain-marvel.text: You glow, Danvers. Every enemy sees you from miles away.
That's the idea. Let 'em see what's coming.

captain-marvel>wolverine.text: Heal fast, Logan. You're gonna need it.
Hit me with everything you got, Danvers. I'll still be standin'.

wolverine>captain-marvel.text: You fly in, blast everything, fly out. Ain't a fight, Danvers.
You're just mad you can't jump that high.

captain-marvel>mystic-brawler.text: What's your call sign, big guy?
Call sign? My name echoes across the ocean, sister!

mystic-brawler>captain-marvel.text: Sister! You burn like a falling star!
Falling? Please. I only go up.

psylocke>wolverine.text: Japan made you a warrior, Logan. It made me a weapon.
Then let's see which one cuts deeper.

wolverine>psylocke.text: You're good, ninja. But not good enough.
Say that again when you see me. If you see me.

psylocke>mystic-brawler.text: You fight with your ancestors beside you. I fight with my ghosts.
Then tonight, sister, the spirits will have a great show!

mystic-brawler>psylocke.text: SISTER! ALL THAT SILENCE! WHAT ARE YOU HIDING IN THERE?
I'm thinking. You should try it.

wolverine>mystic-brawler.text: You always grin like that before a fight, bub?

mystic-brawler>wolverine.text: The mountains, the sky, the sea! I'm the best there is in all three, brother!
Best there is? Bub, I've been sayin' that for a hundred years.

barbarian>barbarian.text: Finally! Someone who hits as hard as me!
Ha! Let's hit each other all day!
Best fight ever! I can't lose!

monk>monk.text: The one who strikes first has already lost.
Then we will stand here until the mountains wear away.
...Do I truly sound like that? How insufferable.

moon-elf>moon-elf.text: As did yours. This may take all night.
The moon cannot choose between us.
Then she will watch us dance until dawn.

ninja>ninja.text: I have the antidote to your poison.
I changed the poison this morning.

paladin>paladin.text: Foul demon! You will not wear my face!
Begone, deceiver! That is MY face!
...and let the Lord light both our paths.

pyromancer>pyromancer.text: Finally! The one thing I've never burned!
ME! I mean, YOU! I mean, US!
I burned a whole city once!
Cute! I burned the city they built to replace it!

shadow-thief>shadow-thief.text: Fifty-fifty. We both count, we both cheat.

treant>treant.text: We sprouted... the same spring... child.
This ground... can feed only one of us.
Then one of us... must become soil.

artificer>artificer.text: And you, the defective copy. One of us gets scrapped.
Then the tiebreaker is who disassembles whom first.

cursed-pirate>cursed-pirate.text: Hand over yer coin, lass, and the curse breaks—
Funny, I was about to take—
Neither of us can die, lass. This could take—
Then bring rum. We'll finish it—

gunslinger>gunslinger.text: Don't be late. I hate waitin'.
Your face is on a wanted poster.
Bounty's good. Shame only one of us collects.

huntress>huntress.text: Your Nyra smells just like my Nyra.
Two mothers. Neither one lets her cub lose.
This jungle has room for one huntress.
Then Nyra and I will make room.

samurai>samurai.text: At last. An opponent worthy of my blade.
And of my death, should it come.
To strike myself would be dishonor.
To refuse a challenge would be worse.

seraph>seraph.text: And no one left who dares to look.
I have judged every soul I have met.
Then judge carefully. This time, you judge yourself.

tactician>tactician.text: Funny. I had the same post in mind for you.

vampire-lord>vampire-lord.text: Five hundred years without a reflection... So this is my face.
Your castle, darling? I don't recall inviting you in.

black-panther>black-panther.text: I challenge you for the throne of Wakanda.
As tradition demands. We meet at the falls.
Then let her watch, and choose again.

black-widow>black-widow.text: Then this comes down to who forgot less.
I know how to defuse your bombs.
Same wiring. Guess we're down to knives.

captain-marvel>captain-marvel.text: Funny. I was about to ask you.

doctor-strange>doctor-strange.text: The one where I'm the original.
Another Strange. The multiverse grows careless.
Or it finally made an improvement.

loki>loki.text: How sweet. You think you're real.
And then I betray you. Naturally.

spider-man>spider-man.text: Another Miles? The multiverse is officially messing with me.
Tell me about it. Every time I sneeze, there's a new Spider-Man.
Weird. My spider-sense isn't going off.
Mine neither. Which is either great or REALLY bad.

scarlet-witch>scarlet-witch.text: Which of us did I create?
Does it matter? Only one of us stays.
I grew up with a twin. It isn't you.

thor>thor.text: This IS my true face! Show thine!
Only one of us may lift Mjolnir.
Then let the hammer choose between us!

cyclops>cyclops.text: Then one of us steps down. It won't be me.
You know our beams can't hurt each other.
Good thing our training covers more than that.

gambit>gambit.text: Pick a card, mon ami. Any card.
Same deck, same tricks. Let's see whose blows first.
Den Gambit's all in too. One of us is bluffin'.

iceman>iceman.text: Two Icemen? Now THAT'S what I call a cold war!
Wow. Is that what I sound like? That's really annoying.
Two of us fighting? We're gonna start a new Ice Age.

jean-grey>jean-grey.text: Is this what I become when I let go?
YOU NEVER LET GO. THAT IS WHY YOU ARE WEAK.
WHY DO YOU STILL HOLD ME BACK?
Because I love them more than I love power.

psylocke>psylocke.text: The same people who sent you.
You won't get past my guard.

rogue>rogue.text: Y'know, we'd get along real well if we weren't about to fight.
Well, bless mah heart, sugar. But Ah'm too stubborn to quit, and so are you.
Bless your heart. If it were, you'd already be on the floor.

storm>storm.text: Who is teaching my class right now?
No one. That is why we finish this quickly.
The sky needs only one goddess.
Then let the storm decide which of us it obeys.

wolverine>wolverine.text: I heal. You heal. This ain't endin' tonight.
Weapon X made another one of me?
Guess so, bub. Question is which of us is the copy.

headless-horseman>headless-horseman.text: Heh heh heh! Nice head! ...Wait. Is that MY head?
Heh heh heh! Finders keepers, rider!
Heh heh heh! Race you to the graveyard!
Heh heh heh! Loser loses his head!

necromancer>necromancer.text: They can't tell us apart, you fool! ...Neither can I!
Tremble before the Lord of the Dead, who—
Excuse me! I was in the middle of MY monologue!

pale-lady>pale-lady.text: I'm sure we can settle this in a civilized manner, as ladies do.
You only say that, dear, because the moon isn't full.
How lovely. No need for pretense this time—

raveness>raveness.text: Nevermore circles above us both, waiting.
Then let him feast on whichever falls first.
Nevermore shall I write a sadder line than mine.
Nevermore will anyone read yours. They only weep at mine.

druid>druid.text: Let's settle this the old way—

duelist>duelist.text: Splendid, stunning, sensationally superior swordsman! Surpassed!
Thief! Those flamboyant frills are mine!
Mine first, mine finest, mine forever.

forgemaster>forgemaster.text: Same to you, lad. Pity I've got to dent ye.
Ye saw it. I dug it. Dwarven law, lad.

sun-elf>sun-elf.text: And she shines on us both. Shall we see who glows brighter?
When dusk falls, one of us must fade.
Then dawn will find only me, child.

santa>santa.text: Ho ho ho! You take the east, I'll take the west!
Ho ho ho! And whoever finishes last gets a punch!
Ho ho ho! ...Wait. Am I on my own naughty list?
Ho ho ho! Let me check it twice.

krampus>krampus.text: My sack has room for one more.
So does mine. Let's see who fits.

alchemist>alchemist.text: Fascinating! Do we react the same to every compound?
Only one way to find out! You drink first!
Two scientists, one lab. One of us has to go.
Then let this experiment decide which!

mystic-brawler>mystic-brawler.text: Who's the real legend here, brother?
Both of us! Double the legend! ...But me a little more.
My ancestors don't know who to cheer for!
Then let's give them a fight worth deciding, brother!

deadpool>deadpool.text: Wait, the game let me fight MYSELF? Somebody file a bug report!
Relax. Mirror matches are a feature, not a bug.
Same board, same dice, same cards. So who wins?
Whoever rolls better. Ugh. It all comes down to luck.
Same hero, same cards. Only difference is who's rolling.
So we're both doomed. Have you SEEN how they roll?
